jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.We're looking for a Marketing Program Manager to join our Partner Marketing team and help us execute co\-marketing programs, events, and industry marketing with top game developers and technology partners. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, marketing, and program management, and plays an important part in supporting partner relationships and program delivery across our platform. Reporting to the Director, Partner Marketing, you'll work cross\-functionally to help ensure the successful launch of win\-win\-win campaigns: good for players, good for partners, and good for our business. You'll help keep timelines, processes, and cross\-functional coordination on track across sales, product, brand, creative, and channel teams. What You'll Be Doing Co\-Marketing Execution Support and execute partner co\-marketing campaigns across channels including owned social, email, in\-product placements, and live events. Help maintain marketing "playbooks" and repeatable program templates that support consistency and faster time\-to\-launch across partners. Support GTM planning for partner moments (new product launches, integrations, tentpole game releases), helping prepare materials and recommendations for review. Coordinate with partners' marketing counterparts on creative direction, promotional timing, approvals, and campaign deliverables. Cross\-Functional Program Coordination Provide day\-to\-day program support for Commerce partners, helping keep always\-on promotions running smoothly. Coordinate with Developer Solutions, Advertising, Commerce, PMM, and Channel Marketing teams to track timelines, deliverables, and responsibilities for partner\-facing programs. Maintain project timelines, flag dependencies and risks, and help facilitate regular syncs with internal stakeholders. Maintain intake and request\-tracking workflows (e.g., via Salesforce and Asana) so partner marketing requests are logged, prioritized, and actioned consistently. Support the development of B2B marketing collateral and presentations in partnership with Product Marketing and Consumer Marketing teams (newsletters, blog posts, case study amplification). Help coordinate partner workshops, innovation days, QBR presentations, and industry summits, using established frameworks and templates. Reporting \& Optimization Track campaign performance against business KPIs — including revenue supported, daily account linked players (DALP), and Commerce GMV — and help synthesize insights for the team. Help maintain a partner marketing roadmap that shows program activity and status for cross\-functional visibility. Flag recurring friction points (e.g., one\-off approval requests, low\-priority asks) to help the team improve processes over time. What you should have Experience 5–6 years of experience in partner marketing, co\-marketing, marketing operations, or program/project coordination — ideally in a tech, gaming, or platform company. Experience supporting cross\-functional marketing programs, from intake through launch and reporting. Some experience working directly with external partners or clients in a marketing capacity. Skills Solid project management instincts: comfortable tracking timelines, managing dependencies across multiple stakeholders, and flagging risks. Strong written and verbal communicator, able to organize information clearly for review by others. Detail\-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage an asset tracker or partner approval request end\-to\-end. Comfortable working in fast\-paced environments with shifting priorities. Good analytical instincts — comfortable pulling data and connecting program activity to business metrics with guidance. Tools Proficiency in project management and workflow tools (e.g., Asana, Salesforce, Notion, Google Workspace, Claude / AI). Familiarity with cross\-functional marketing operations, including intake and approval workflows. Experience with presentation\-heavy environments (Google Slides / PowerPoint) — you'll frequently build and review partner\-facing materials. Bonus Points Experience in the gaming industry or with game developer partnerships. Background in or exposure to developer marketing, platform marketing, or B2B marketing. Familiarity with co\-marketing in a deal context — where marketing is part of a larger commercial negotiation. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $148,000 to $166,500 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.Why Discord?Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of persona

jobs.title: CAP-CT Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary**

Involves analytical studies on a variety of policies, projects, programs and issues in support of a function, research initiative, program and / or organizational unit, or in research of new or changing systems and programs. Assists in policy and program planning, development, administration, management and implementation; interprets, monitors and analyzes information regarding policies and procedures and provides consultative services to department administrators and other stakeholders.


**Generic Scope**

Professional who applies acquired job skills, policies, and procedures to complete substantive assignments / projects / tasks of moderate scope and complexity; exercises judgment within defined guidelines and practices to determine appropriate action.


**Custom Scope**

The UCSF Division of Geriatrics seeks to recruit a full\-time **Program Coordinator** to support the implementation and operational ownership of a Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) funded program, Caregivers as Partners in Care Teams (CAP\-CT). This position reports to the Program Director and supports/leads a wide\-range of project operations and coordination tasks. The Program Coordinator will perform a broad range of duties that will require analytical, organizational, communication, technical, and coordination skills. Specific duties include: coordinating and maintaining project timelines and deliverables, assisting with researching and applying relevant policies, data collection, management, analyses and reporting, preparing and updating program materials/protocols/procedures, coordinating meeting schedules/agendas/minutes, drafting and updating documents, making program\-related purchases and submitting expense reports, conducting literature searches/reviews, and supporting manuscript preparation/scholarly dissemination. The Program Coordinator will additionally function as a subject matter expert and provide oversight and direction on learning management systems, manage digital education platforms, CE/CME accreditation coordination, analytics reporting, marketing communications, website management, and operational support across multiple projects and conferences. This position requires the ability to be proactive, resourceful and efficient, with a high level of flexibility. An ideal candidate will be able to work independently with minimal supervision, balances multiple competing priorities at any given time, and is intellectually curious, willing to learn new skills and a problem\-solver. The Program Coordinator may be required to provide the same level of support across projects/programs where there is a need.


**Department Overview**

The Division of Geriatrics’ work is grounded in a deep commitment to and respect for older persons from diverse backgrounds and lived experiences. We are specialists in aging. Our expertise is in optimizing the health of older individuals. We work in the community and on virtually every UCSF campus – Parnassus, San Francisco VA Health Care System, Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital, Mission Bay, and UCSF Center for Geriatric Care. The Division has over 130 employees including faculty, volunteer clinical faculty, fellows, staff, student interns and volunteers. We are deeply committed to, and will champion, diversity, equity and inclusion as our core mission. We will nurture and grow a culture in which everyone from all backgrounds is welcomed, supported, respected, and valued!


  
**Required Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of relevant experience.
* Working knowledge of common organization\- or research\-specific and other computer application programs.
* Proficient in communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Proficient in ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
* Demonstrates ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
* Demonstrates ability to analyze, research and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
* Proficient in ability to multi\-task with demanding timeframes.
* Experience in using Qualtrics/REDCap/other surveying platforms.
* Proficient in MS Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, etc.)
* Proficient with Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Learning Management System (LMS).
* Experience working with consumers of educational courses/academic institutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in public health or research administration, e.g. working on state contracts, NIH programs, or working in an academic institution.
* Previous experience using project management tools and software, website management and managing social media platforms.

**Required Education**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.

jobs.title: Food Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Food Program Coordinator

**Organization:** Daly City Partnership (DCP)

**Reports To:** Director of COVE

**Supervises:** \~20 Volunteers; provides secondary supervision and support when the primary supervisor is unavailable

**Salary Range:** Grade 7 ($28/hr \- $31/hr)

**FLSA Status:** Full\-Time \| 40 hrs/week

**About Daly City Peninsula Partnership Collaborative**

Daly City Partnership is a 501(c)(3\) non\-profit organization dedicated to creating transformative change in Northern San Mateo County. We provide comprehensive, multi\-generational services that empower children, families, and older adults to overcome challenges and promote community advancement. Our vision is a thriving community where everyone is empowered to reach their full potential, driven by our core values of Community, Responsibility, Determination, and Compassion. 

**Position Overview**

The Food Distribution Coordinator oversees the daily operations of DCP’s food programs. This includes organizing weekly food distributions, managing volunteers, maintaining inventory, and submitting reports. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, dependable, and enjoys engaging with both the community and volunteers in a fast\-paced environment. Supervised by the Director of COVE. 

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 1–2 years' experience in a leadership role, program coordination or volunteer management
* Valid California driver’s license and a driving record that meets the organization’s insurance requirements
* Must maintain a clean and insurable driving record throughout employment.
* Experience working with diverse populations
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Familiar with Microsoft Office

**Preferred Qualifications (In Addition To Those Above)**

* Bilingual in Spanish, Tagalog, Cantonese, or Mandarin
* Experience in food security or nonprofit programs

**Operational Responsibilities**

* Act as the lead coordinator for the grocery rescue program and Project Dash, managing logistics, scheduling, and partner communication.
* Safely drive the organization's van to execute grocery rescue pickups and perform Project Dash home deliveries (up to twice a week).
* Coordinate daily operations for Project Dash and satellite site distributions.
* Serve as operational support to the main food distribution program as needed.
* Train and supervise volunteers, ensuring compliance with safety and civil rights protocols
* Maintain volunteer records, monitor performance, and foster an inclusive team environment
* Support clients during distribution and connect them to additional resources as needed
* Utilize digital platforms for communication, scheduling, and tracking volunteer engagement

**Ability to:**

* Follow food safety and civil rights regulations
* De\-escalate and resolve client concerns
* Keep confidentiality of client and volunteer information
* Be able to lift up to 50 pounds, occasionally.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Must perform a background check and driving record check

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Paid Holidays, Sick leave
* 403 (b) plan
* Ongoing training, growth \& advancement opportunities

Employment with Daly City Partnership is "at\-will." Either the employee or the organization may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment. 

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter and complete all questions and assessments on Indeed.

***Join a caring and dedicated team of co\-workers and volunteers who take great pride and joy in helping members of our community succeed and thrive!***

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $28\.00 \- $31\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 403(b)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Language:

* Spanish, Tagalog, Cantonese, or Mandarin  (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: OCIP Workers Compensation Program Coordinator, Google Data Centers
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience handling workers compensation claims.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with claims management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) platforms, and standard productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets).
* Solid working knowledge of end\-to\-end workers compensation procedures, claims administration, and relevant state and federal labor laws.
* Comprehensive understanding of medical terminology, treatment protocols, and injury evaluation.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Workers Compensation and Owner Controlled Insurance Policy (OCIP) Program Lead oversees the strategic governance, placement, and daily administration of owner\-controlled insurance programs and occupational injury claims. This role drives end\-to\-end risk management by conducting exposure analyses, directing policy audits, and partnering closely with brokers and contractors to optimize coverage structures and ensure seamless program enrollment.


In addition to program strategy, the lead directs full\-lifecycle workers compensation claims management across employees, owners, and contractors. Acting as the primary liaison among injured workers, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and healthcare providers, the role coordinates quality medical care and facilitates prompt, modified\-duty return\-to\-work transitions. Furthermore, the position ensures regulatory compliance and workplace safety by delivering supervisor training, maintaining comprehensive claims databases, and analyzing incident trends to implement proactive, data\-driven injury prevention initiatives.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.
* Receive and process claims for owners, employees, and contractors, arrange medical care and facilitate return\-to\-work and modified\-duty accommodations.
* Serve as primary contact for injured workers, liaise with carriers, clinics, and legal counsel and maintain detailed incidents and financial records.
* Deliver supervisors claim training, analyze incident trends to prevent recurring injuries, and ensure alignment with workers compensation regulations.
* Evaluate risk exposures, design proactive risk control solutions, and build strategic vendor and insurer relationships.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: 214 Men's Step Down - Program Manager
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union\-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** Monday \- Friday 8:30 am \- 5:00 pm
  
  

JOB SUMMARY
  
  

HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re\-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  

Men’s Residential Step Down (MRSD) is a program of HealthRIGHT 360 located at Alamo Square neighborhood in San Francisco. It is a 64\-bed male transitional housing for individuals that have completed at a minimum of 30 days residential substance use disorder treatment. MRSD provides temporary housing to assist our clients in their next stage of sobriety.
  
  

The Program Manager IV is responsible for the direct management of the Residential Step\-Down facility. Through supervision and training, the Program Manager IV ensures care and safety is provided with cultural competency and process is functioning efficiently and in compliance with contracts and rules for the program.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

**Program Management Responsibilities:**  

* Under supervision of the Program Director, the Program Manager of the Residential Step\-Down Program plans and administers all aspects of the Residential Step\-Down Program.
* Directs and coordinates various activities within the program.
* Coordinates with the intake/referral department to ensure smooth and effective admission processes for new clients and high utilization of the facility.
* Ensures facility is in accordance with goals of contract.
* Provides direct services such as intake, assessment, crisis interventions, \& case management as needed.
* Has ultimate responsibility for retention and completion of all clients.


**Supervisory Responsibilities:**  

* Provides immediate supervision and guidance to the staff of the program.
* Responsible for recruitment, hiring, direct supervision, and on\-going training of all program staff and student interns.
* Ensures staff is familiar with program policies, procedures, and practices.
* Coordinates staff coverage, reviews and responds to vacation requests, and coordinates program services.


**Facility Management Responsibilities:**  

* Responsible for all operational functions of Residential Step\-Down Program, including but not limited to maintenance, program supplies, meals, \& medical needs of clients.
* Responsible for safety and security of the facility.


**Administration and Compliance:**  

* In accordance with guidelines established by HealthRIGHT 360 to satisfy internal and external evaluating requirements, ensures that staff maintains accurate documentation on all clients. Perform regular audits to ensure contract compliance.
* Coordinates with staff to make necessary corrections on all Electronic Health Records (EMR) discrepancies within a timely manner.


QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

Education, Certification, or Licensure
  
* Bachelor's Degree, OR 4 years equivalent work experience.
* 7 years supervisory experience.
* Valid CA Driver’s License.
* First Aid and CPR certification.
* Preferred:
* Master’s Degree from an accredited college in counseling, psychology, or social work
* Some experience in substance abuse prevention/treatment programs in a residential setting
* Alcohol and Drug Counseling Certification with one of the three approved certifying organizations in California (CCAPP, CAADE, or CADTP)
* Licensed LMFT, LCSW, or LPCC in the state of California
* Experience providing behavioral health services

jobs.description:
**About Glide**
GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization. **Position Summary**:
The Supervising Case Manager (SCM) oversees a team of 1–3 Case Managers, manages shift operations across all San Francisco neighborhoods, oversees hotline functions, validates relocations and reunifications, and safeguards all client\-related supplies, vouchers, tickets, and funds. The SCM ensures high\-quality mobile and onsite services that support clients experiencing homelessness toward stabilization and long\-term well\-being.

In this role, you will create, develop, and steward a caseload of approximately 20\-25 clients at various stages of their journey toward housing stabilization and help approximately 3\-5 people per month progress from homelessness toward housing stability. Journey Home Supervising Case Managers are assigned a regular shift (Day, Graveyard), must be available to work outside of their regular shift when assigned, and must be available to work special events or serve as emergency workers when required by community need. Shifts can be reassigned or rotated as the business needs of the operations change.

**Schedule:** Tuesday–Saturday, 10:30 PM–7:30 AM \\u007C 40 **hours/week**

* Support the Program Manager and Director by enforcing Journey Home’s mission, policies, protocols, and contract requirements. Oversee all aspects of an operational shift, ensuring strong staff supervision and effective resource and schedule management for 24/7 operations.

* Verify all relocations and reunifications for appropriateness, documentation, safety, and legitimacy. Model excellence in direct case management.

* Ensure compliance with all fleet safety and operational protocols; serve as lead driver when needed.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with CBOs, SFPD, SFFD, EMS, hospitals, clinics, statewide partners, and GLIDE internal programs (Welcome Center, Safety, Ambassadors, etc.).
* Conduct outreach and engagement with individuals experiencing or at risk of homelessness. Connect clients to shelter, housing, and wraparound services to achieve Journey Home KPIs.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation for 50–60 active clients per case manager, including intakes, assessments, notes, logs, engagements, referrals, and all required data. Submit accurate daily, weekly, and monthly reports on time in the required databases.
* Transport clients to appointments; arrange travel; and ensure all client resources are tracked, distributed, and managed with the highest ethical and fraud\-prevention standards. Coach team members to do the same.
* Uphold all case management ethics, HIPAA rules, confidentiality protocols, and public communication guidelines, and train team members to do the same. Coach team members to do the same.
* Connect clients to the full range of GLIDE and community\-based services. Collaborate with all GLIDE neighborhood engagement and street\-crisis response programs, integrating services where appropriate. Build rapport with neighborhood groups.

GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization **Position Summary**



Journey Home Case Managers spearhead mobile and on\-premises client outreach, intake, assessment, and low\-threshold to intensive case management: develop and manage individualized care plans, coordinate resources and wrap\-around services, transport clients to appointments, connect clients with shelter and housing, facilitate health, mental health, and substance use disorder treatment, arrange travel and transportation, and help clients reunite with family, support networks, and careers for long\-term well\-being and housing stabilization. In this role, you will create, develop, and steward a caseload of approximately 20\-25 clients at various stages of their journey toward housing stabilization and help approximately 3\-5 people per month progress from homelessness toward housing stability.



Journey home case managers are assigned a regular shift (such as AM, PM or Graveyard). You must be flexible and available to work outside of their regular shift when assigned. And must be available to work special events or serve as emergency workers when required by community need. Shifts may be reassigned or rotated (within the parameters of the CBA) as the business needs of the operations change.


**Schedule:** Tuesday \- Saturday, 10:30 pm \- 7:30 am \\u007C 40 **hours/week**

* Must be able to conduct oneself in a professional manner, model emotional intelligence and self\-regulation.
* Consistent attendance and on\-time arrival (for all assigned shifts) are crucial.
* Must successfully complete the California Peer\-to\-Peer Support Specialist certification within 60 days upon hire.
### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Outreach, educate, and connect people experiencing or at risk of homelessness to shelter, housing, and coordinated care wrap\-around services to support housing stability.
* Document and maintain complete case files on 20\-25 active clients including updated intakes, assessments, case management notes, appointment and attendances logs, engagements, referrals, connections, and other required data captured in a timely and accurate manner as directed. Submit daily, weekly, and monthly activity and data reports that capture contract deliverables in required database systems on or before the due date.
* Transport clients to and from appointments; arrange travel and ensure that all resources provided to clients are tracked, managed, and distributed according to best practices for eliminating theft, fraud, misuse, and abuse; adhere to the highest ethical standards when managing both our clients and all of the wrap\-around resources provided to support our clients.
* Adhere to standard professional boundaries, understand and follow basic ethics and values of case management, and understand and adhere to HIPAA protocols, approved public speaking guidelines, and other SOPs meant to ensure a consistent and accurate portrayal of program services.
* Build and maintain positive rapport with all clients to maintain a productive and active caseload; ensure steady client progression withing coordinated care framework. Consistently conduct outreach and connect clients to the full range of Glide services across all life domains, as well as relevant external resources to achieve stability.
* Develop and prepare outreach and educational materials targeted to engage the broader community. Assist the leadership team in coordinating special events that promote Journey Home efforts as well as the full array of GLIDE services.

* Participate and engage in proactive self\-leadership, individual supervision, team meetings, community meetings, professional development, training, and other professional development opportunities.

jobs.title: Medicare Advocate
jobs.description:
**Title:****Medicare Advocate**


**Department:** HICAP – San Francisco

**FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt

**Reports To:** Program Manager

**Summary:** The Medicare Advocate counsels Medicare beneficiaries and those individuals soon to be eligible for Medicare benefits, provides information, and advocates on behalf of older adults and people with disabilities, and may conduct community outreach and education. Activities are related to the following objectives:

* Assist Medicare beneficiaries with questions about health benefits, health claims, and insurance problems through direct counseling and informal advocacy.
* Support the independence of people making choices that affect their health and financial well\-being.
* Inform the public and interested parties about the challenges associated with Medicare and related health insurance plans and products.

*Training will be provided on Medicare, Medi\-Cal, and other health care topics to enable the Medicare Advocates to become registered Health Insurance Counseling and Advocacy (HICAP) Counselors.*

**Essential Functions:**

* **Counseling**\- Provides individual counseling and informational services to Medicare beneficiaries regarding Medicare insurance options, eligibility for financial assistance programs to help with Medicare costs, billing problems, and other related topics.
* **Advocacy** \- Assists individuals as appropriate to ensure that clients’ rights and privileges under Medicare are upheld, makes appropriate referrals to legal services and /or other agencies, and offers other referrals and/or interventions as needed and appropriate.
* **Record Keeping**\-Maintains accurate database records on all clients, contacts, and services
* **Community Outreach and Education** \- Attend outreach events or conduct presentations to community groups, senior centers, senior lunch sites, etc. Providing presentations regarding HICAP services, Medicare, Medicare Supplemental (Medigap) insurance, long\-term care insurance, consumer rights, Medicare Advantage (MA), and prescription drug plans (PDP) and promotes program publicity.
* **Collaboration and Communications**\- Demonstrates a collaborative and respectful approach to working with colleagues, contributing to a positive, team\-oriented work environment.
* **Attendance and Punctuality**\- Maintains regular and reliable attendance, adhering to assigned work schedules and punctuality standards.
* Substitutes for volunteer counselors at counseling sites when needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent training with a minimum of two years providing services in a social services or health care organization or related experience.
* Must complete HICAP counselor training and/or registration within 2 months of employment, depending on program needs. Must maintain current registration standards as outlined by the CDA.
* Three or more years providing services in a social services or health care organization or related experience.
* Knowledge of Medicare, Medi\-Cal, Medigap, managed care, long\-term care insurance, and health care delivery systems preferred.
* Must abide by the HICAP Confidentiality and Conflict of Interest Guidelines as outlined by the CDA and HICAP. These include having no past or present employment or financial interests and investments, or personal affiliations that may affect their ability to provide HICAP services in an objective and unbiased manner.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, and experience in group presentations. Bilingual in English and Chinese/Spanish/Russian/Vietnamese preferred.
* Must be self\-motivated, organized, and able to multitask under minimal supervision.
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment;
* Sensitive to the needs of the elderly and disabled adults from diverse ethnic and minority cultures.
* Proficient in MS Office and the Internet.
* Must be able to travel via public transportation or personal vehicle for the performance of job duties. If driving, must have and maintain a valid CA driver license, satisfactory driving record, and auto insurance coverage as specified in Self\-Help's policy.

*Self\-Help for the Elderly is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmation Action Employer and we welcome diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law. We participate in E\-Verify.*

*Qualified applicants with criminal history will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*

*We may provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, please call (415\) 677\-7600 for special assistance.*

**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.

This job will collaborate internally and use best practices to influence the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of processes and programs. jobs.description:
- **ABOUT WIND RIVER**
====================

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission\-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.


Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.


The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer\-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion \& belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world.


**YOUR ROLE**
=============

We are seeking a highly analytical and technology\-focused Sales Operations Administrator to drive operational excellence across our global sales organization.


In this role, you will be responsible for optimizing sales processes, administering critical sales technologies, delivering actionable analytics, and supporting automation initiatives that improve seller productivity, data quality, and operational efficiency.


**HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE**
---------------------------

You will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance, IT, and Business Systems teams to streamline workflows, improve reporting visibility, and help scale operations as Wind River continues to grow.


**In your daily work, you will:**
---------------------------------


	* Administer and optimize key sales technologies including Salesforce CRM, Salesforce CPQ, ZoomInfo, Clari, Outreach, Salesloft, and related sales engagement platforms.
	* Support onboarding and offboarding activities for sales personnel and related user groups.
	* Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and analytics that support leadership decision\-making.
	* Identify operational bottlenecks and drive continuous improvements across lead management, opportunity progression, territory management, forecasting, quoting, and partner\-related processes.
	* Build and enhance automation solutions within Salesforce, including workflows, approvals, validation rules, and process automation.
	* Partner with cross\-functional teams to improve data governance, system adoption, and operational effectiveness.
	* Participate in evaluating, testing, and implementing new sales technologies and process enhancements.**Key skills and competencies for succeeding in this role include:**
--------------------------------------------------------------------


	* 5\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related analytical role.
	* 3\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce administration and support experience.
	* Strong experience developing Salesforce reports, dashboards, and analytics.
	* Experience supporting Salesforce CPQ environments.
	* Experience with Salesforce Enterprise Territory Management (ETM) or similar territory management solutions preferred.
	* Experience with ZoomInfo, sales engagement platforms, and sales productivity tools.
	* Experience developing process automation within Salesforce.
	* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with strong Excel skills.
	* Strong understanding of CRM data quality, governance, and reporting best practices.
	* Ability to analyze business processes and translate requirements into scalable operational solutions.
	* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
	* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
	* Self\-motivated team player with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.**BENEFITS**
============


	* Hybrid work model for workplace flexibility.
	* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
	* Life insurance.
	* Short and long\-term disability coverage.
	* Flexible time\-off policies.
	* Employee assistance program.
	* Learning and professional development opportunities, including access to LinkedIn Learning.
	* 401(k) participation and company\-sponsored programs.**COMPENSATION**
----------------

This role is compensation range is between $140,00 to $160,000 USD plus annual incentive plan bonus. Compensation is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and abilities of the applicant, and equity with other team members. Employees in this role are also eligible for the following benefits in accordance with the terms of the Company's plans: health, dental, vision insurance, life insurance, flex time off, eligibility to enroll in 401k, and 12 paid holidays.

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

  

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

  

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will own the technical and commercial vetting that turns a raw deal into a fundable project — the work that separates a defensible capacity commitment from an inflated one. When a partner asks Crux to guarantee an eight\- or nine\-figure sum, you're the one who tests that number against schedule, equipment composition, and real construction cost before it goes to leadership. Reporting into the Chief Program Manager's organization, you will sit at the interface between Data Center Construction, Energy, MEP, and Finance, making sure every project in the active portfolio is executed against the numbers it was approved on — and flagging it immediately when it isn't.

**In this role, you will:**

* Vet the technical and commercial terms of new capacity deals — schedule, equipment cost, equipment composition — before they're recommended to leadership, right\-sizing commitments rather than defaulting to the number a partner asks for.
* Track every live data center project in the portfolio against its approved cost and schedule baseline, and own the process for flagging and escalating variance early.
* Partner with Data Center Construction, Energy, and MEP Systems teams to translate field\-level execution status into Finance\-ready program reporting.
* Own the interface between build\-side execution and the cost and margin model of record — your data is what Finance's models are actually built on.
* Run the change\-control process for scope, schedule, or cost changes on active projects, with sign\-off gates that keep Finance and Development aligned in real time.
* Build and maintain the tools that make deal vetting fast and repeatable — this cannot be a one\-off analysis redone from scratch on every deal.
* Default to AI\-agentic workflows for cost/schedule reconciliation and variance tracking, rather than adding headcount to keep up with portfolio growth.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Deal\-vetting framework (schedule, equipment cost, composition) is documented and applied to at least one live negotiation.
* Portfolio cost/schedule tracking is live for the current active project set.

**After 6 months:**

* Variance escalation process is running with a documented track record of catching at\-risk projects before they slip.
* Finance's cost and margin model of record is being fed directly from your tracking, not reconstructed separately.

**After 1 year:**

* Deal\-vetting and portfolio\-tracking functions run as a repeatable system others can execute against, not a one\-person effort.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 8\+ years in data center construction, capital projects, or infrastructure delivery with direct P\&L, cost, or schedule ownership.
* Demonstrated experience vetting or negotiating capacity/commercial terms against real technical and cost data, not top\-down assumptions.
* Comfortable moving fluently across finance, construction, and technology — this is not a single\-lane specialist seat.

**Attributes**

* “$900M is the ask” is a hypothesis until the equipment and schedule say otherwise — you test the number before you defend it.
* You bring bad news first, unprompted, and own the result — hierarchy doesn't intimidate you and you don't intimidate easily either.

**Mindset**

* High tolerance for ambiguity. The portfolio will outgrow whatever process exists today, and you build the next version rather than waiting for one.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager, Validation & Vehicle Operations
jobs.description:
About Lucid



At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software\-defined vehicle architecture, our award\-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.



We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in\-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility.

**Sr. SW Quality Vehicle Operation and Validation Project Manager**


**Engineering \| California \| Full\-Time**


**About Lucid**



At Lucid, we are creating an electric future without compromise. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. We build world\-class vehicles by pushing performance, efficiency, and design beyond industry limits, setting new standards with vehicles like Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity.



The people here, engineers, designers, operators, and builders, came from across industries and around the world because they wanted to work on a harder problem. They care deeply about mastering their craft and delivering work they are proud of. We trust you to take ownership, push beyond what is expected, and help write the playbook for what comes next.



By refusing to settle, you help shape the future of electric mobility and prove what is possible when craft and ambition refuse to compromise each other.


**The Role**



We are seeking a Sr. SW Quality Vehicle Operation and Validation Project Manager who will serve as the accountable Lucid owner for the California assessment fleet, daily Quality assessment execution, and validation project coordination.



This role is responsible for ensuring assessment vehicles are ready, scheduled, configured, and available against software release milestones while managing fleet logistics, repair readiness, OTA and build control, validation support, and cross\-functional execution.



The ideal candidate combines strong project management discipline, hands\-on vehicle operations capability, software quality validation experience, and proactive cross\-functional coordination to ensure Quality assessments start on time, findings are supported with the right evidence, and release readiness decisions are grounded in real vehicle execution.



Mission: Lead SW Quality vehicle operations and validation project execution by keeping the California assessment fleet ready, controlled, and effectively utilized so daily Quality assessments can execute on time and support software release readiness.


**What** **You'll** **Own**


**Fleet Ownership \& Vehicle Readiness**



Serve as the accountable Lucid owner for the California assessment fleet, daily Quality assessment execution, and validation project coordination.



Maintain fleet and vehicle readiness by ensuring assessment vehicles are available, scheduled, configured, and utilized against software release milestones.



Coordinate maintenance, repair, and parts replacement activities to keep assessment vehicles ready for planned execution.


**OTA \& Build Management**



Own OTA and build control across the assessment fleet, including update deployment, version tracking, and configuration integrity.



Coordinate deployment of special builds with Digital Engineering for validation, investigation, and root cause support.



Track vehicle status, software and build versions, assessment availability, repair constraints, and execution blockers in a structured manner to support release milestone visibility.


**Quality Assessment \& Validation Support**



Support Quality assessment execution through issue reproduction, log collection, and clear triage input for findings discovered during daily vehicle assessments.



Perform hands\-on vehicle operations and assessment support as needed to confirm readiness, reproduce issues, collect evidence, and unblock execution.


**Fleet Operations \& Logistics Coordination**



Coordinate drivers, fleet logistics, vehicle handoffs, and operational readiness so assessments start on time and daily execution remains continuous.



Organize multiple vehicles, builds, drivers, repairs, and daily assessment schedules while maintaining clear status visibility and operational control.


**Cross\-Functional Program Execution**



Partner closely with Software Quality, Digital Engineering, Vehicle Engineering, Service, Fleet Operations, and Program teams to align assessment priorities, vehicle readiness, and release\-support needs.



Drive cross\-functional alignment and escalation across vehicle readiness, repair coordination, OTA and build updates, and assessment execution needs.


**Continuous Improvement**



Drive practical improvements to daily assessment operations, including fleet readiness routines, escalation paths, handoff discipline, and repeatable execution processes.



Identify readiness gaps and execution blockers and drive improvements that strengthen fleet utilization, validation support, and release readiness.


**What You Bring**


**Required**


* Bachelor's degree in a related technical or operational field OR equivalent relevant technical education, certification, or comparable formal training is required.
* Minimum 7\+ years of relevant experience in vehicle operations, fleet coordination, software quality validation, test operations, service engineering, or related automotive product quality roles.

**OUR COMMITMENT TO A HUMAN HIRING PROCESS**



We believe every candidate deserves thoughtful consideration. That's why we do not use AI or automated systems to review applications. Every application is reviewed by a real human member of our team. Because we take the time to give each submission the attention it deserves, our review process may take a little longer — and we genuinely appreciate your patience as we work through applications carefully and respectfully.


**SERVICE AREA PREFERENCE**



While we encourage all interested applicants to apply, we do give priority to those who live in, or near, our service counties: Santa Cruz, Monterey, Merced, San Benito, and Mariposa. Our mission of *accessible, quality health care guided by local innovation*leads everything we do, and having team members who are connected to the communities we serve strengthens our ability to deliver on that commitment.


#### **ABOUT THIS TEMP POSITION**



This is a temporary position. The length of the assignment is estimated to go from September 2026 through December 2026, but this is always dependent on business need, and these dates may change. While the assignment would be at the Alliance, you would be an employee of a temporary employment agency that we would connect you with if hired for this position.This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) temporary assignment.


**WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**



Reporting to the Enterprise Project Management Manager, this position:


* Provides intermediate\-level project management support for medium to high complexity cross\-functional, systems\-driven strategic and operational projects involving interdepartmental units and/or external stakeholder teams through all aspects of the project lifecycle
* Conducts intermediate\-level business, technical and financial analysis and reporting to support operations and business development
* Effectively utilizes, implements and communicates project management methodologies and policies, and mentors project teams, project stakeholders and Enterprise Project Managers, to ensure accuracy, consistency and thoroughness


**ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Project Management Office (PMO) is a key part of our Operational Excellence Department, committed to *providing and growing operational effectiveness expertise across the organization*. As the PMO team, we contribute to that commitment through enterprise Portfolio, Program and Project Management services, enabling the organization to operationally adapt and advance our mission. The PMO's role is to provide practical structure, partnership, and support that makes it easier for teams to deliver meaningful outcomes and focus on what matters most: serving our members well.



**IDEAL CANDIDATE**



We are looking for a flexible, adaptable professional who works effectively with stakeholders at all levels and keeps projects moving in a fast\-paced environment. This person communicates clearly, collaborates across teams, and manages the full project lifecycle with strong organization and attention to detail. They are resourceful and solution oriented, able to balance multiple priorities while producing high\-quality documentation. They take ownership of their work, build trust and credibility quickly, foster alignment across teams, and contribute to team success with a constructive, team\-first approach.



#### **WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**



To read the full position description and list of requirements, click here.


* **Knowledge of:**
* + Project management methodologies and tools
	+ Windows based PC systems and Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and project management software applications
	+ Methods and tools of meeting facilitation and ability to lead team building exercises and facilitate meetings and/or projects using problem solving and persuasion skills
* **Ability to:**
	+ Demonstrate strong analytical skills and identify issues, offer solutions and mitigate risk
	+ Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner
	+ Maintain organized and accurate records
	+ Accurately collect, interpret and evaluate data, make recommendations, and project consequences of recommendations
	+ Prepare statistical and narrative reports
* **Education and Experience:**
	+ Bachelor's degree in a Business, Health Care or a related field
	+ A minimum of three years of project management experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be qualifying

#### **OTHER INFORMATION**


* We are in a hybrid work environment, and we anticipate that the interview process will take place remotely via Microsoft Teams.
* While some staff may work full telecommuting schedules, attendance at quarterly company\-wide events or department meetings will be expected.
* In\-office or in\-community presence may be required for some positions and is dependent on business need. Details about this can be reviewed during the interview process.
* **This is a temporary position and does not provide the benefits that are listed below (this is standard language from our regular job posts and cannot be altered or removed). Temporary employees on assignment at the Alliance will be connected to a staffing agency with separate benefit options.**


**COMPENSATION INFORMATION**


* **Zone 1 Pay Range: $57\.70 \- $63\.50**  

Typical areas in Zone 1: Santa Cruz, San Benito, and Monterey Counties, Bay Area, Sacramento, Los Angeles and San Diego areas
* **Zone 2 Pay Range: $54\.50 \- $60\.10**  

Typical areas in Zone 2: Mariposa and Merced Counties, Fresno area, Bakersfield, Eastern California, San Luis Obispo area, and the Central Valley (except Sacramento)


The applicable salary ranges are based on work location and are aligned to a zone according to the cost of labor in your area. All ranges are subject to change in the future. jobs.title: Program Manager- NPI
jobs.description:
As NPI Program Manager, you will serve as the primary leader for assigned customer programs and portfolios, driving the execution of customer commitments, operational performance, and business objectives. You will align resources across Molex GSM, translate customer requirements into executable plans, and lead cross\-functional teams through demand planning, delivery, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Account Management, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain \& Operations, Procurement, and Sales, you will ensure priorities, risks, and decisions are effectively managed to support customer success and profitable growth.
Success in this role requires strong business acumen, customer advocacy, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization to drive accountability, disciplined execution, and measurable results. The Program Manager is accountable for overall program performance and customer satisfaction, ensuring alignment between customer priorities and business objectives.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead cross\-functional execution of customer programs and projects, managing priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions to ensure successful delivery of customer and business objectives.
* Serve as the primary program leader and internal customer advocate, aligning customer priorities, contractual commitments, and business objectives with operational capabilities and resources.
* Establish and maintain program governance, including customer reviews, executive business reviews, escalation management, action tracking, performance reporting, and recovery planning.
* Translate customer demand, forecasts, program changes, and strategic priorities into coordinated plans that support delivery, quality, responsiveness, and profitable growth.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate risks while facilitating timely, data\-driven decision\-making to prevent impacts to customer experience or business performance.
* Develop and maintain program plans, dashboards, performance metrics, and communication processes that provide visibility, accountability, and execution discipline.
* Partner with commercial and operational leaders to support strategic account planning, identify growth opportunities, improve forecast accuracy, and protect profitability.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including on\-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, customer satisfaction, and program profitability.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 2\+ years of experience leading programs, projects, customer accounts, or cross\-functional business initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across matrixed organizations, manage risk, balance competing priorities, and drive execution without direct authority.
* Strong business, financial, analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills, including experience leading customer communications, escalations, and performance reviews.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, ERP/MRP systems, business intelligence tools, and performance reporting dashboards.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience leading strategic customer programs in aerospace, defense, space, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting strategic account growth, new program launches, demand planning, and manufacturing operations.
* Experience presenting to executive leadership, leading customer business reviews, and building strong customer relationships while balancing business and operational priorities.
* PMP, PgMP, Lean Six Sigma, or comparable project management and continuous improvement certifications.


For this role, we anticipate paying $85,000\- $100,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form .

**Hiring Philosophy**


All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

**Who We Are**


At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

**Our Benefits**


Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes \- medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.


Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

**Equal Opportunities**

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. jobs.title: Residential Project Manager
jobs.description:
Nordin Builders is a small, family\-run residential general contractor looking for a Project Manager to join our team. We build and remodel homes throughout Los Altos, Los Altos Hills, Palo Alto, Mountain View, Woodside and surrounding areas.

This is a hybrid role, but the majority of the position is spent onsite. We’re looking for someone who understands residential construction, can confidently read plans, knows construction sequencing and is comfortable managing the day\-to\-day moving pieces of a project.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day progress of residential projects
* Coordinate subcontractors, inspections, deliveries and materials
* Read architectural and structural plans and oversee work in the field
* Maintain project schedules and stay ahead of upcoming trades and project needs
* Communicate with homeowners, architects, designers, subcontractors and our internal team
* Identify issues in the field and work with the team to resolve them
* Manage project documentation such as change orders and punch lists
* Keep project information organized and up to date in Buildertrend and Google Drive

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong knowledge of residential construction and how a project comes together from start to finish
* Very good at reading and understanding construction plans
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing and trade coordination
* Organized, dependable and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces
* Strong communication and follow\-through
* Comfortable with technology and proficient with Google Drive, Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Calendar
* Buildertrend experience is a plus, but not required

We’re flexible on exact background and experience. Residential project management experience is a plus, but strong field experience, construction knowledge and the ability to stay organized and manage a project are most important to us.

Because we’re a small team, this person will work closely with both our field and office staff and have a lot of involvement in their projects.

* **Full\-time \| Monday–Friday**
* **Primarily onsite with some remote flexibility**
* **Compensation based on experience**

Pay: From $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company truck
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  

  

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.


The **Senior Program Manager** will lead technical program execution with a primary focus on ensuring flawless alignment between Varian and external suppliers. This role is responsible for orchestrating day\-to\-day technical activities across supplier interfaces and internal engineering teams, ensuring that system\-level integration, technical requirements, and deliverables are consistently aligned, executed, and validated.


Working closely with Engineering, this role acts as the single point of coordination across supplier technical interfaces, proactively identifying risks, resolving misalignment early, and maintaining program momentum across complex, multi\-disciplinary workstreams.

**Responsibilities**


Supplier \& Technical Alignment

* Accountable for end\-to\-end technical alignment across Varian and supplier interfaces; owns resolution of any integration misalignment impacting program delivery.
* Own technical alignment between Varian and external suppliers, ensuring requirements clarity, traceability, and execution consistency
* Drive interface management across hardware, software, and system integration boundaries
* Establish and enforce technical governance with suppliers (reviews, design checkpoints, issue tracking)
* Identify and resolve technical gaps, inconsistencies, and integration risks early


Program Execution \& Coordination

* Lead and coordinate day\-to\-day technical program execution across internal engineering teams and external suppliers, ensuring alignment to schedule and deliverables.
* Translate program objectives into clear technical deliverables and milestones across suppliers
* Maintain integrated program plans that reflect both Varian and supplier dependencies
* Own the technical decision tracker and ensure all decisions are documented, communicated, and implemented across organizations.Risk \& Issue Management
* Proactively identify and escalate technical and integration risks
* Drive cross\-company issue resolution, ensuring rapid decision\-making and no loss of momentum


Implement risk mitigation strategies to avoid downstream delays in system integration


Communication \& Leadership

* Serve as the primary interface between Varian and supplier technical leadership
* Provide clear, structured updates to internal stakeholders and leadership
* Facilitate technical decision\-making across organizations, ensuring alignment and accountability
* Strategic Governance and Leadership of technical program milestones to accelerate schedules and proactively mitigate technical risks for the ARPA project.

 **Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Physics, or related technical field
* 8–12\+ years of experience in technical program/project management, preferably in medical devices or complex systems
* Proven experience working with external suppliers or partners in a technical environment
* Strong understanding of system integration, hardware/software interfaces, and engineering development cycles
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-functional and multi\-company technical programs
* Strong technical acumen with ability to engage deeply with engineering teams
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across organizational boundaries
* Structured problem\-solving and risk management mindset
* Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast\-paced development environments

 **Other Desired Skills and Knowledge:**

* Proven experience with FLASH clinical trials.
* Experience with HCM (e.g., Workday), CRM (Salesforce) and ERP (SAP) product and productivity software.
* Strong can do and solution orientated focus.

**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**

* Zero ambiguity in supplier technical interfaces and requirements
* Early identification and resolution of integration risks
* Smooth, predictable execution across supplier\-dependent milestones
* Strong working relationships and trust established with key suppliers

 **Special Job Requirements:**

* Occupational exposure to radiation and other occupational hazards pertaining to the operation of a linear accelerator
* Standing, sitting, or stooping for extended periods of time.
* Periodic travel (domestic or international) as required by project milestones, with a focus on remote coordination where possible.

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision\-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work:** When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.


To find out more about Siemens Healthineers businesses, please visit our company page here.
