jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R\&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice\-of\-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.


This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross\-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.


This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy**

* Run structured voice\-of\-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
* Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
* Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

**Architecture and AI Deployment**

* Own end\-to\-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
* Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well\-governed capability that scales across divisions.
* Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
* Track adoption and usage post\-deployment, and course\-correct programs that aren't landing.

**Automation Program Execution**

* Lead program management for cross\-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
* Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
* Manage cross\-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

**Cross\-Functional Governance and Reporting**

* Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
* Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross\-program dependencies.
* Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10\+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R\&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
* Systems engineering background or hands\-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
* Experience running voice\-of\-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
* Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
* Experience running cross\-divisional or multi\-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems\-level and architecture workflows.
* Skilled at running voice\-of\-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
* Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
* Strong cross\-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

**Additional Details**


This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least September 22, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.
The full\-time equivalent pay range for this position is $179,931\.00 \- $315,300\.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Creative Ops
jobs.description:
**Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!**
---------------------------------------------


Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.


As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.


We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

**Role**
--------


We’re looking for a Senior Creative Operations Program Manager to lead large, high\-visibility campaigns across the Whatnot brand. This person will sit at the center of Creative, Marketing, and Catex teams, bringing structure to complex initiatives, aligning stakeholders, and keeping work moving from kickoff through launch. You’ll manage multiple priorities at once, anticipate risks, and ensure the team has the clarity and resources needed to deliver great creative work.


What You’ll Own:

* **Campaign program leadership.** Lead multiple complex, high\-visibility campaigns from kickoff through launch. Build clear project plans that align stakeholders around scope, milestones, owners, approvals, dependencies, and deliverables.
* **Prioritization and resourcing.** Partner with creative leadership to evaluate incoming requests, sequence work, and focus the team on the highest\-impact priorities. Maintain a clear view of capacity and flag when timelines, scope, or resources need to shift.
* **Cross\-functional alignment and decision\-making.** Bring Creative, Marketing, and partner teams together around shared goals and clear expectations. Lead working sessions and reviews that drive timely decisions, establish ownership, and keep work moving.
* **Communication and relationship building.** Build trust through clear, thoughtful communication tailored to different audiences. Navigate complex interpersonal dynamics with empathy and confidence while contributing to a collaborative, solutions\-oriented team culture.
* **Risk and dependency management.** Anticipate challenges, identify critical dependencies, and surface tradeoffs early. Resolve blockers before they put timelines, budgets, or creative quality at risk.
* **Creative operations and ways of working.** Build and refine practical workflows that make it easier for the team to collaborate and deliver great work. Introduce the right amount of structure without creating unnecessary process or slowing the team down.
* **Program visibility and measurement.** Create a clear view of what’s in flight, what’s at risk, and where decisions are needed. Define success, track progress and outcomes, and apply learnings to make future programs stronger.

 **We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in\-person time for planning, problem\-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our San Francisco, Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York City hubs.**

**You**
-------


People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they’re building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it.


For this role specifically, you should have:

* 6\+ years of experience in creative, marketing, or design program management, ideally at a high\-growth consumer company, marketplace, or creator\-focused platform. You’ve worked closely with Creative, Marketing, and GTM teams from early planning through final delivery.
* A track record of leading complex, integrated campaigns. You’ve successfully managed large\-scale brand initiatives with multiple workstreams, stakeholders, deliverables, and dependencies, bringing structure to the work without slowing it down.
* Strong creative production fluency. You understand how creative work moves from brief and concept through reviews, production, and launch. You know what teams need to do their best work and can build realistic timelines around the creative process.
* Exceptional prioritization and project management instincts. You can separate urgent from important, assess tradeoffs, and translate shifting priorities into a clear plan. You’re highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to keep several initiatives moving at once.
* Clear communication and strong relationship\-building skills. You can turn messy information, competing opinions, and complex blockers into clear recommendations.
* Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You operate independently, identify what needs to happen next, and move work forward without waiting for perfect direction. When a problem arises, you bring practical solutions—not just the problem.
* Operational and analytical judgment. You use data to identify issues, measure progress, and improve how teams work. You’re comfortable managing vendors and contractors and adapting project management, resourcing, and reporting tools to fit the team’s needs.

**Benefits**
------------

* Generous Holiday and Time off Policy
* Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision
* Work From Home Support


	+ Home office setup allowance
	+ Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet
* Care benefits


	+ Monthly allowance for wellness
	+ Annual allowance towards Childcare
	+ Lifetime benefit for family plannin

jobs.title: Landscape Architect / Project Manager
jobs.description:
Landscape Architect/Project Manager

This role is in\-office in San Francisco, with the option to work at home 1 day/week after a positive 6\-month review.

**About Fletcher Studio**

Fletcher Studio is an agile, close\-knit team working to create satisfying and sustainable landscapes, urban spaces, and living infrastructures. We believe design matters, and that people deserve to find value, meaning, and possibility in the places they encounter and occupy. We work with city makers, communities, and other visionaries to realize evocative and appropriate concepts, designed and constructed to ensure social vitality and integrity. We leverage technology to work faster and smarter—people, ideas, and culture drive our process. Our small studio offers opportunities for leadership and mentorship.

**About the Role**

This role of Landscape Architect / Project Manager is a new addition to the team. This position will lead complex landscape architecture projects from conceptual design through construction. jobs.description:

Our purpose – Opening up a world of opportunity – explains why we exist. Here at HSBC we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We’re bringing together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share.


This role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical implementation, and project delivery for HSBC’s client connectivity channels. You’ll design and deliver technically robust, secure, and scalable connectivity solutions for strategic corporate clients, leading complex onboarding and change initiatives across HSBCnet, APIs, SWIFT connectivity, and Host\-to\-Host (H2H)/file\-based connectivity.


You’ll run technical discovery and client workshops, convert business outcomes into technical designs, define testing and cutover approaches (including ISO 20022 formats and SWIFT migration considerations), and then drive end\-to\-end execution—removing blockers across client teams, Product, IT, Client Service and Coverage/Sales. The goal: faster time\-to\-revenue, high\-quality implementations, and smooth client experience.


As our Sr Project Manager, Client Connectivity\-Innovation Banking, you will:

* Own the end\-to\-end technical approach for client connectivity implementations, including architecture decisions, sequencing, and technical artefacts
* Lead technical client workshops to document current\-state processes and define target\-state automation across:
* + Accounts Payable, Receivables, Treasury, Payroll
	+ Bank statements and technical reconciliation
* Design connectivity solutions across:
* + APIs, SWIFT connectivity (connected banking patterns, security considerations, technical trade\-offs)
	+ H2H/file\-based connectivity (format management, transmission patterns, operational controls) and HSBCnet channel alignment as required
* Translate client requirements into clear technical deliverables (data mapping, message specifications, control points, exception handling)
* Document agreed solutions clearly, including statements of work, technical scope, assumptions, dependencies, and controls
* Lead practical implementation of ISO 20022 for payments and reporting message formats, including mapping, validation, and exception handling
* Ensure solution designs account for industry evolution, including SWIFT MT to MX migration impacts and de\-risking plans for corporate clients
* Support testing of payment and receivables files in industry\-accepted formats, coordinating across global stakeholders where required
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery: planning, execution and cutover, with a strong emphasis on technical risk control
* Partner closely with Project Management disciplines, while personally driving: Technical workstream governance, checkpoints, testing strategy, cutover planning along with critical care for customers post go live
* Identify technical blockers (format issues, mapping gaps, environment constraints) and drive resolution to protect timelines and outcomes
* Monitor post\-launch connectivity performance and stability; identify optimization opportunities and implement continuous improvements
* Provide pre\-mandate technical support for RFI/RFP responses and solution proposals; act as a consultative partner to Coverage/Sales
* Serve as liaison across Client Service, Sales/Coverage, Product and IT, aligning global/regional/country stakeholders on a single delivery path
* Act as a trusted advisor to client technology and treasury stakeholders—confidently leading workshops and senior stakeholder discussions


You´ll likely have the following skills to succeed in this role:

* Deep experience in client\-facing solutioning and technical delivery: solution architecture, implementation, or technical consulting within banking/payments/treasury/fintech
* Hands\-on delivery of connectivity implementations using H2H/file\-based and/or API\-based technical; able to clearly explain trade\-offs and fit\-for\-purpose recommendations
* Strong working knowledge of payments and connectivity, including:
	+ ACH, wires, real\-time/instant payments
	+ ISO 20022 standards and real delivery experience (mapping/testing/validation)
	
	SWIFT connectivity and ability to discuss MT+ MX migration impacts
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex workstreams and act as an escalation point, with strong stakeholder influence across business and technology teams
* Excellent communication skills—able to translate between technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders without losing accuracy
* Familiarity with client platforms and technical patterns:
	+ ERPs: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics
	+ TMS awareness: Kyriba, GTreasury, FIS Quantum, Integrity
* Experience supporting global or multi\-country client rollouts; comfort operating in multicultural teams and time zones
* Working knowledge of treasury operating models, centralization/standardization initiatives, and change management practices
* Comfortable with structured delivery and transparency via tools such as JIRA, MS Project, Confluence (or equivalents)

jobs.title: Digital Accessibility Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Please note:** We will consider both Hybrid and Remote candidates for this role.


The Digital Accessibility Program Manager serves as the operational and subject matter backbone to the Office of Digital Accessibility’s service delivery. This role owns the day\-to\-day functioning of the digital accessibility program in managing the service portfolio, conducting accessibility evaluations, ensuring the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of accessibility reviews from team members, engaging directly with campus clients on complex compliance challenges, and tracking program performance. The Digital Accessibility Program Manager reports to the Director for the Office of Digital Accessibility.


The ideal candidate brings both digital accessibility expertise and strong program management skills, serving as a critical bridge between technical staff and Stanford clients by translating findings, balancing competing priorities, and ensuring clients leave every engagement with clear, actionable guidance. They are equally comfortable guiding a campus web team through a remediation roadmap, reviewing an engineer's audit report for accuracy and completeness, and prioritizing and managing competing tasks with concurrent deadlines.


**Core Duties:**

**Program Management:**

* Manage the digital accessibility service intake pipeline by triaging incoming requests, assigning work, tracking progress, and ensuring reviews and consultations are completed on schedule.
* Coordinate with Office of Digital Accessibility staff on workload planning, deadline management, and service delivery priorities.
* Maintain quality standards for digital accessibility deliverables and consult with digital accessibility engineers on complex findings or edge cases requiring additional interpretation. Ensure findings are presented in a manner that is solution\-focused and actionable for both technical and non\-technical clients.
Oversee the interpretation, implementation and compliance with digital accessibility standards and regulations. Recommend actions and/or resolve complex issues with institutional partners that span organizational and university boundaries.  
* 

**Program Evaluation:**

* Evaluate how existing accessibility tools are offered and based on configuration, adoption, and use, if they are meeting program goals or when alternatives should be considered.
* Identify trends in accessibility issues across campus and surface insights that inform strategy and resource planning.
In coordination with the Director, track and maintain key performance indicators and program metrics, including service volume, review turnaround times, client satisfaction, remediation outcomes, and compliance trends.  
* 

**Planning and Analysis:**

* Under supervision of the Director, execute strategic plans for the Office of Digital Accessibility, leveraging subject matter expertise to meet regulatory and technical challenges for digital accessibility.
* Design and evolve the digital accessibility service delivery model, determining how core services (e.g., audit intake, remediation consultation, procurement review, training) are structured and delivered to improve client experiences.
Apply a creative mindset and bring the ability to think outside the box to create innovative service offerings.  
* 

**Client Management:**

* Advise clients on how accessibility requirements should be applied to specific vendor evaluations while balancing the intersection of technical standards, compliance obligations, and institutional constraints.
* Support clients on complex compliance requirements, including situations requiring creative or non\-standard solutions.
* Navigate difficult conversations with stakeholders who are resistant to or overwhelmed by accessibility requirements.
* Translate technical remediation findings into actionable guidance for non\-technical content owners, developers, and procurement staff.

  
**Core Duties** :


* Lead strategic planning and analysis for complex functions or programs with significant business, regulatory and/or technical challenges requiring subject matter expertise. May provide development of program or function from initial concept to implementation.
* Manage the administration and evaluation of programs or functions. Oversee the interpretation, implementation and compliance with policies and regulations. Recommend actions and/or resolve complex issues that often span organizational boundaries.
* Represent the program or function at the university level and/or to external/internal stakeholders and constituencies.
* Develop and manage outreach strategy that includes relationship development, communications, and compliance.
* Oversee or supervise staff in the development and implementation of programs or functions.
May develop and/or oversee budgets; manage finances including monitoring, analyzing, forecasting, and reporting.  
* 

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree and eight years of relevant experience, or combination of education and relevant experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to influence and motivate constituencies which could span multiple organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated excellent planning, organizational and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated ability to make sound business decisions using good business judgment and innovative and creative problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to manage financial, organizational and staff resources.
* Excellent interpersonal and communications skills with the ability to cultivate professional and business partnerships.
* Relevant subject matter expertise.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Launch Manager - Pharmaceuticals
jobs.description:
**Description**


**You’re driven, resourceful, and above all else – remarkably smart.**


In this role, you will support the development and execution of commercial readiness plans for new product launches. Working with our clients, you play an integral role working to support the launch planning and management efforts across a variety of assets, indications and geographies. The Launch Manager will assist established and emerging life science clients by being part of the team that brings a disciplined approach to help our customers commercialize their brands. You will:

* Facilitate regular launch readiness meetings with stakeholders, executive leadership and coordinate stakeholder support for these meetings. Communicate required tasks, updates and timelines.
* Develop a deep understanding of the market problems of various industry segments and user personas. Effectively position and communicate how the product features and the functionality create client\-based solutions.
* Track deliverables, it's risks and discrepancies across the cross\-functional launch team
* Actively support product and application launch activities including product positioning, promotional and pricing strategies, training and working with cross functional teams

**Essential Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, life science or other related field
* Minimum 2yrs experience with launch management or execution of launch (marketing, branding, project management)

**Desired Requirements:**

* PMI, CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Mgt) or PMP (Project Mgt. Professional)
* Experience in meeting facilitation and strong presentation skills


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $122,000 to $134,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, you're a part of the big picture. You will collaborate with colleagues across clinical and commercial disciplines to guide premarket development through post\-market commercial strategy. Every project is a chance to solve a new challenge, learn from your colleagues, and advance your career. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients' lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


Syneos Health has a voluntary COVID\-19 vaccination policy. We strongly encourage all employees to be fully vaccinated. Additionally, certain local governments or Syneos Health customers may have vaccine requirements that apply to some of our employees. These employees are required to submit proof of vaccination to Syneos Health and maintain compliance with these requirements.
  

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

jobs.description:
The application window will be open until at least September 29, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.  

  

Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

5 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer\-facing role.  
* 

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience supporting consumer or merchant\-facing e\-commerce, digital retail, visual search, or generative/agentic AI products.
* Strong investigative capabilities with proven experience translating unstructured feedback into actionable product recommendations.
* Demonstrated track record of managing competing priorities, leading cross\-functional alignment across PM/Eng/UX, and driving end\-to\-end launch readiness.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence executive cross\-functional stakeholders.

**About the job**
-----------------


We are part of Product Support Excellence within gUP (gTech Users and Products), dedicated to delivering exceptional service while advocating the consumer perspective for Google’s flagship commerce platforms. In this role, you will bridge the gap between billions of everyday shoppers and internal engineering teams, leveraging operational systems, active feedback loops, and cross\-functional partnerships to make online journeys more intuitive, helpful, and reliable.Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.  

  

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $114000 \- $163000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the dedicated support strategy lead and main point of contact for Shopping Product Management and Engineering partners across Shopping Creatives, Visual Content, and Agentic features.
* Define and execute launch readiness plans, issue taxonomy, operational workflows, and risk assessments for new shopping formats and Artificial Intelligence\-driven experiences.
* Monitor product uptake, track spikes in feedback, lead critical issue escalation management, and provide swift resolution for emerging user pain points.
* Transform raw feedback and operational data into user insights, influencing product roadmaps and feature iteration for visual shopping and agentic tools.

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. * Frequent interface with focused key OEM customers in providing turnkey manufacturing services
* Drive day to day operations in production planning, material readiness, shortage prevention, order fulfillment, quality control and new product development related topics, to ensure meeting forecast requirements, customer satisfaction and our business growth targets
* Coordinate tasks of a cross\-functional team from Sales, Production, product management, and Purchasing Departments to deliver outstanding products and issue solutions

* Analyze customer forecast demands and maintain corresponding material schedule plan to mitigate potential shortages and keep fast order fulfillments for sustaining products

* Proven track record of managing projects and delivering on time

* Excellent verbal and written communication and organizational skills. Advanced level in Excel and Power Point. Excellent presentation skills required. Experience with ERP system (SAP) preferred


* Demonstrated ability to take initiative, develop and implement new processes

In\-office collaboration and participation in team meetings, training sessions, and other on\-site activities are essential aspects of this role. Candidates should consider the commuting distance and be prepared to fulfill their responsibilities in the designated office location.

----------------


$120,000 \- $154,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. jobs.title: Project Manager 2
jobs.description:
Convergint is looking for a full\-time, enthusiastic, results driven and forward\-thinking Project Manager to join our amazing culture. In this role, you will ensure that projects are effectively executed within budgeted cost and time schedules while ensuring positive cash flow. This is a customer\-facing role, and is responsible for maximizing customer satisfaction, safety, and quality assurance on all assigned projects. As a Project Manager, you are a part of a dynamic team that allows you to grow as Convergint grows.

  


**For information about how we use your personal information, please see our Colleague \& Applicant Privacy Notice, available on convergint.com/careers.**

  




**Who You Are**



You have a passion for providing world\-class service to customers, colleagues and communities. You are a person of integrity with a commitment to growth, accountability and delivering results. You want to join an organization with a positive culture that embraces equal opportunity and allows everyone to be the best version of themselves at work and home. You want to grow with us and deliver results as an exceptional Project Manager.

  


**Who We Are**



With 20\-years of proven growth and exceptional performance, our mission is to be our customer’s best service provider. We realize the importance of diversity in achieving that goal. Our company was built upon a solid foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs which drive our unmatched culture, making us the \#1 global, serviced\-based systems integrator in the industry. We take great pride in protecting the lives and assets of our customers and their communities with the solutions we provide.

  


**What you’ll do with “Our Training and Your Experience”**


* Convergint's greatest strength is our people! Every colleague is encouraged to participate in our Recruit Awesome People program, helping us grow Convergint by promoting our colleague\-first culture and referring top talent to the Talent Acquisition Team and hiring managers.
* Manage, oversee, and coordinate many aspects for small to medium projects of moderate complexity from award through completion of project.
* Translate a variety of customer needs / requirements into detailed proposals and project implementation plans to meet Customer requirements.
* Effectively communicate project requirements to project team and wider organization as and when required and maintains accurate and up to date records of job status, job changes, material flow and other control records necessary for processing of internal and external reports.
* Acts as “our customer’s best service provider” at all times thereby ensuring Convergint Technologies is the customer’s first choice for service.
* Coordinate the procurement of materials, supplies, services, and controls necessary for timely and cost\-effective completion of project within budget.
* Establish project milestones and analyze costs.
* May perform limited range of managerial responsibilities and oversee subcontractor selection process and work.

  


**What You’ll Need**


* Project management experience in a technical environment (building automation systems, fire alarm systems, and/or electronic security systems).
* Initiative – engages in proactive behavior and looks for opportunities and solutions.
* Strong analytical skills necessary to resolve problems and look for solutions, solid conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to facilitate a collaborative working environment for customers and team members.
* Extreme adaptability; respond effectively to changes in situation or information; ability to influence others and build consensus using advanced written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and staff development skills; solid leadership orientation. Actively seeks ways in which to act as a role model, guide, develop and mentor others within the organization.
* Strong financial analytical skills including cost control.
* Solid team leadership, team building and facilitation skills.
* Experience managing client relationships / communications.
* A valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

  


**Company Benefits**



Convergint fosters a supportive, accessible, and inclusive environment in which all individuals are able to realize their maximum potential within the company. We offer a variety of programs and exceptional benefits:


* 10 Company Holidays and Paid Time Off starting at 13 days annually
* Fun \& Laughter Day Off
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Plan
* Life insurance \& Disability Plan
* Wellness Program
* 401K Matching Plan
* Colleague Assistance Program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Competitive salary and compensation plan
* Vehicle reimbursement plan or company vehicle
* Corporate Social Responsibility Day
* Cell phone reimbursement (if applicable)
* Paid parental leave

  


**Requirements:**



Education: College degree, trade school or equivalent experience



Minimum Experience: 5\-7 years project management



Preferred Experience (but not required):


* 5 years relevant engineering, field service or project management
* Experience in 1 or more of the following industries: electronic, fire alarm \& life safety, and/or building automation
* Certifications \& Licenses: Project Management Institute (PMI); industry\-specific certifications and/or licenses

  



The expected compensation range for this position is between $105,000 \- $150,000 annually, depending on experience.

If the position is posted in multiple locations or is a remote position, the salary range may vary. jobs.title: EHR Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
GeneDx (Nasdaq: WGS) delivers personalized and actionable health insights to inform diagnosis, direct treatment, and improve drug discovery. The company is uniquely positioned to accelerate the use of genomic and large\-scale clinical information to enable precision medicine as the standard of care. GeneDx is at the forefront of transforming healthcare through its industry\-leading exome and genome testing and interpretation services, fueled by the world's largest, rare disease data sets. For more information, please visit www.genedx.com.


**Summary**



The EHR Implementation Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering large, cross\-functional programs that align with the company's strategic goals. This role ensures that multiple related projects stay on track, achieve broader business objectives, and drive organizational vision. The EHR Implementation Manager serves as a central point of alignment across internal and external stakeholders, managing resources, timelines, and risk to deliver program\-wide success.


**Job Responsibilities**


* Program Leadership: Oversee the entire program lifecycle, from inception to completion, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and company vision.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary liaison across internal and external teams to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned and working toward common goals.
* Alignment and Planning: Develop program strategies in collaboration with senior leadership and define a roadmap for success with clear milestones.
* Risk and Issue Mitigation: Proactively identify and mitigate risks to ensure seamless progress, addressing roadblocks before they impact program outcomes.
* Resource Management: Coordinate resource allocation across projects to maximize efficiency and maintain balance across the program.
* Stakeholder Communication: Keep all relevant stakeholders informed of program progress, changes, and risks through regular updates and communication.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements across program operations, ensuring that best practices are followed and lessons learned are applied.


 **People Manager**


* No


**Education, Experience, and Skills**


* Bachelor's degree in business, Life Sciences, Engineering or a related field.
* Extensive experience (5\+ years) in program and project management, with a focus on cross\-functional collaboration.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Demonstrated experience in implementing project management software.
* Familiarity with Epic, Aura, Cerner, eClinicalWorks, and other Electronic Health Record platforms.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication including an ability to communicate effectively at an executive level.
* Ability to work collaboratively across distributed workforce.
* Possesses significant practical experience in project management (project planning, resource planning, issue management, risk management, change management, communication planning).
* Excellent organizational skills and capable of setting priorities and a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time, on budget and within scope.
* Proven accomplishment as a driver of multiple projects running concurrently.
* Exhibit good judgment skills on when to seek guidance and when to escalate risks and issues.

  


**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**


* Epic certifications are desirable but not required


**Work Environment**



This is a fully remote position. The employee will work from a home office or other suitable remote location with reliable high\-speed internet access. Work is performed in a climate\-controlled environment using standard office equipment including computer, phone, and video conferencing tools. Your standard work schedule and hours will be established in collaboration with your leader and may be adjusted to align with evolving business needs.

At GeneDx, we're driven by urgency and purpose: helping patients get diagnosed earlier. Our mission, to empower everyone to live their healthiest life through genomics, drives our team to make a tangible impact each day – and shapes our culture where high standards, strong teamwork, and meaningful ownership are the norm. We act with intention, support one another, and deliver work we're proud to put our names on.

1\. Play like a champion (step up, redefine what's possible, own it)


We bring energy, focus, and a bias for action. We step up, take initiative, and deliver on our commitments – with quality, speed, and care.  

  

  



2\. Think bigger (stretch beyond, courage not consensus)
We push past the obvious. We challenge assumptions, raise the bar, and make thoughtful, decisive calls — choosing progress over perfection.  

  

  



3\. Grow fast (be curious, speak up, be agile)
We stay curious, ask questions, and share direct feedback with respect. We adapt quickly and keep learning through collaboration and continuous improvement.
  

  

If you're motivated by meaningful work, a fast\-moving environment, and teammates who care deeply about outcomes, you'll thrive at GeneDx.



At GeneDx, we believe in taking care of our people. We provide competitive compensation and benefits that reflect local market practices and legal requirements in each country where we operate, helping employees thrive both professionally and personally.

We welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

**Position Summary:** 

The Document Quality Manager is responsible for overseeing the quality control and quality assurance of as\-built documentation and closeout deliverables for construction of utility infrastructure projects. This role ensures all documentation accurately reflects final project conditions, meets contractual requirements, and complies with company and client processes and standards. The manager leads a team of Document Quality specialists and coordinates closely with project management, clients, and field teams to ensure timely and accurate project closeout, including electronic filing and records management within company systems.

**As\-Built Documentation Review**

* Lead the comprehensive review of as\-built drawings, redlines, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment with final installed conditions.
* Verify completeness and consistency across engineering drawings, specifications, and field documentation.
* Ensure updates from field changes, RFIs, change orders, and design revisions are properly incorporated into final as\-built records.
* Identify discrepancies or missing information and coordinate with engineering, field teams, or subcontractors to resolve issues.
* Promote and foster continuous process improvement to meet or exceed internal and external quality targets

**Closeout Documentation \& Data Analysis**

* Manage the collection, review, and validation of project data shared by the client.
* Analyze close\-out\-phase documentation to identify gaps, trends, and compliance issues prior to final project handover.

**Governance, Quality Assurance \& Process Management**

* Develop and maintain documentation review procedures, checklists, and quality standards for as\-built and closeout documentation.
* Implement quality control workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Conduct internal quality audits of documentation prior to client delivery.
* Track documentation status, completeness metrics, and closeout readiness.
* Oversee electronic documentation management in compliance with retention policies.
* Facilitate and ensure alignment between internal vs external quality control standards in a dynamic working environment.

**Team Leadership**

* Supervise, mentor, and coordinate the work of a team of four document control specialists.
* Assign review tasks, monitor progress, and ensure deadlines for project closeout milestones are met.
* Provide training on documentation standards, systems, and quality procedures.
* Foster a collaborative and detail\-oriented team environment.
* Collaborate closely with internal field leadership to resolve documentation issues, report outcomes, identify solutions and drive increased collaboration across groups.

* Strong leadership, coaching and workload prioritization abilities.
* Proficiency with document management systems and project documentation tools.

jobs.description:
ABOUT RITTER CENTER:


For over 40 years, Ritter Center has been dedicated to preventing and resolving homelessness and improving the health, dignity, and well\-being of people living in poverty in Marin.


When you join Ritter Center, you join a highly trained staff that combines national clinical best practices with a whole\-person care approach to solving each person’s medical and mental health, housing, and food needs.


We are growing to meet the needs of our community. We are looking for staff who are ready for a career with a mission\-driven organization, want to be valued, have diverse experience, and have compassion. If this sounds like you, we would love to have you join us!


\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**CURRENT OPENING:**

**Housing Case Manager**

**Full\-time (40 hours weekly), Non\-Exempt position**.

**Hourly Compensation:** **$29\.40 per hour**

**All positions at Ritter Center require a background check and Livescan fingerprinting.**

 **Please visit our jobs page on our** **website** **for a complete list of our employee benefits.**  

  

Ritter Center is currently recruiting a Housing Case Manager for our Whole Person Care Case Management Team. This full\-time, non\-exempt position reports to the Whole Person Care Program Manager, based in San Rafael, CA.

***Please find the full job description below.***

**Position** **Description:**


This is a professional\-level position requiring a high level of responsibility, knowledge, and ability in coordinating and providing services to clients with complex needs. A good fit for this position is able to think on their feet and quickly assess the needs of chronically homeless people with the help of a multidisciplinary team. The WPC Case Manager provides case management, counseling, and advocacy services to these individuals and families who are extremely low\-income with a variety of barriers to permanent housing, which may include mental illness, chronic illness, and physical disabilities.


Under supervision, the Case Manager will provide flexible support services to program participants to assist in securing housing in the community and coordinating health care needs. Other responsibilities include outreach, mental health assessments, screening for eligibility, development of comprehensive care plans, and preparation of reports and clinical case notes for WPC reimbursement. Through the coordination of services and partnerships with local agencies, participating clients will receive help in obtaining needed supportive services such as mental health services, In\-Home Support Services, educational or vocational counseling, assistance to maintain benefits through Medi\-cal, SSI, and any other entitlement or benefit programs they may qualify for.

**Essential** **Job Functions** **and** **Responsibilities:**

* Engages and works with chronically homeless individuals and families with severe and persistent mental illness, physical disabilities and/or a history of substance use, a history of chronic homelessness, and/or terminal illness.
* Interviews clients while using clinical skills to evaluate and determine the extent of social service needs for each individual client.
* Conduct assessments with individuals to determine their psychiatric and psychological needs. Monitors health issues, makes appropriate medical referrals, and coordinates medical care as needed.
* Functions as a part of an inter\-agency multidisciplinary team, making referrals to other community resources for services and coordinating services with other social services and support agencies.
* Contacts public social welfare and mental health agencies to obtain and provide information to program participants.
* Acts as an advocate for the client. Assisting participants with locating appropriate housing, assisting with the move\-in process, helping participants obtain needed household items, and other tasks that help participants maintain a supportive housing environment.
* Provides mediation and advocacy for participants between the landlord and surrounding community members.
* Provides assistance with daily living tasks such as money management, shopping, and cooking as needed while assessing for needed assistance with Activities of Daily Living.
* Works with participants to obtain and maintain entitlements; develops ongoing consultation with participants' family members, case managers, and other care providers; makes timely referrals to supportive services and intervenes to avert crises.
* Coordinates and provides flexible support services and skills training to participants once they are housed, with the objective of helping them to stay housed and to achieve the goals set forth in their coordinated case plan.
* Assists the CE Coordinator and Outreach Team with outreach activities toward eligible homeless persons.
* Writes reports and performs daily WPC charting and billing; collects data for the purposes of program administration and monitoring using ECM and Wizard. Meets with clients a minimum of three times a month.
* Prepares and maintains casework records, court and other evaluative reports and relevant correspondence; maintains accurate case notes and related records and files.
* Creates comprehensive care plans for each client and inputs them into the WPC database

jobs.title: Quality Assurance/Quality Control Specialist
jobs.description:
Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Specialist

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing / Precision Manufacturing  
**Department:** Quality  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and hands\-on **Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Specialist** to join our semiconductor equipment manufacturing team.

The QA/QC Specialist will be responsible for inspecting incoming, in\-process, and finished components to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, customer specifications, and internal quality standards. This position will also support quality documentation, non\-conformance management, corrective actions, supplier quality, and continuous improvement activities.

The ideal candidate has experience in **precision machining, semiconductor equipment, or high\-precision manufacturing** and is comfortable working with engineering drawings, inspection equipment, and quality documentation.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform **incoming, in\-process, and final inspections** of precision machined parts, fabricated components, assemblies, and purchased materials.
* Inspect parts according to **engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances, and customer requirements**.
* Use inspection and measurement equipment such as **calipers, micrometers, height gauges, pin gauges, thread gauges, surface roughness testers, optical measurement systems, and CMM equipment**, as applicable.
* Review and interpret **engineering drawings, GD\&T, dimensions, tolerances, surface finish requirements, and inspection criteria**.
* Verify material certifications, inspection reports, Certificates of Conformance (CoC), and other supplier quality documentation.
* Document inspection results accurately and maintain complete, traceable quality records.
* Identify, document, and control **non\-conforming materials and products**.
* Generate and manage **Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs)** and coordinate disposition with Engineering, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and other departments.
* Assist with **root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA)** for internal, supplier, and customer quality issues.
* Support supplier quality activities, including communicating quality issues, reviewing corrective actions, and monitoring supplier performance.
* Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve dimensional, workmanship, documentation, and manufacturing quality issues.
* Support customer quality requirements and assist with customer complaints, returns, and corrective action requests when necessary.
* Ensure inspection tools and measurement equipment are properly maintained and within calibration.
* Assist with maintaining and improving quality procedures, inspection instructions, forms, and work instructions.
* Support internal and external quality audits as required.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts to reduce defects, rework, scrap, and recurring quality issues.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and controlled inspection/work area.
* Perform other quality\-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical field is preferred.
* **2\+ years of QA/QC or inspection experience** in semiconductor equipment, precision machining, aerospace, medical device, or another high\-precision manufacturing environment preferred.
* Experience inspecting **CNC machined components and precision mechanical parts** is highly preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret **mechanical drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and GD\&T**.
* Hands\-on experience using precision measurement and inspection tools.
* Understanding of **quality inspection processes, NCRs, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and document control**.
* Familiarity with **ISO 9001 or similar Quality Management Systems (QMS)** is preferred.
* Experience with CMM inspection is a plus.
* Knowledge of semiconductor equipment manufacturing requirements, cleanliness standards, surface finish requirements, and precision components is a plus.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and general computer systems.
* Strong attention to detail with excellent documentation and organizational skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate quality concerns professionally with suppliers, customers, engineers, and production personnel.
* Ability to prioritize multiple inspections and quality issues in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, and Management.

Preferred Skills

* Semiconductor equipment or semiconductor industry experience
* CNC machining / precision machining knowledge
* GD\&T
* CMM inspection
* First Article Inspection (FAI)
* Incoming Quality Control (IQC)
* In\-Process Quality Control (IPQC)
* Final Quality Control (FQC)
* Supplier Quality
* NCR / MRB management
* Root Cause Analysis
* CAPA / Corrective Action
* 5 Why / Fishbone analysis
* ISO 9001
* Calibration management
* Inspection report preparation
* Blueprint / engineering drawing interpretation

Physical Requirements

* Ability to stand and work in an inspection/manufacturing environment for extended periods.
* Ability to safely handle and inspect mechanical components of various sizes.
* Ability to lift up to **30 lbs.** as needed.
* Ability to visually inspect precision components and use measurement equipment accurately.

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation based on experience
* Health, dental, and vision benefits
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement
* Hands\-on experience in the semiconductor equipment manufacturing industry
* Collaborative environment working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987\. Overview:
**Position**: Operations Leadership Development Program Associate

**Locations:** California (Milpitas, San Diego), USA or Maryland (Sparks), USA.

**Program Length**: 3 Years (Full\-Time, Permanent; Final Placement Upon Completion)

 **Overview:**


Are you ready to launch your career in Global Operations with a world\-class organization that focuses on accelerating the benefits of pioneering science to improve human health and well\-being? Our Operations Leadership Development Program (OLDP) is a dynamic three\-year development opportunity designed to cultivate the next generation of operations leaders. Based in California, USA or Maryland, USA, this immersive program offers cross\-functional training and hands\-on experience within a global life sciences organization.


Over the course of four, nine\-month rotations, you will gain hands\-on experience across our key capabilities within operations. Each rotation is designed to build critical skills, provide global exposure, and develop your leadership capabilities through mentorship and real\-workplace challenges. One rotation will also include the opportunity to lead and supervise a team. Upon successful completion of the program, you will transition into a full\-time leadership role aligned with your strengths and business needs.


Responsibilities:
**Three\-Year Rotational departments could include, but** **are** **not limited to:**

* Supply Chain
* Procurement
* Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical \& Industrial)
* Manufacturing Operations
* Chemical Manufacturing Operations
* Consumables
* Instrumentation
* Informatics
* Continuous Improvement / Lean Six Sigma / Operational Excellence
* Quality Assurance
* Environmental, Health \& Safety

 **Program Highlights:**

* Global Exposure: Work with cross\-functional teams and gain insight into international operations
* Foundational Experience: A broad, foundational understanding of global operations in a high\-impact industry
* Professional Development \& Networking: Gain leadership coaching, people management and technical skills training, project management experience and opportunities to connect with senior leaders.
* A pathway to a meaningful, full\-time career with long\-term advancement potential
* Working in a state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facility
* Final Placement: A full\-time position upon successful completion of the program
* Competitive Salary \& Benefits


Qualifications:

* Upcoming graduates with a passion for innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Problem solvers with strong analytical and project management skills
* Strong communicators with written, verbal and presentation skills
* Leaders who are self\-motivated, work well independently as well as part of a team, and have a strong attention to detail.
* Individuals who are open to geographic mobility and excited about opportunities to grow within different regions or markets.

 **Qualifications:**

* Minimum Requirement: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical \& Industrial)
* Internship or Co\-Op experience in relevant coursework
* Commitment to the full 3\-year program

The Operations Leadership Development Program is set to begin June 21st, 2027\.

jobs.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------


Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US\-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co\-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time\-to\-market with single\-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co\-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.  



  

  

Supply Chain Inventory Risk PM: function is responsible for activities related to controlling, scheduling, and managing the flow of production from acquisition of raw materials to distribution of finished product. Areas include purchasing of materials, logistics, distribution, inventory management, warehousing, and transportation. The Materials area is responsible for developing and implementing policies, procedures and material control systems activities related to material control and inventory control functions. Ensures materials are ordered and in stock while maintaining acceptable inventory levels. Develops material schedules and coordinates the efficient movement of materials with purchasing, production and engineering. The Multi\-Focus attribute is typically reserved for roles that either: (1\) are fully described by their area or function description; or (2\) span multiple disciplines, products, or focuses of expertise. This job family is in the professional level category and works independently with flexibility and authority over daily work priorities. Incumbents in this job level category may provide work direction to other employees but would not typically have the authority to discipline or reward other employees. There are different levels available that provide clarity on contribution expectations based on knowledge, application, problem solving, and


collaboration.


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail\-oriented Inventory Risk Management Project Manager (PM) to join our team in Fremont, CA. In this individual contributor role, you will be responsible for executing strategies that safeguard our high\-velocity hardware manufacturing pipeline by balancing supply availability with financial exposure. You will analyze data, manage day\-to\-day risk mitigation processes for overstocking and obsolete components, and support global supply, capacity, and utilization tracking within Hyve manufacturing facilities. A core focus of this role is serving as the primary operational bridge between internal planning teams and key hyperscale clients to track and ensure precise stock consumption.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Alignment Execution: Manage end\-to\-end demand consumption validation and tracking. Partner directly with tier\-one hyperscale client counterparts to reconcile actual material pull against forecasted pipelines.
Supply Chain Coordination: Collaborate cross\-functionally with the supply chain planning team to track material availability, maintain Clear\-to\-Build (CTB) tracking, and coordinate pull\-in/push\-out logistics to support manufacturing capacity.
Risk \& Exposure Analysis: Execute the framework for quantifying financial exposure. Monitor and report on excess and obsolete (E\&O) inventory, material liabilities, and aging stock.
Variance \& Data Tracking: Conduct detailed assessments and reconciliations of material consumption variances across multi\-phase, high\-value manufacturing runs to ensure data integrity and accountability.
Operational Reporting: Compile and analyze inventory health metrics, consumption trajectories, and risk\-mitigation data for presentation to internal stakeholders and client teams.
Qualifications
Experience: 3–5 years of project management or analytical experience in supply chain, inventory management, or hardware manufacturing.
Skills: Strong proficiency in data analysis, Excel, ERP systems, and Clear\-to\-Build (CTB) methodologies.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.

Position Summary:

The Knowledge Base Program Manager is responsible for leading the management, optimization, and governance of Technology Credit Union’s (Tech CU) enterprise knowledge ecosystem, including Tech CU’s Knowledge Hub. This role partners closely with business units, subject‑matter experts, leadership, and cross\-functional partners to design and employ scalable content governance practices, manage content workflows, strengthen taxonomy and search effectiveness, maintain a unified organizational voice, and leverage knowledge base analytics and AI capabilities to continuously optimize Tech CU’s knowledge management program. The incumbent is equal parts content strategist, systems administrator, process designer, and program manager.


Responsibilities:
**Essential Duties**

  



Knowledge Hub Program Management

* Serves as the program manager for Tech CU’s Knowledge Hub, including configuration, content lifecycle management, and user permissions.
* Designs and maintains the structure, taxonomy, metadata, and search optimization within the platform.
* Monitors system performance, usage patterns, and analytics to ensure the knowledge base remains accurate, accessible, and effective.
* Establishes annual priorities, maturity goals, and adoption plans.
* Aligns knowledge initiatives with operational, service, compliance, and training goals.
* Promotes a knowledge\-sharing culture across the organization.


Content Governance \& Workflow Design* Partners with business areas to design, implement, and maintain content review and approval workflows that ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely updates.

Content Quality \& Unified Voice* Ensures all knowledge articles follow a consistent tone, structure, and voice across the organization.
