Knowledge Gap Identification \& Optimization* Uses analytics, AI insights, and reporting tools to identify knowledge gaps, outdated content, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborates with business partners to prioritize and close gaps through new or updated content.
* Tracks the impact of knowledge improvements on customer experience, operational efficiency, and agent performance.


Cross‑Functional Collaboration* Chairs or facilitates a cross\-functional governance forum.
* Advises business leaders and process owners on knowledge management best practices.
* Works closely with customer service, operations, product, compliance, risk, technology, and training teams to ensure the knowledge base supports organizational goals.
* Facilitates workshops, training sessions, and onboarding for new contributors and reviewers.
* Acts as the internal advocate for knowledge management best practices.

**Work Schedule**

* Full\-time; typically 40\+ hours/week.
* Flexible within core business hours, Pacific Time, M\-F.
* Occasional extended early morning or late evening hours, and weekends, typically with advance notice.

**Workplace Essentials**

* Supports Tech CU’s *Mission and Vision* and consistently demonstrates Tech CU’s Values (Accelerate, Collaborate, Innovate and Cultivate).
* Meets with manager on a regular basis to discuss goal alignment, performance metrics, and development plans.
* Complies with Tech CU policies and procedures.
* Upholds employee Code of Conduct and Business Ethics and ensures confidentiality of the workplace.
* Complies with requirements imposed by federal, state, and local regulatory agencies.
* Adheres to internal control and security measures designed to ensure regulatory compliance and mitigate losses and errors.


Qualifications:
**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or related area (or equivalent experience).

 **Experience:*** 5\+ years of experience in knowledge management, process management, content management, technical writing, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience leading an enterprise knowledge, process governance, or cross\-functional improvement initiatives.
* 3\+ years of experience managing an enterprise knowledge platform and developing or managing content review and approval workflows across multiple business units. Experience with eGain Knowledge Hub is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience using analytics or reporting tools to identify knowledge gaps, optimize content, and improve user experience. Experience influencing stakeholders and establishing standards across multiple departments.
* Experience supporting customer\-facing or contact\-center environments is strongly preferred.
* Prior experience in regulated environments, financial services, or credit unions is preferred.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Demonstrated ability to lead enterprise programs, design governance frameworks, and influence stakeholders across business areas without direct authority.
* Proficiency in process mapping, change management, and continuous improvement, with demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical knowledge and process standards.
* Advanced knowledge of knowledge management principles and practices, including taxonomy, metadata, information architecture, and content lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in administering enterprise knowledge platforms, including configuration, content architecture, workflow administration, and permissions
* Demonstrated ability to define KPIs, interpret performance reporting, and translate findings into measurable improvements.
* Working knowledge of AI\-enabled knowledge capabilities, search optimization, risk

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Creator Economy runs on two things creators can't get a straight answer on: what their content is actually earning across platforms, and when that money lands in their account. We're solving both.

Over 1\.2 million Creators across 50\+ countries rely on ChannelMeter for the data behind their business—performance and monetization reporting across platforms beyond YouTube—and for the payments infrastructure that turns that data into money in their bank account. We've processed $1\.8B\+ in payments for Creator Networks, agencies, IP distributors, and global brands, and the analytics layer underneath is just as core to what we do as the payment rails.

The market is heading toward $500B by 2027, and most of the infrastructure to support it—on the data side and the money side—doesn't exist yet. We're building it, and we need someone who can speak fluently to both halves of that problem for every customer who depends on us.

**Why this role exists**

Our customers don't show up with one kind of question. One week it's "why does my YouTube monetization number look off," the next it's "where's my payment," and often it's both at once, tangled together. This isn't a check\-in\-once\-a\-quarter role—you'll be embedded in how our customers understand their own data and their own money, spotting risk before it becomes churn and opportunity before anyone has to ask for it. And you'll do it with AI as a core part of how you work, not an add\-on: Claude, Codex, and Claude Cowork are expected tools here, not optional ones.

**What you'll own**

**Own the full customer relationship**

\- Guide customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion, building trust with everyone from day\-to\-day operators to economic buyers

\- Manage a tiered portfolio—hands\-on for our largest Creator Networks and agencies, and scalable playbooks (lifecycle campaigns, in\-product prompts, proactive outreach) for the rest, so growth doesn't just mean more headcount

**Be fluent in the data, not just the money**

\- Help customers interpret their own performance and monetization data—including YouTube monetization trends—as confidently as they'd want a finance person to explain a payment

\- Spot data anomalies (a channel's reported earnings not matching what a customer expects) before they turn into a support escalation or a trust problem

\- Track account health against a mix of signals—retention, expansion, NPS/sentiment, and data/usage patterns—not payment metrics alone

**Turn signals into action**

\- Partner with Risk and Finance on underwriting\-adjacent questions and payment escalations, and with Data and Product on reporting or monetization discrepancies—most real issues touch both

\- Feed what you're hearing from customers back into Product in a structured way, not just as one\-off tickets

**Build the playbook as you go**

\- Use your AI toolkit daily—prep for calls, draft QBRs, summarize account history, and flag risk patterns before they surface

\- Keep a tight, structured pipeline in your task management system—every commitment and renewal date owned, nothing left to memory

\- Help define what great customer success looks like at ChannelMeter as we build out the function

**Who you are**

\- 3–5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer\-facing SaaS/B2B role

\- Already fluent with AI tools like Claude, Codex, or Cowork in your daily workflow—this is the single biggest predictor of success here

\- Comfortable being the translator between a data/analytics question and a payments/financial one—most accounts touch both, often in the same conversation

\- A clear, concise writer who simplifies complex things instead of complicating simple ones

\- Obsessively organized, with the kind of follow\-through that catches what everyone else missed

\- Genuinely curious about the Creator Economy—how creators actually make money across platforms, not just how they get paid

**Nice to have**

\- Experience with creator or content analytics, multi\-channel network (MCN) tools, or platform monetization systems (YouTube or otherwise)

\- Experience in payments, fintech, or financial operations

\- Time spent in the Creator Economy—platform, agency, brand, or enterprise side

\- Startup experience where you had to build the process, not just follow one

**The fine print**

\- Based in the SF Bay Area or Los Angeles, available to come into the office regularly

\- Authorized to work in the US—we can't sponsor visas or support relocation for this role

\- Comfortable demonstrating your AI workflow as part of the interview process

**What success looks like**

In your first 60 days: you've met every account in your portfolio and can speak to both the data and the money behind your top accounts accurately, you've got a first pass at a health\-tracking system in place, and your task pipeline is fully stood up.

By 6 months: retention and expansion in your book are trending up, Product and Data are getting structured, regular signal from your accounts, and the playbooks you've built are ones a future hire could pick up and run with.

**Compensation**

\- Base: $55,000–$85,000 USD

\- Commission on top of base—$85K–$125K OTE

\- Health benefits, unlimited PTO, team offsites, and flexible work arrangements

**How we hire**

We move quickly and respect your time. Most candidates wrap up in 2–3 weeks:

1\. Intro call (30 min)

2\. Team interview (45 min)

3\. Short take\-home exercise (AI tools expected, not just encouraged)

4\. Presentation \& discussion

5\. Leadership conversations

6\. References \& offer

**Apply**

Send your resume or LinkedIn to jobs@channelmeter.com. Tell us your favorite Creator, and one specific way you've used data or AI to improve a customer outcome.

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Senior Digital Customer Success Manager - Americas
jobs.description:
#### **About the Job:**



The Digital Led Customer Success Manager reports directly to the regional CS leader and represents LaunchDarkly as the direct point\-of\-contact with our customers post\-sales. They are LaunchDarkly subject\-matter experts, guiding our new and existing customers through implementation and adoption with a heavy focus on 1:many outreach tactics and leveraging data to engage with the right customers at the right time. This is a relatively new team at LaunchDarkly, and the best candidate for this role will have a passion for customer success, experience leveraging data to manage a large customer portfolio, and an interest in helping to build a best\-in\-class Digital Led CS organization while executing at a high level.


#### **Responsibilities:**


* **Customer Onboarding:** Leverage customer journey data to understand which customers need additional support through onboarding. Drive them to 1:many marketing engagements or work with them 1:1 to ensure all customers in your portfolio are onboarded and activated correctly.
* **Risk Identification and Mitigation:** Use data and product signals to proactively identify risks. Develop both 1:many and 1:1 risk mitigation strategies and coordinate across the account team to steer customers towards success.
* **Technical Guidance:** Maintain a deep level of LaunchDarkly product knowledge and provide customers with direction on implementation and adoption best practices.
* **Prescriptive Selling:** Monitor how customers are tracking against their key goals and outcomes. Identify opportunities for customers to purchase additional products, services, and adopt new features to maximize the value of our solution.
* **Trusted Advisor:** Build trust quickly and provide prescriptive guidance to help customers get the most out of their LaunchDarkly purchase.
* **Build Champions \& Executive Relationships:** Identify and support key advocates within customer organizations who actively promote the value of LaunchDarkly. Leverage success metrics and value\-driven insights to gain executive sponsorship in partnership with your Champion.

**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.


### **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**



Our Customer Success team powers long\-term customer value and growth across the West region. We're hiring Customer Success Managers based in San Francisco or Redwood City to own a book of SMB accounts, drive adoption, and partner with customers to deliver measurable outcomes. You'll bring operational rigor, a growth mindset, and strong relationship skills to help our customers realize the full value of Box.



In this role, you will manage a curated portfolio with flexibility to travel for high\-impact onsite moments. You'll collaborate across teams, lead value\-focused demos, and turn insights into action that increases retention and expansion.


### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**



We are an AI\-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.


* Own a book of West region SMB accounts and build trusted partnerships that drive adoption, renewal, and growth.
* Lead discovery, value reviews, and product demos that tie business goals to clear outcomes.
* Maintain operational rigor across systems—forecast renewals, track health, and prioritize actions based on signals.
* Build account plans, identify risks/opportunities, and execute proactive playbooks to improve customer value.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to remove roadblocks and deliver solutions that matter.
* Prioritize customer meetings (virtual and onsite as needed) to accelerate impact across your territory.
* Surface insights from your portfolio to influence territory planning and process improvements.
* Champion a growth mindset and experiment with AI\-enabled workflows to scale customer success.

### **WHO YOU ARE**


* 2\+ years of customer success, account management, or related client\-facing experience managing a book of business.
* Proven track record of ownership and proactive problem\-solving that led to measurable customer outcomes.
* Strong relationship management and communication skills; comfortable leading demos and executive conversations.
* Operationally rigorous with experience navigating business systems for forecasting and health tracking.
* Growth\-minded, coachable, and adaptable; excited to learn and leverage AI to improve workflows.
* Comfortable managing a mixed SMB portfolio, prioritizing impact across multiple accounts.
* Hybrid: Based in San Francisco or Redwood City with 3 days/week in\-office; travel within the West region as needed.

Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.



At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**



We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. * We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare\-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.
* Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 7,000\+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 20x in the past 12 months.
* We operate thousands of bare\-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 100k\+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte\-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.
* We’ve raised $58\.5M from Seed to Series B, led by Google Ventures (GV) \& Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.
* Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.
* We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.

  

As Office Manager, you will own the day to day operations and workplace experience for the Blacksmith San Francisco office.


This is a crucial role. We are an in\-person team and we want everyone to enjoy the environment they work in. Your role will deliver an experience that means people want to come in, and guests leave feeling impressed.

 **What you’ll do**

* Own the workplace experience. We want the office to be an enjoyable place to be; the latest technology, high end design touches, fully stocked kitchen, catered lunches. You’ll own this end\-to\-end.
* Coordinate internal team events, lunches, dinners. And help with coordinating and managing the external customer and network events we’re hosting in the office.
* Employee experience; work anniversaries, birthdays, special events. We want people at Blacksmith to feel recognized and you’ll play a key role in delivering this experience.
* Effectively manage the day to day operations of the office. Vendor management, equipment, supplies, facilities.
* Negotiate and manage vendor contracts.
* Be the first point of contact for all guests.
* Always be looking for ways to improve the office experience.

 **You’re a good fit if you have**

* Experience in delivering exceptional workplace experience in a similar role.
* You understand what makes an in\-person office experience enjoyable and can deliver that for the team.
* You enjoy creating experiences \- you are excited by the little details, you can anticipate the needs of the team and enjoy delivering an experience that people love.
* You can effectively manage multiple projects simultaneously and have exceptional eye for detail.
* You are comfortable owning logistics and coordinating across the business to deliver initiatives.

 **Compensation and benefits**

* Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.
* Competitive base \+ equity.
* 401K match.
* Unlimited PTO.
* Annual offsite.
* Early\-exercise stock options
* 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US)


Compensation Range: $115K \- $150K

jobs.title: Case Manager (RRC)
jobs.description:
**Case Manager (RRC)**


**Hybrid Remote/In\-Person Full\-Time (40 hrs/wk) Position in Oakland, CA (Non\-Exempt)**


**Who We Are**



Ruby's Place dba Restorative Pathways (RP) is an innovative nonprofit committed to ending domestic violence, human trafficking, and violent crime through hope, advocacy and connection. Our services include emergency shelter, transitional housing, rental subsidies, mental health services, substance recovery, and wrap\-around services. All our services are trauma\-sensitive and client\-centered and are provided at no cost to our clients. All programs are low barrier.


RP is led by survivors with a focus on reflection, innovation, and connection. We believe in fostering relationships, both in our direct service work and throughout our internal work culture. We aim to cultivate a workplace that appreciates and emphasizes the voices of those most impacted by violence. We recognize these voices are vital to interrupting the cycle of violence and transforming lives towards safety, unity, and trust.


**Who You Are**



You have a strong commitment to preventing interpersonal violence as well as an understanding of, and sensitivity to, serving diverse populations. You have excellent interpersonal skills and strong techniques for relationship building. You believe people should determine their own path towards healing, and have an orientation towards survivor\-centered services.



You are a go\-getter who enjoys fast paced environments. You enjoy working both collaboratively and independently. You are adept at time management and highly organized with a proven ability to ensure you can meet deadlines, plan, organize and execute. You are comfortable working as part of a team and are an accountable collaborator. You excel at organizing, prioritizing, and following through on multiple time\-sensitive projects. You are flexible, creative, and take initiative in handling emergencies.


***What qualifications are required for this position?***


**Required:**


* High school diploma or equivalent (GED) required.
* Ability to pass all required background screening prior to hire, including criminal background check and DOJ/FBI fingerprinting, per RP and California DHCS requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage and track a caseload of clients with competing deadlines and needs.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, including comfort documenting in an electronic medical record.
* A calm, non\-judgmental, and compassionate approach to working with clients in recovery and their families.
* Ability to work collaboratively across residential, clinical, and medical teams.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation, if assisting with client transportation coordination.
* In possession of a valid CA driver's license, proof of insurance, and be approved by RP insurance as a driver in order to drive agency vehicles. If a staff member cannot be approved by RP insurance as a driver, employment might not be able to continue. Instances where staff cannot be approved to drive will be reviewed on a case by case basis to determine if employment can continue in their role without driving agency vehicles. Items considered include but are not limited to: the shift the staff member holds and the frequency/necessity of driving during that shift, the amount of time before the staff member may be approved to drive by the insurance carrier, the availability of other staff on site to drive agency vehicles as program needs require, etc.
* Able to complete all required background checks. Additional requirements may be deemed necessary, including fingerprinting (Live Scan), completion of all Community Care Licensing (CCL) documents, and ability to meet CCL licensing requirements.


**Preferred:**


* Bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, human services, or a related field.
* Prior experience in case management, care coordination, or a related support role, ideally in a behavioral health or SUD treatment setting.
* Familiarity with community resources in the Oakland / Bay Area region (housing, employment, benefits, legal aid, healthcare).
* Registered or certified AOD (alcohol and drug) credential, or working toward one — not required for this role, but a plus.
* Bilingual ability, and experience working with culturally and linguistically diverse clients and families.


**What You Will Do**



Riley Recovery Centers (RRC) is a program within Restorative Pathways. RRC provides safe, compassionate, evidence\-based substance use disorder (SUD) treatment for youth and adults. RRC operates a single integrated continuum of care on one property: clients live on\-site in a supervised, home\-like sober living residence while attending structured clinical programming — Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP, ASAM Level 2\.5\) and Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP, ASAM Level 2\.1\) — delivered through individual, group, and family sessions. RRC believes recovery is possible for every person, and our team works together across housing, clinical, and medical services so that treatment feels like one connected experience rather than separate programs under one roof.



RP is hiring a full\-time Case Manager within RRC to serve as the connective thread between our sober living residence and our PHP/IOP clinical programs. This is a non\-clinical, client\-facing coordination role: you will not provide therapy or counseling, but you will be the person who makes sure every client's practical, logistical, and support needs are identified, tracked, and followed through on — from a scheduled appointment or a referral to community services, to helping a client in their final weeks of sober living line up a job and permanent housing. You'll work closely with the Program Manager, AOD Counselors, the House Manager, and RRC's clinical and medical team, and you'll be a steady, organized presence for clients navigating a lot of moving pieces at onc

**About Lao Family Community Development, Inc.**


Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD) is a community\-based non\-profit organization established in Richmond, Contra Costa County, California, in 1980\. Since then, LFCD has expanded its operations to Alameda and Sacramento counties with its headquarters located in Oakland, California.


LFCD delivers programs and services from seven locations in more than 35 languages. The organization provides community development, affordable real estate, workforce development, education, and human services that primarily support low\-income individuals and families, refugees, immigrants, transitional\-age youth, seniors, individuals with disabilities, and other underserved populations.

**Job Summary:** Under the direction of the program supervisor, this position will serve low\-income Workforce Innovation Opportunity Act (WIOA) participants, CalWorks LEP participants, and CSBG participants to gain job placements, as well as manage participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medical (Cal\-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non\-clinical needs.


The Lead Case Manager is responsible for overseeing the Contra Costa County Workforce Development Board (CCCWDB) WIOA Employment Services case management services, ensuring high\-quality workforce services delivery, preparing the reports, ensuring compliance with program requirements and successful participant outcomes.


This position is responsible for interfacing with local employers and training providers, external organizations, and the internal LFCD department, especially the America’s Job Center of California (AJCC) and Business Centers. The position’s duties include lead the project, organize quarterly job fair, outreach recruitment for employers and job seekers, provide orientation, intake\-assessment, set up Individual Employment Plan (IEP), case management, On the Job Training (OJT), Individual Training Account (ITA) / Vocational Training counseling, job placement, retention services, assessing the participants health condition and coordinating care. Program activities and strategies include long\-term career advancement for each participant; understanding the hiring and business development needs of each employer; the policy and compliance requirements of funders; and the many subtle factors that can influence each individual’s ability to thrive and advance in the workplace. * Maintain strong networks with employers, community stakeholders, and service providers, ensuring program participants have access to career opportunities and supportive services.
* Organize quarterly job fair.

* Communicate with county and workforce development staff to ensure compliance with program requirements, eligibility verification, and time

We are a thriving nonprofit network of 23 free, public charter schools open to all students. At KIPP, we believe all children should grow up free to create the future they want for themselves and that schools can and should be a critical factor in making that vision a reality. Together with families and communities, we create joyful, academically excellent schools that prepare students with the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose—college, career, and beyond—so they can lead fulfilling lives and build a more just world.


Our student community consists of nearly 7,000 elementary, middle, and high school students in East Palo Alto, Oakland, San Francisco, San Lorenzo, San José, Redwood City, and Stockton. 81% qualify for free or reduced price lunch, 34% are multilingual learners, and 12% have special needs. We strive to cultivate a representative team of teachers and leaders that reflects our students’ diversity.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Operations Coordinator supports a safe, orderly, and joyful environment at KIPP Bridge Academy by executing consistent student culture and campus operations routines throughout the school day. Reporting to the School Leader, this role maintains a visible presence across campus, builds positive relationships with students, and supports systems that keep students safe, engaged, and in the appropriate learning environment.


In this role, you execute assigned tasks with quality and on time, working within a scope set by others. You decide how to approach your work and escalate anything outside it.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **Student Culture, Supervision \& Safety**

* **Executes** established supervision and student culture routines across hallways, bathrooms, common areas, and other high\-traffic spaces so students experience a safe, orderly, and welcoming campus.
* **Supports** consistent schoolwide behavioral expectations through respectful redirection, age\-appropriate de\-escalation, and positive relationship\-building so students understand and meet community expectations.
* **Escalates** significant, recurring, or higher\-risk student behavior and safety concerns according to established school protocols so appropriate leaders can respond promptly.
* **Maintains** consistent implementation of established student safety, crisis response, and behavior protocols within the scope of the role.

### **Student Movement, Attendance \& Engagement**

* **Executes** established transition and student movement routines during class changes, arrival, dismissal, lunch, and other school activities so students reach assigned locations safely and efficiently.
* **Maintains** the school's student pass and movement systems so students outside instructional spaces are appropriately accounted for throughout the school day.
* **Tracks** patterns of tardiness, class avoidance, extended time outside classrooms, wandering, or pass misuse so school leaders have timely information to address recurring concerns.
* **Supports** attendance and re\-engagement systems, including assigned campus sweeps and student\-location checks, so students return to and remain engaged in instructional spaces.

### **Arrival, Dismissal \& Lunch Operations**

* **Executes** assigned arrival, dismissal, and lunch procedures so students move safely and school routines remain predictable and efficient.
* **Supports** lunch supervision and student expectations for movement, use of space, cleanliness, and behavior so non\-instructional periods remain safe and welcoming.
* **Escalates** significant conflicts, safety concerns, and operational breakdowns according to established protocols so school leaders can intervene when needed.

### **Campus Operations \& Systems**

* **Completes** regular campus\-readiness checks of common areas, student spaces, signage, supplies, and assigned safety\-related needs so the campus is prepared for students and staff.
* **Maintains** accurate records and systems for assigned inventory, equipment, supplies, and student\-facing materials so operational resources remain organized and available.
* **Tracks** recurring operational gaps or breakdowns and communicates them to school leadership so the team can determine appropriate improvements.
* **Supports** implementation of established and new campus routines so operational expectations are applied consistently across the school.

### **Student \& Family Community**

* **Supports** a positive school climate by building trusting relationships with students while maintaining clear adult boundaries and consistent expectations.
* **Executes** student recognition and relationship\-building practices so students experience encouragement, accountability, and connection to the school community.
* **Supports** student culture activities, assemblies, community events, and other schoolwide programming so students and families experience a welcoming and connected school community.
* **Maintains** respectful, culturally responsive, and age\-appropriate communication with students, families, and staff so community members feel known, safe, and respected.
* Other duties as assigned.

--------------------------------


These competencies describe the core leadership behaviors expected at this level—they guide how we hire, develop, and grow our people at KIPP NorCal.

* **Lead People:** You lead with integrity, follow through on commitments, and collaborate openly—contributing to team purpose and bringing others along.

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year
  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.
* Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple cross\-functional programs or projects.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with R, SQL, spreadsheets, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience working with product and engineering teams.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure or SaaS commercial programs and business models.
* Exposure to statistical analysis, driver analysis, and incrementality calculations.
* Ability to form excellent working relationships across business, operational, and technical functions.
* Comfort with sprints to rapidly answer executive asks.

**About the job**
-----------------


Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.



As a Lead for market insights, you are responsible for building a robust and scalable platform where we monitor and collect critical signals of market intelligence and participant behavior. You will use this process to track and identify trends that help us understand what customers want and what our participants are doing in the market, allowing us to stay one step ahead. You will assist with the steady stream of inbound executive requests for information and insights, while allowing us to proactively identify patterns and bring these to leaders across the Cloud business.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $176000 \- $256000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Identify and solve organizational problems by defining, leading, and establishing effective operating programs, processes, and tools to achieve key business goals.
* Influence cross\-functional teams and executive management to drive complex, strategic programs and market intelligence initiatives to successful completion.
* Develop AI\-driven agents and processes to monitor, collect, and analyze participant and market intelligence data in near\-real time at scale.
* Build and scale a robust data repository to proactively track market shifts, participant focus areas, and rapidly answer high\-priority executive inquiries.
* Create and deliver high\-impact presentations and visual displays of quantitative insights to communicate market trends and strategic recommendations to stakeholders.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
**About Sporton**  
Since its inception in 1986, Sporton International has been focusing on providing customers with professional product testing and certification services. With years of dedication, Sporton International has become a designated testing lab for regulatory bodies such as BSMI, NCC, and TAF and acquired professional certificates including PTCRB, GCF and CTIA. With solid credibility in the industry, Sporton International now is the largest test lab specializing in EMC/Safety tests.

**Job Overview**

The HR Generalist will manage daily HR operations, ensure compliance with California Labor Law, and handle tasks such as hiring, onboarding, training, benefits enrollment, and Workers' Comp. The role requires strong HR knowledge and interpersonal skills to support a high\-performance culture and workforce development. We will offer a salary package commensurate with experience.

**Responsibilities**

1\. **Employee Relations**

* Address employee queries and resolve issues promptly.

2\. **Recruitment and Onboarding**

* Manage recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and training.
* Handle job postings, candidate shortlisting, and interview scheduling.

3\. **HR Policies and Compliance**

* Update and enforce HR policies and company guidelines to ensure compliance with regulations.
* Maintain and revise the Employee Handbook and mandatory programs.

5\. **Benefits Administration**

* Coordinate benefits open enrollment and address employee benefit inquiries.
* Manage benefits\-related documentation and employee requests.

6\. **Records and Documentation**

* Maintain and organize employee records, benefits, and attendance.
* Ensure accurate documentation for employment verifications and internal tracking.

7\. **Government and Insurance**

* Respond to government agency inquiries and handle Workers' Comp claims.
* Manage compliance with federal and state employment regulations.

8\. **Training and Development**

* Support departmental and organizational training initiatives.

Note: Additional tasks may be assigned as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or a related field
* Proficient understanding of HR laws, regulations, and best practices
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills
* Analytical mindset with a focus on accuracy
* Fluent in English \& Mandarin (Required)

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

  

  

As a Senior TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.  

  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Math, or related discipline, and 2\+ years of equivalent work experience or 4\+ years of related work experience.
* 2\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience in Information Technology operations

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead
* Understanding of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework pillars and ability to properly apply them to existing or new customer architecture, implementations, and/or solutions
* Internal enterprise or external customer\-facing experience as a technical lead
* Professional oral and written communication skills, presenting to an audience containing one or more executive team member(s)

jobs.title: Community Health Worker - Marshall, DeKalb, and Blount Counties
jobs.description:
**About A.C.T.I.O.N.**



A.C.T.I.O.N. is a proposed community\-wide overdose prevention initiative that will expand access to FDA\-approved opioid overdose reversal medications (OORMs), community training, and treatment referral pathways across the twelve counties of Alabama's 4th Congressional District (Lauderdale, Colbert, Franklin, Marion, Lamar, Fayette, Walker, Winston, Cullman, Marshall, DeKalb, and Blount). This position is contingent upon receipt of federal SAMHSA grant funding.



**Position Summary**



The Community Health Worker (CHW) for Cluster 4 is responsible for opioid overdose reversal medication (OORM) distribution, overdose\-recognition and response training, and referral follow\-up within Marshall, DeKalb and Blount Counties, working in close partnership with the cluster's designated community partner organization. This locally embedded, field\-based role requires strong ties to the assigned counties.



**Key Responsibilities**



* Distribute FDA\-approved OORMs (naloxone and nalmefene) to bystanders, community sectors, and rural first responders within Marshall, DeKalb and Blount Counties.
* Deliver overdose\-recognition, response, and OORM\-administration training to both traditional partners (healthcare providers, pharmacies, EMS, school systems) and non\-traditional community sectors (e.g., gas station attendants, motel staff, retail employees, postal workers).
* Train local Training\-of\-Trainers cohorts to extend the training curriculum further into the community.
* Support referral and linkage follow\-up for individuals identified through prevention or overdose response activities, in coordination with the Program Coordinator/Data Lead.
* Maintain local relationships with the cluster's designated community partner, healthcare providers, pharmacies, faith\-based organizations, and schools.
* Complete required data collection instruments accurately and submit them to the Program Coordinator/Data Lead on the required schedule.
* Participate in the Local Community Prevention Collaborative and community\-facing outreach and distribution events.

**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in public health, social work, or a related field
* Local, rural\-based residency or strong ties to Marshall, DeKalb and Blount Counties, with community trust and lived familiarity with the area.
* Community health worker certification or equivalent lived or professional experience preferred.
* Strong local community relationships and the trust of area residents.
* Ability to complete Aletheia House's overdose\-recognition and naloxone\-administration training during onboarding (provided).
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel within the assigned counties for distribution and training visits.
* Comfortable with basic data entry and reporting tools.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

Aletheia House is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Candidates are selected based on merit and qualifications only.


**Schedule**



Monday\-Friday 9:00am\-5:00pm; occasional weekends and evenings for community events

jobs.title: ServiceNow Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**ServiceNow Senior Project Manager**
=====================================


**Company:** CoreX  

**Position:** Senior Project Manager – ServiceNow  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time


**Role Overview**
-----------------


CoreX is seeking an experienced **ServiceNow Senior Project Manager** to lead complex ServiceNow implementations and transformation initiatives from initiation through successful delivery.


This individual will be responsible for managing the full project lifecycle, coordinating cross\-functional delivery teams, maintaining strong client relationships, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.


The ideal candidate has significant experience managing **ServiceNow implementations within a consulting or professional services environment** and is comfortable leading multiple workstreams, managing executive\-level stakeholders, and driving accountability across technical and functional teams.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex ServiceNow implementation and transformation projects.
* Own project scope, timelines, budgets, resource plans, risks, dependencies, and overall delivery performance.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between CoreX delivery teams and customer stakeholders.
* Lead project kickoff meetings, status meetings, steering committee meetings, and executive\-level communications.
* Coordinate ServiceNow Architects, Business Process Consultants, Developers, Technical Consultants, and other project resources.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, RAID logs, status reports, and financial forecasts.
* Proactively identify project risks, blockers, scope changes, and resource constraints and drive them toward resolution.
* Manage project financials, including budget tracking, resource utilization, forecasting, and overall project health.
* Partner with technical and functional teams to ensure customer requirements and business objectives are translated into successful ServiceNow solutions.
* Manage customer expectations and maintain strong relationships throughout the engagement.
* Ensure appropriate governance, documentation, quality controls, and delivery methodologies are followed.
* Support change management and escalation processes when necessary.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes and overall customer satisfaction.
* Manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously when required.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 8\+ years of Project Management experience, preferably within technology consulting or SaaS implementations.
* 4\+ years of experience managing **ServiceNow implementations or ServiceNow\-related projects**.
* Previous experience working for a **ServiceNow Partner or within a professional services/consulting organization is highly preferred**.
* Strong understanding of the ServiceNow implementation lifecycle and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Experience managing enterprise\-scale implementations involving multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Strong experience managing project budgets, timelines, resources, scope, risks, and change requests.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with executive stakeholders, technical teams, and business leaders.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Experience working with distributed and cross\-functional delivery teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* PMP, PMI\-ACP, Scrum Master, or similar Project Management certification.
* ServiceNow certifications or formal ServiceNow training.
* Experience delivering projects across ServiceNow workflows such as ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, S2P, SPM, or other enterprise workflows.
* Experience managing large enterprise or multi\-workstream ServiceNow programs.
* Experience working directly with ServiceNow Professional Services or within the ServiceNow Partner ecosystem.

jobs.title: Market Manager, Mining
jobs.description:
**Be an Owner, not a number!** As a 100% employee\-owned firm, our culture thrives on collaboration, sharing of ideas, and open communication, which encourages contributions from every one of our employee owners. As a multi\-disciplined, full\-service firm, success is achieved by our entire team working towards a common goal to provide innovative design solutions, which means you will be challenged, you will be encouraged to bring your ideas, and your contributions will make an impact!



Are you an engineering professional who has extensive knowledge of mining operations and infrastructure requirements? Do you have a thorough understanding of trends, current practices, and future forecasts associated with the mining industry? Do you have a successful track record of cultivating, nurturing, and fostering relationships and a desire to lead efforts to expand and enhance the engineering services we offer to current and prospective mining clients? If so, we have an exciting, challenging, and rewarding opportunity for you to join our Mining Engineering team as the Mining Market Manager for the Southwest Region!



As the Mining Market Manager, you will advance our engineering services within the mining market sector around Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, and Utah. You will develop and implement business plans that focus on enhancing capabilities and increasing awareness of our service offerings to secure surface mining projects and contract opportunities that align with annual and 5\-year strategic revenue and profit goals.



As a member our team, you will collaborate with a multi\-disciplined group of architectural and engineering professionals (civil, mechanical, electrical, structural) to cross\-sell services throughout the firm, identify prospective and strategic clients and project opportunities, track and respond to Request for Proposals (RFPs), and prepare for interviews and presentations. You will also collaborate with Project Managers to define project scope and scheduling requirements, negotiate contracts, determine staffing assignments for project teams, establish design standards, review design plans for technical quality and accuracy, and monitor expenditures and budget parameters. You will play a vital role in cultivating and maintaining relations with technical and industry leaders by leading outreach programs, attending networking events, and actively participating in committees and associations. On occasion, you may also assume the role of Project Manager or Project Engineer depending on the size of the project or the technical / design requirements.



### **Location and Work Arrangement**


Geography isn’t a limiting factor for this position, which is why we are open to remote candidates whose experience and qualifications align with this position and market development initiatives. Preference may be given to candidates who reside within the Southwest (Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, or Utah) due to proximity to existing and target client operations. Regular travel to TKDA offices, project locations, and team events will be expected to foster collaboration, strengthen relationships, and support project success.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor degree in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Mining or Structural Engineering.
* Ten or more years of progressive experience designing, commissioning, or managing a portfolio of mining, facility, and infrastructure projects; crushing, conveying, slurry and water pumping and pipelines, ore concentrating plants, plant and enabling infrastructure.
* Minimum of five years of multi\-disciplined project management experience with a reputation for providing superior customer service and a successful track record of effectively managing client expectations, project scope, fee estimates, budgets, and schedules.
* Minimum of two years of business development experience demonstrated by a track record of cultivating, nurturing, and deepening client relations and an ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities to increase revenue and improve market share.
* Thorough understanding of the mining industry operations with emphasis on processing, and infrastructure; ability to identify trends, suggest solutions, and guide clients’ ideas into functional and buildable solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to apply effective written and verbal communication and presentation skills when developing proposals, preparing technical reports and documentation, conducting project interviews, leading team meetings, and engaging in discussions related to market and divisional operations.
* Working knowledge of design applications including Revit and/or AutoCAD.
* Flexibility to travel up to 20% overnight to conduct on\-site consultations, lead or participate in project meetings, and attend business development and industry events.
* Prior experience engaging in business development activities \- including proposal preparations, development of scope and fee estimates, and facilitation / leading of capabilities or qualifications presentations.
* Demonstrated track record of securing project opportunities with established, emerging, and prospective clients.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop a team of mechanical engineering professionals consisting of registered engineers, designers, and technicians with varying competencies, knowledge, qualifications, and experience.
* Superior focus on quality demonstrated by an ability adhere to design requirements, utilize and/or implement thorough quality review measures, and continuously evaluate practices to ensure technical accuracy and enhance project delivery methods.
* Demonstrated commitment to promoting and advancing a culture of safety excellence that emphasizes employee training, project / site risk assessment and mitigation, and strict adherence to all internal and external safety policies, requirements, and regulations.

Bring a pioneer spirit, a desire to be part of something that changes the valuation industry, and a drive to turn complex operational challenges into scalable solutions.
  

An intermediate individual contributor role, the Analyst provides in\-depth analytical and strategic program support to several key initiatives simultaneously. This role goes beyond tactical support to drive strategic process improvement and bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. Primary objectives include empowering the CX Organization with actionable insights through data analytics, ensuring project alignment with broader operational goals, and delivering transparent reporting to key stakeholders.
  

This position reports to the Senior Director, Appraisal Innovation Operations but works closely with the entirety of the CX Operational teams as well as finance, sales and product.
  

On occasion, this role will be asked to provide support and leadership to projects within the ASG and additional Clear Capital divisions as needed.

* Lead requirements gathering by facilitating stakeholder sessions to elicit, analyze, and document operational needs
* Define project scope and business objectives to ensure alignment with long\-term strategy
* Validate delivered solutions against business needs through user story creation and acceptance criteria
* Provide analytical support to teams engaged in ongoing performance improvement initiatives
	+ Weekly internal reporting: Performance, financials and escalations
	+ On\-demand customer requests for custom analysis
	+ Coverage analysis of appraiser and broker panels
* Provide Analyst support to CX Organization to build accurate and robust business justifications for system enhancement requests, analyze performance trends.
* Building dashboards and reports using tools like google sheets, google slides and quicksight
* Effectively communicate analysis, data and recommendations to senior leadership and other CX stakeholders
### **Who We Are Looking For**


* 2\-4 years of experience as a Junior Analyst, QA Analyst, Data Analyst, or Operations Associate; demonstrated exposure to project support, documentation, and reporting.
* Strong data analysis skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proven ability in influencing cross\-functional stakeholders and guiding project direction
* Demonstrated strong work ethic
* Excellent organizational and project management skills
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills to create data with little direction
* Demonstrated ability to manage through change and adapt to a changing environment
* Strong history of mentoring and developing employees
* Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy while managing multiple complex projects


**Additional Qualifications**


* Microsoft/Google Experience
* Deep Excel/Sheets Experience to perform helpful analysis for the business
* P\&L experience
* Strong business acumen
### **What You Can Expect**

* Compensation: The base salary for this position ranges from $92,000 \- $115,000 annually, depending on your location, experience, and qualifications. Additional compensation offerings include a company profit\-sharing bonus program, communication stipends, and referral bonuses.
* Inclusive benefits package offering:  

Comprehensive medical, dental, and company paid vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, voluntary life and AD\&D insurance options, voluntary supplemental insurances for accident, critical illness, and legal services, paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays, employee assistance and wellness programs, company paid short term disability coverage, company contributions to health saving funds (with participation in the high deductible health plan. We offer company\-paid access to Galileo for virtual primary care and Rula for virtual mental health resources.

Career and skill development resources to help advance your career and personal growth.

* impact on the real estate industry.

* Wherever it Leads, Whatever it Takes® \- No matter how remote, complex, or unexpected. Our commitment never wavers.
* Hire NICE people \- Skills can be taught but character shines through. We seek those who bring integrity, kindness, and grit.
* Lift others up \- We lead with empathy and strive to improve the lives of those around us.
* Sweat the details \- Excellence lives in the little things. Getting it just so is how we make a big impact.
* Raise the bar \- We don’t settle for industry standards, we redefine them.

Clear Capital is a national real estate analytics, data solutions and valuation technology company with a simple purpose: to build confidence in real estate decisions to strengthen communities and improve lives. Our goal is to provide customers with a complete understanding of nearly every U.S. property through our AI\-driven analytics, data solutions, valuation services and automated appraisal review platforms. * Manage a high volume of calls while maintaining professionalism and meeting response time goals.

jobs.title: Fractional Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Sunny's Gourmet Products · Part\-time · Remote with travel to Mishawaka, Indiana**

Sunny's Gourmet Products manufactures authentic Korean sauces and seasonings — all\-natural, chef\-developed, and built on recipes our founder refined over more than thirty years, first in her own restaurant kitchen and now as a packaged goods line. We distribute nationally through KeHE, with UNFI in progress, alongside self\-distribution and Amazon, and hold retail placement across the Midwest and beyond.

**The opportunity**

This is a new role and a broad one. Our founder has run production directly since the beginning, and this next stage calls for formalizing what she has built — specifications, quality standards, supplier and cost systems — so it scales with us.

You would own that work end to end and design most of it rather than inherit it. For an operator who would rather build than maintain, there is real room here, and the role is structured to grow as the company does.

**The first six months**

*Month 1 — Get oriented.* Meet the team, learn the products, and map the current state across records, suppliers, contracts, certifications, and working arrangements. Deliver a current\-state map and a prioritized roadmap.

*Months 2–3 — On\-site intensive.* Two consecutive days in Mishawaka working directly with the founder and observing live production, capturing formulation, process parameters, and quality standards. A structured question bank and capture protocol are ready for you.

*Months 3–4 — Documentation.* Master specifications for four SKUs, quality standards with defined acceptance criteria, and core operating procedures.

*Months 4–6 — Build the operating record.* Supplier and packaging master with terms and lead times, SKU\-level cost build and COGS, logistics and fulfillment, and the compliance documentation our distribution partners require.

**Ongoing**

* Own and maintain the specification and procedure library
* Supplier relationships, purchasing cadence, and terms
* Cost tracking and margin analysis by SKU and channel
* Retailer and distributor compliance documentation and new item setup
* Co\-manufacturer qualification as we expand capacity
* Production planning and inventory as volume grows

**Required**

* Documentation experience in a regulated manufacturing environment — food, pharmaceutical, or medical device. Food preferred.
* Fluency in controlled documentation: specifications, batch records, operating procedures, and change control
* Experience building operating systems, not only maintaining them
* Experience working directly with a founder\-operator
* Self\-directed, and comfortable owning a function end to end

**Preferred**

* Food manufacturing background, particularly shelf\-stable products
* HACCP, GMP, and FSMA fluency
* Experience taking a small brand into co\-manufacturing
* Familiarity with KeHE and UNFI mechanics, trade spend, and deductions
* SKU\-level cost accounting
* Based in the South Bend–Elkhart area — convenient for the on\-site work, though not required

**Terms**

Independent contractor on a monthly retainer. Approximately 30 hours per month at $1,600–1,800, depending on experience and scope. Twelve\-month horizon with a path to a full\-time operations role as revenue supports it. Remote — on\-site work in Mishawaka is expected to be roughly 10% of the engagement or less, concentrated in the intensive. Airfare and lodging arranged and paid by SGP, ground transportation reimbursed. Mutual NDA prior to disclosure.

**To apply**

Send relevant experience with particular attention to operations work you built rather than inherited; one sample deliverable you authored (redaction is fine); your read on where you would start; and your availability.

Pay: $1,600\.00 \- $1,800\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.


Do you find the slow pace of drug development unacceptable? Are you ready to use cutting\-edge technology to accelerate the completion of cancer clinical trials? $65,000\-$100,000

Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. **Operations Manager — Financially SMART**

**About Financially SMART**

Financially SMART is a fractional CFO and outsourced accounting firm built exclusively for wealth management firms and RIAs. We serve advisory firms through a pod\-based model — each client is supported by a dedicated bookkeeper, senior accountant, and advisor — and we pair that service with FinSights AI, our proprietary financial analytics platform that gives clients real\-time dashboards, benchmarking, and AI\-driven commentary.

We've grown to a 13\-person team in under three years. Now we need someone to make sure the machine runs as well as the people in it.

**The Role**

The Operations Manager is the connective tissue of the firm. You'll own how work moves through Financially SMART — making sure every client deliverable goes out on time and to standard, our CRM reflects reality, and our team operates from one playbook instead of many. You'll report directly to the Founder and partner closely with our Director of Finance, accounting pods, and client advisors.

This is a builder role. You'll inherit a strong team and good systems, and your job is to tighten them, connect them, and scale them.

What You'll Do

**Service delivery \& deliverables oversight**

* Track and manage the monthly delivery calendar across all clients — closes, financial packages, reports, dashboards, and forecasts

**Firm operations \& alignment**

* Run internal operating cadences — weekly team syncs, pod check\-ins, and status reviews

* Identify gaps between sales, service, and FinSights, and close them
* Act as a point of escalation for operational and client\-service issues

What You Bring

* 4\+ years in operations, practice management, or service delivery — ideally at an accounting firm, outsourced accounting/CAS practice, or professional services firm

* Background scaling a firm through a growth phase

Why Financially SMART

Submit your resume and a short note describing a process or system you built that made a team run better — what was broken, what you changed, and the result.
