**Our Story**
-------------


TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end\-to\-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world\-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.


Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.


We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast\-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

 **The Opportunity**


The Litigation Operations Manager is responsible for the operational execution of Top Dog Law's litigation function across all active states. This role serves as the primary implementation layer between firm leadership and state\- level litigation teams. A core responsibility of this role is the direct oversight, training, and accountability of Litigation Team Leads in each state, ensuring uniformity in how cases are managed from litigation through trial.

**What You Will Own**

* Directly supervise Litigation Team Leads across all active states (FL, GA, MS, AZ, LA, NY, TN, IL)

* Identify and develop high\-performing paralegals and litigation staff for Team Lead succession

**Litigation Operations Implementation**

* Implement and enforce firm\-wide litigation SOPs across all states, adapting for state\-specific court rules and procedural requirements
* Monitor compliance with phase timing benchmarks from filing through trial; escalate bottlenecks to the Regional Operations team.
* Oversee daily operational workflows including task management, deadline tracking, court filing compliance, and case phase movement
* Partner with Team Leads to ensure caseload assignments are balanced against capacity and case complexity
* Coordinate cross\-state operational initiatives, ensuring consistent execution regardless of jurisdiction

**Training \& Standards**

* Design and deliver litigation\-specific training for Team Leads and litigation staff on Filevine, case management protocols, court procedures, and SOL compliance.

* Facilitate regular Team Lead meetings to share best practices, surface operational challenges, and reinforce firm standards

**Data \& Reporting**

**What You Bring**

**Required:**

* 5\+ years of experience in personal injury litigation operations, legal operations management, or a senior paralegal leadership role
* Prior experience supervising or training litigation staff across multiple offices or jurisdictions strongly preferred
* Deep familiarity with litigation case management platforms; Filevine experience a plus
* Strong working knowledge of personal injury litigation workflows — from filing through trial — across multiple states
* Demonstrated ability to implement SOPs, hold teams accountable to standards, and drive performance through others
* Comfortable working with data and performance metrics; ability to read dashboards and translate findings into operational action
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to work effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and firm leadership

 **Who Thrives Here (Core Values)**


We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

* **Embrace Change:** Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
* **Committed:** You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
* **No\-Ego Energy:** Positive, professional, and solutions\-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
* **Ownership:** You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
* **Fast \& Hungry:** You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

**Accounting Operations Manager**


**About Fringe**


Fringe is a fast\-growing HR technology company based in Virginia. Founded in late 2018, Fringe is the first ever platform for personalized lifestyle benefits. We are a relentlessly people\-focused group revolutionizing the way employers care for their people in the benefits space. We're a supportive, down\-to\-earth team, fully committed to the belief that relationships fuel outstanding client experience.


We built Fringe to give companies a better way to show love and care to their people. Because we believe it's the people who really matter. Companies exist because of the products and services they offer, but we believe the people within them should come first. At Fringe, this is the way we live.


Practically, this means we hire people who care about their teammates just as much as (if not more than) themselves. We hire people who are genuine, humble, willing to learn, ready to teach, able to adapt, flex, collaborate, celebrate each other, win together and lose together.


We're a startup, and that means we must be a courageous group. We solve problems all day, but we also mess up sometimes. We extend grace to each other, and we try again. We aren't looking for perfect people. We're looking for people who own their faults, play to their strengths, and have the courage to simply be the same person all the time.


If that doesn't sound like your cup of cold brew, no hard feelings. But that's exactly who we are and what you can expect when you work at Fringe.


**About the role**


Fringe's employee experience platform combines a B2B model with a B2B2C marketplace. Employers pay us a subscription and fund lifestyle benefits, swag, recognition, and gifting for their people. Employees spend those dollars as points in our marketplace across hundreds of vendors. We pay the vendors. That means we run a SaaS business and a marketplace at the same time, with deferred revenue, points liabilities, and a cohort of channel partners layered on top. If you find that combination energizing rather than intimidating, keep reading.


You'll be the in\-house finance and accounting leader at Fringe and will take over a well\-built set of documented, repeatable close processes. You will own the monthly close and everything that comes out of it, run our financial operations end to end, and be the person everyone at Fringe comes to with a finance question. You'll report to the COO and work closely with Operations and Product.


This is a role for a professional who wants to jump into a startup environment and own a whole function. It is a lot of hats and it is a rare amount of scope, ownership, and visibility..


**What you'll own**


**Monthly close and reporting**


* Run the full monthly close: close calendar, journal entries, reconciliations, and sign\-off across subscription and marketplace revenue.
* Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 for a hybrid model: PEPM subscriptions, employer\-funded marketplace spend, gifting, and partner revenue share.
* Maintain deferred revenue and points liability roll\-forwards and keep the balance sheet clean and explainable.
* Produce internal and external monthly reporting: variance and flux analysis and the executive dashboard.
* Support the annual audit and tax processes with our outside CPA firms.


**Financial operations**


* Treasury and cash: cash forecast, bank relationships, managing operating balances, and executing outbound wires and ACH payments with proper approvals.
* Accounts payable, accounts receivable and collections in partnership with Customer Success: customer invoicing and billing accuracy, vendor payment runs, and chasing what's past due.
* Payroll, working with People Operations and our PEO.
* Review all accounting work and ensure a high standard.


**Cross\-functional partner**


* Be the main point of contact for all things finance internally: contract terms, vendor questions, funding schedules, commission plans, budgets.
* Spot the process that's slowing us down and fix it. Drive operational improvement rather than waiting for someone to ask.


**Who you are**


* High agency and a bias for action. You'd rather ship a good answer today than a perfect one next week, and you know which situations call for which.
* Comfortable being the only finance person in the room, and honest about when you need a second set of eyes.
* A clear communicator who can explain a flux to the CEO, a payment term to a salesperson, and a rev rec judgment to an auditor.
* Curious about how the business actually works, not just how it's booked.
* Someone who owns mistakes, extends grace, and shows up as the same person every day. That's who we are.


**Need to haves**


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience.
* Deep understanding of GAAP, especially ASC 606\.
* Hands\-on experience running monthly close procedures and meeting internal and external reporting requirements.
* Familiarity with an accounting tech stack and a spreadsheet wizard (Quickbooks, Tabs, Anrok, FloQast, Salesforce, Claude, Google Sheets)
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to drive operational improvement.
* Quality communicator, written and verbal.


**Nice to haves**


* Experience at Big 4, high\-growth startup, management consulting, or investment banking.
* CPA (active or license applicant).
* SaaS or marketplace experience, especially with deferred revenue, points or stored value, or multi\-party revenue.


**What we offer**


Fringe is remote\-first, with an office in Richmond, VA for those who want it. Beyond the scope of the role itself, here's what comes with it:


* Competitive salary.
* Employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for individuals and families.
* 3% company match on 401(k) retirement

jobs.title: Program Launch Manager
jobs.description:
**About Convergent Research**
-----------------------------



Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO). We design, launch, and support mission\-driven, time\-bound organizations built to solve important scientific and engineering bottlenecks.



FROs are designed to tackle the kinds of problems that benefit from unusual levels of focus, coordination, and scale. Convergent provides the operational backbone that allows FRO teams to move quickly—from legal formation, funding, hiring, finance, and governance to partnerships, communications, and operational systems.



We’ve now taken 14 FROs from idea to operating entity, including four launches in 2026\. And we’re not slowing down.

  


**About the Role**
------------------



Turning an ambitious scientific idea into a functioning organization requires a lot more than good science.



There are entities to form, teams to hire, systems to stand up, funders and partners to coordinate, decisions to make, and approximately one million details that need to happen in the right order. At the same time, the founders doing this work are often building an organization for the first time.



That’s where you come in.



As our **Program Launch Manager**, you’ll sit at the center of the FRO lifecycle. You’ll help promising scientific projects become functioning organizations while also running large\-scale founder programs that develop the next generation of FROs.



You’ll be part project manager, part operator, and part trusted partner. One minute you might be building a launch plan across legal, finance, people, and IT. The next, you’re helping a scientist understand an unfamiliar operational decision, chasing down a dependency that could delay launch, or making sure a founder residency participant has what they need to make progress.



This isn’t a traditional project\-management or account\-management role. Our systems and playbooks are still evolving, and every FRO is different. You’ll need to bring structure without creating bureaucracy, keep things moving without losing sight of the people involved, and turn what we learn from every launch into a better system for the next one.



### **You Are (Skills):**

* **A project manager who can make ambiguity actionable.** Give you a complicated goal with multiple teams, unclear dependencies, and a moving timeline, and you can turn it into a practical plan. You know who owns what, what needs to happen next, where the risks are, and which decisions are holding everything else up.
* **Operationally rigorous.** You notice the details that matter. You keep accurate records, follow through reliably, and know that a small operational gap today can become a much larger problem three weeks from now.
* **People\-centered and emotionally intelligent.** Launching an organization can be exciting, confusing, stressful, and occasionally all three before lunch. You build trust quickly, meet people where they are, and know when to coach, facilitate, advise, push, or simply listen.
* **A confident, clear, proactive communicator.** You can run an effective meeting, write a concise status update, ask the uncomfortable\-but\-important question, and translate complicated processes into something another human can actually understand. You’re equally comfortable working with scientists, founders, executives, vendors, funders, and functional specialists.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity.** You’ve worked somewhere entrepreneurial—perhaps a startup, nonprofit, consultancy, research organization, or similar environment—where not every process came with an instruction manual. You bring structure while recognizing that the right answer may be different for every FRO.
* **A fan of functional systems.** After doing something manually for the fifth time, you start wondering whether there’s a better way. You like turning bespoke work into useful processes, templates, documentation, and operating rhythms—and you’re interested in using automation and AI thoughtfully when they can make those systems better.
* **A great juggler.** Multiple launches, founder programs, stakeholders, decisions, and deadlines don’t scare you. You can manage several workstreams at once, adjust when priorities change, and keep things moving without adding unnecessary process.

### **You Will (Duties):**

* **Lead FRO launches.** You’ll own the day\-to\-day coordination of one or more FRO launches, bringing together Convergent’s legal, finance, people, compliance, procurement, IT, fundraising, communications, and leadership teams. You’ll build and manage launch plans from proposal approval and funding commitment through entity formation, operational activation, team onboarding, and early FRO execution. You’ll run launch meetings, track decisions and dependencies, surface risks early, resolve blockers, and help coordinate launches across both U.S. and international contexts.
* **Run founder programs.** You’ll own the operational delivery of FRO Founder Residencies, open calls, Launchpad programs, and other partner\-led initiatives—from planning and participant onboarding through programming, selection, and closeout. You’ll coordinate program design, participant experience, and internal operational work while providing thoughtful, high\-touch support to founders and teams.
* **Be a trusted partner to FRO founders.** You’ll serve as a consistent and responsive point of contact for founders and FRO leaders during launch and early operations. You’ll help them understand Convergent’s operating model, systems, decision rights, governance expectations, and available support. You’ll advocate for their needs while also helping them navigate the realities of building a new organization.

They serve as a primary liaison with client stakeholders across projects; navigate early project development (NOI to warranty), contract negotiations, engineering early work, sequencing, and supply chain strategies. They enforce Standard Work Instructions and Quality Programs, drive process utilization, safety, and risk management, and ensure the company’s values are upheld.

**STEP INTO THE ROLE**

**Portfolio, Program \& Project Leadership**

* Leads portfolio\- and program\-level planning and serves as sponsor to multiple Project Manager teams, ensuring strategic alignment across projects.
* Manages projects from NOI through Warranty and sponsors Project Manager teams as needed.
* Successfully manages multiple complex projects while mentoring and overseeing other Project Managers.

**Stakeholder, Client \& Communication Management**

* Develops stakeholder engagement strategies and builds strong relationships across projects and programs.
* Serves as the primary liaison with client teams/leadership, ensuring portfolio\-level alignment and strategic decision\-making across projects.
* Independently negotiates complex contracts and exhibits and provides guidance to Project Managers on contract strategy and resolution of high\-risk negotiation points.
* Understands the company mission and supports future opportunities through client relationships.

**Requirements, Planning \& Scheduling**

* Oversees identification, analysis, documentation, and lifecycle management of requirements across multiple projects, ensuring final deliverables meet strategic and technical expectations.
* Develops complex, long\-term, cross\-team schedules; reviews schedules created by Project Managers.

**Risk, Quality \& Change Control**

* Sets program\- and portfolio\-level risk strategies, manages escalated risks, and establishes recovery plans across multiple projects.
* Leads formal review and change\-control processes to assess progress and approve adjustments.
* Leads assurance reviews and third\-party audits; supports PMs in resolving issues.
* Champions best practices, process utilization, quality, safety, and risk management across the organization.

**Financial Management**

* Oversees negotiation, prioritization, and deployment of budgets across programs and projects; directs resource allocation decisions and provides financial oversight to Project Manager teams.
* Oversees project and program budgets, including change management processes.
* Manages and trains others on monthly financial forecasting and time\-phasing.
* Reviews and validates financial performance across projects, providing guidance to Project Managers and ensuring portfolio\-level billing and change controls are accurate.

**People Leadership, Coaching \& Talent Development**

* Sets direction for large or multiple teams; communicates vision, builds capability, and provides training, coaching, and mentoring.
* Onboards and trains PM1s in tools, processes, workflows, and financial forecasting.
* Contributes to management of PM1s, including performance reviews, development coaching, and structured growth plans.
* Provides 1:1 coaching and fosters a high\-performance culture.

**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Drives innovation and contributes to internal initiatives, committees, and cross\-functional improvements.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

* Bachelor’s degree in construction or engineering; or equivalent combinations of technical training and/or related experience.
* 7 or more years of total project/construction experience; 5 or more years leadership experience; preferred renewable construction experience.
* Exceptional leadership and communication (oral, presentation, written).
* Deep knowledge of cost accounting, construction regulations, and risk management.
* Advanced planning and conceptual skills; able to develop portfolio\-level sequencing and schedules.
* Knowledge of salary structures, market pricing, compensation modeling, and pay practices.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office products.
* Ability to prioritize, operate independently, and meet deadlines.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
* Ability to travel.

**WHAT SETS YOU APART**

* Experience with Gas Power Generation projects.

**HOW WE INVEST IN YOU**

* Competitive pay
* 100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees
* 401(k) with company match
* HSA and FSA options
* Dental and Vision insurance
* Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)
* Work/Life balance
* Employee/Family focused culture
* Gym on site
* And more!

**WHO ARE WE?**


With more than 115 years of construction experience, the company has played a vital role in building America’s critical infrastructure, ranging from railroads and highways to dams and mines. Since 1997, Blattner has focused on renewable energy solutions and is responsible for some of the most significant solar, wind and storage projects in the U.S. Today, Blattner has installed more than 25% of America’s utility\-scale wind, solar and energy storage capacity. Blattner Company is the parent company of Blattner Energy and D.H. Blattner \& Sons, of which all are members of the Quanta Services family of companies. Company headquarters are in Avon, Minnesota.


Be a part of something bigger and join the Blattner team – Leading America to a clean energy future!

jobs.description:
**Operations Associate**


(Temporary)

**Engagement Type:** Temporary, W2, with possible conversion to a permanent, full\-time Operations Associate role at the end of the term

**Engagement Length:** 3 months, with the option to extend or convert to permanent based on performance and business need

**Compensation:** $72,500/yr

**Location:** Fully Remote

**Reports To:** Senior Director of Operations

**Position Overview**


Indagare is hiring a Temporary Operations Associate for an initial three\-month term, with a strong possibility of conversion to a permanent, full\-time role based on performance and business need. This person's primary focus will be our Finance x Operations initiative – a cross\-functional effort to modernize and tighten up several of our core operational and financial processes – working under the direct oversight of the Senior Director of Operations. As capacity allows, this role will also grow into supporting partner and supplier\-facing communications as well as cross\-functional projects with other internal departments.


We're looking for someone with excellent project management instincts and the confidence and polish to work directly with, and manage up to, senior leadership. This person should be comfortable driving initiatives forward independently, keeping multiple workstreams and stakeholders organized, and pushing projects to completion – someone who can genuinely move the needle for the business.

**What You'll Do —** Finance x Operations Project (Primary Focus)


Working closely with the Senior Director of Operations and in coordination with Finance leadership, this role will drive the following workstreams:

*Vendor \& Contractor Expense Tracking*


Refine and roll out a new process for tracking vendor and contractor expenses, including intake, approval, and reconciliation steps.


Document the process and train relevant stakeholders on the new workflow.


Accounts Receivable \& Collections


Clean up the existing AR and collections process end to end.


Define and finalize a clear write\-off policy and an aging/escalation process for outstanding receivables.

*Documentation Sprint*


Partner with Finance and Operations leadership on a focused sprint to launch a streamlined SOP architecture and documentation system.


Help structure, write, and organize SOPs so they are consistent, easy to find, and easy to maintain going forward.

*Expense Report Process Review*


Review the current expense report process following its recent update.


Identify and recommend any further refinements needed for accuracy, compliance, and ease of use.

*Salesforce / NetSuite Integration*

* Work with Tech and Finance leadership to project\-manage the Salesforce/NetSuite integration fix through to completion.
* Track open issues, coordinate across stakeholders, and keep the initiative moving toward the finish line.
* Cross\-Departmental Accountability
* Ensure meeting notes and action items are distributed promptly and clearly across all workstreams.
* Track deadlines and proactively hold team members accountable to their commitments.

*End\-of\-Year Sentiment \& Impact Review*


Conduct a retrospective/sentiment review at the end of the engagement (or calendar year) to assess what was accomplished.


Measure and summarize impact against relevant KPIs, and capture lessons learned for future process work.

**What You'll Do —** Supplier \& Cross\-Functional Support (Growth Area)


As the Finance x Operations project progresses and bandwidth allows, this role will expand to include:

* Serving as a point of contact liaising with suppliers on behalf of Operations, coordinating communications and following up on open items.
* Supporting cross\-functional projects with other internal departments beyond Finance and Operations, as priorities arise.
* Taking on additional operations projects and initiatives as assigned, based on demonstrated capacity and performance.

**What You'll Bring**

* Exceptional project management skills — the ability to organize multiple concurrent workstreams, track details, and reliably drive projects to completion.
* Confidence and polish working with, and managing up to, senior leadership; comfortable pushing timelines and holding stakeholders accountable.
* A proactive, ownership\-oriented mindset — someone who identifies what needs to happen next and moves it forward without waiting to be asked.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for documentation, process write\-ups, and stakeholder updates.
* Comfort working across ambiguity and shifting priorities as the role grows from a defined project into broader cross\-functional support.
* 1–3\+ years of relevant work experience in operations, project management, finance, or a related field; Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Familiarity with financial processes (AR/collections, expense management, vendor/contractor payments) and tools like Salesforce or NetSuite is a plus, but not required — we're prioritizing project management and leadership\-facing skills over specific tool expertise.

**Engagement Details**

* This is a temporary, W2 role, not initially benefits\-eligible, unless and until converted to permanent employment.
* Primary focus for the engagement is the Finance x Operations project described above, with growing scope into supplier liaison and cross\-departmental project work as capacity allows.
* Performance and fit will be evaluated on an ongoing basis, with a formal check\-in near the end of the term to discuss extension, conversion to a permanent Operations Associate role, or conclusion of the engagement.

jobs.description:
**Project Manager (Technical)**
-------------------------------


**Location:** Remote US


**Who We Are:**
---------------



Enterra Solutions is introducing the world's top brands and market leaders to true enterprise intelligence. Powered by our groundbreaking Enterra Autonomous Decision Science™ Platform, we're delivering enterprise\-wide optimization and decision\-making to help businesses best achieve their most complex goals. We're providing real human insights to facilitate smarter, faster market moves. And we're turning unknowns into opportunities for unprecedented growth and agility. All with next\-level speed, accuracy, autonomy, and continuous learning. We're shaping the future \- join a dynamic, collaborative team where your contributions drive real impact.


**Overview**



The Project Manager (PM) oversees the planning, execution, and successful completion of projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, client expectations, and quality standards. The PM serves as a central point of communication between stakeholders and project teams, manages resources effectively, mitigates risks, and drives continuous process improvement to maximize the success and profitability of projects.


**What You'll Do:**
-------------------


* Define project scope, deliverables, tasks, timelines, and charters; develop comprehensive project plans in MS Project and Excel aligned with client and organizational requirements.
* Monitor progress against plans, adjust timelines and resources as needed, ensure high\-quality delivery, and manage project closure activities including documentation, postmortems, and lessons learned.
* Allocate tasks, assign backup resources, provide guidance and direction to team members, and ensure efficient utilization of internal and external project resources.
* Identify root causes of issues, develop effective resolutions, and implement risk mitigation and contingency plans to prevent project delays or obstacles.
* Serve as the central point of contact for project teams, clients, and internal stakeholders; provide regular updates, schedule and facilitate meetings, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Manage project\-related Teams sites, PMO meetings, and documentation; maintain organized and accurate records of all project communications and materials.
* Perform other related duties as required, including coordination with external stakeholders, vendors, or partners.

**Your Skill\-set:**
--------------------


**Requirements:**


* Bachelor's of Master's degree in business, project management, or a related field.
* Experience delivering technology solutions within the Consumer\-Packaged Goods (CPG) industry required, ideally within trade promotion management (TPM).
* 3–5 years of experience managing technical client\-facing projects within the CPG industry, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholders, project scope, resources, schedules, and communications effectively.
* Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall methodologies, with hands\-on experience using Jira and Microsoft Project.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating with technical teams, clients, and vendors.


**Nice\-to\-haves:**


* Project management certification such as PMP or CAPM.
* Master's degree in business, project management, or related field.
* Experience managing projects in SaaS, technology, or client\-facing consulting environments.


**Additional Information**



Must reside in the US – preferably in the Northeast or Mid\-Atlantic Regions. Remote work permitted. Occasionally, travel may be needed based on client, project, or business need. Candidates must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship. This is a full\-time position with benefits.


**What We Offer:**
------------------



We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer:


* Competitive compensation
* Fully paid "employee only" health insurance (medical, dental, and vision) or employer contribution toward various health insurance plans
* 15 days PTO \+ 7 holidays \+ 3 floating holidays
* 401k offering


**Equal Employment Opportunity:**



Enterra Solutions provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API. Our private label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.



As a remote\-first company, we're focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.



We are looking for a motivated Project Manager to join our growing organization. This position is based in the United States and can work cross\-functionally on projects across all teams, with a likely focus on revenue operations for enterprise sales teams. You are forward\-thinking and create efficiencies while pushing through roadblocks. This role reports to the PMO manager.


**You Will:**


* Work closely with senior leadership and high performing revenue driven teams.
* Take initiative and not wait for work to be assigned and contextualized.
* Collaborate across departments to accomplish projects, processes and high priority tasks.
* Proactively identify needs of project deliverables from launch through close.
* Identify appropriate stakeholders on new projects and work with third\-party vendors, managing tracking of progress.
* Monitor the progress of projects and adapt to ensure successful outcomes.
* Support several levels of stakeholders including the CEO, other C\-level executives, and project leads on ad hoc requests.
* Create detailed technical documentation of errors, issues, and resolutions.
* Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster—it's your default, not an afterthought.


**You Have:**


* Experience in or strong familiarity with SaaS companies and startup environments, with the ability to operate at startup speed.
* Experience supporting revenue teams (sales, client success, or partnerships) preferred.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, including attention to detail and managing up and across the organization in order to execute projects.
* Ability to work independently and follow processes with minimal supervision.
* Willing and excited to learn about new parts of the business.
* Interest in understanding our business and array of B2B2C SaaS products.
* Proficiency in understanding and creating reports and manipulating data with AI tools, SQL and Excel.
* A belief that AI is reshaping work, you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do.


**Pay transparency:** $90,000 \+ for base salary, depending on experience. Full time employee compensation includes an Incentive Stock Option (ISO) grant, subject to Board approval.


**Expected interview process:** Recruiter Conversation \- Hiring Manager Interview \- Loop round:


**Expected onboarding process:** Onboarding at Array is active, not passive: new hires spend their first two weeks building fluency in our products, customers, and value proposition, and are expected to pass scored assessments before beginning role\-specific work. Success means meeting defined performance standards through a six\-month evaluation period — with continuous feedback and ongoing accountability as core parts of working at Array.


**Array Offers All Full Time Employees the following Benefits and Perks:**


* Full medical, dental, and vision, premiums covered at 100% for full\-time employees and 70% for dependents
* Unlimited PTO and sick leave \+ 14 company holidays to encourage a healthy work\-life blend
* 100% 401k match up to 4% with immediate vesting
* Generous and competitive parental leave for all parents
* $1,000 desk setup subsidy to set\-up your unique remote office
* $100/month to subsidize wifi/cell phone expenses
* Summer Fridays (half\-day Fridays) typically from late May to the end of August
* Commuter benefits for those who choose to go into our New York City or San Francisco office spaces

**You are organized, driven, and thrive in an ownership role.**  

  

The Senior Program Manager serves as the primary point of contact and gateway into the studio for a defined set of clients, including Syneos Communications agencies and Syneos Health Clinical departments. Acting as a holistic business partner, the Senior Program Manager ensures the studio delivers on client needs and expectations. This role is accountable for ensuring overall client satisfaction. The Senior Program Manager reports directly to the Director, Program Management.  

  

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for defining project parameters, contributing to creative ideation sessions, and participating in tactical recommendation brainstorming. Once project parameters are aligned between the client and the studio, the Senior Program Manager leads and oversees the project from start to finish, including budget development, timeline creation, and management of deliverable routing. The Senior Program Manager should possess deep knowledge of the creative process and have experience with print production.  

  

This role partners closely with the studio teams and serves as the primary lead for one our internal communication teams, ensuring that work is routed appropriately to necessary stakeholders. The Senior Program Manager ensures that the Creative team is fully integrated into the workflow and redirects relevant projects to them as needed.  

  

**Client and Business Management*** Serves as the studio’s lead representative, ensuring client expectations are consistently met.
* Builds, maintains, and nurtures strong relationships with key stakeholders across disciplines.
* Acts as an advocate for the studio by continually building organizational awareness of its value, including coordinating capability presentations, and proactively promoting and recommending studio services as appropriate.
* Handles challenges professionally and navigates disagreements diplomatically to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.

This role will serve as a deputy and trusted right hand to the Sr Program Manager, helping lead day\-to\-day contract operations, client delivery, workforce management, technical execution, and strategic growth. jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**A bit about this role:**


Devoted Medical is building clinical programs to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted's values of treating every member like family. Medication plays a crucial role in helping people manage chronic conditions, but in many cases effective medication management is limited by barriers to access, uncoordinated prescribing, or a failure to use the most effective evidence\-based medication therapies. For example, despite a mountain of evidence, less than 1 in 10 people with congestive heart failure (CHF) are prescribed evidence\-based medications proven to save lives and prevent hospitalizations.


Devoted's clinical pharmacy team aims to support improved therapeutics for Devoted members. It supports this work in three ways:

* *Conducting medication reviews (via direct member engagement and pharmacist consult support for other clinicians)*
* *Virtual pharmacist\-led or clinician\-led care via telemedicine to close therapy gaps*
* *Coordinating care for changes in therapy by counseling members and engaging prescribers and pharmacies*

**This work is done in service of a number of goals. The clinical pharmacy team drives Devoted's quality and Medicare Stars performance across multiple programs such as:**

* **SUPD (Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes)**
* **SPC (Statin Use in Persons with Heart Disease)**
* **MTM (Medication Therapy Management)**
* **TCC (Total Cost of Care)**
* **Polypharmacy**


During appointments with our pharmacists and clinicians, medication opportunities are identified.That's where Pharmacy Care Coordinators (PCCs) step in. PCCs ensure recommendations reach the outside provider, follow up with pharmacies on claims issues, pick\-up confirmations, or discontinuations, and keep the member informed of any changes along the way.


As a PCC, you will partner with our Clinical Pharmacy and Operations teams on outreach, coordination, and follow\-up to provide best in class care to our members, as part of a mission\-driven, team\-oriented, joyful culture.

 **Responsibilities and Impact will include:**

* Supports clinical outreach campaigns by making outbound calls and utilizing portal chat to members to schedule appointments with the pharmacist team to address clinical gaps or medication concerns
* Supports cost of care efforts by reaching out to providers and members to offer lower cost alternative medication options
* Manages an assigned caseload which may require provider, pharmacy, and/or member follow\-up to address medication recommendations, concerns, or questions
* Independently oversees assigned cases and outreaches with timely follow\-up, clear next steps, and thorough documentation
* Helps members navigate their Devoted Health benefits

* Assists with training and shadowing when new team members join the team
* Participates in team and pharmacy department activities and responsibilities

**Required skills and experience:**

* At least 3 years of work experience in health care or retail pharmacy
* Active National PTCB Certification
* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to members, providers, and pharmacies
* Comfortable managing daily responsibilities and tasks independently
* Ability to shift between tasks, projects, and priorities frequently

**Desired skills and experience:**

* Highly organized and detail\-driven
* Comfortable learning new software and adapting as tools and workflows evolve
* Adaptable and flexible, with a willingness to take on new or shifting tasks positively
* A true team player who brings new ideas to the table, works through solutions with others, and lifts up their teammates

* A transparent communicator about your work, what's going well, and what's not, with a thoughtful eye for improving processes

jobs.title: Community Health Worker - Lauderdale, Colbert, and Franklin Counties
jobs.description:
**About A.C.T.I.O.N.**



A.C.T.I.O.N. is a proposed community\-wide overdose prevention initiative that will expand access to FDA\-approved opioid overdose reversal medications (OORMs), community training, and treatment referral pathways across the twelve counties of Alabama's 4th Congressional District (Lauderdale, Colbert, Franklin, Marion, Lamar, Fayette, Walker, Winston, Cullman, Marshall, DeKalb, and Blount). This position is contingent upon receipt of federal SAMHSA grant funding.



**Position Summary**



The Community Health Worker (CHW) for Cluster 1 is responsible for opioid overdose reversal medication (OORM) distribution, overdose\-recognition and response training, and referral follow\-up within Lauderdale, Colbert, and Franklin Counties, working in close partnership with the cluster's designated community partner organization. This locally embedded, field\-based role requires strong ties to the assigned counties.



**Key Responsibilities**



* Distribute FDA\-approved OORMs (naloxone and nalmefene) to bystanders, community sectors, and rural first responders within Lauderdale, Colbert, and Franklin Counties.
* Deliver overdose\-recognition, response, and OORM\-administration training to both traditional partners (healthcare providers, pharmacies, EMS, school systems) and non\-traditional community sectors (e.g., gas station attendants, motel staff, retail employees, postal workers).
* Train local Training\-of\-Trainers cohorts to extend the training curriculum further into the community.
* Support referral and linkage follow\-up for individuals identified through prevention or overdose response activities, in coordination with the Program Coordinator/Data Lead.
* Maintain local relationships with the cluster's designated community partner, healthcare providers, pharmacies, faith\-based organizations, and schools.
* Complete required data collection instruments accurately and submit them to the Program Coordinator/Data Lead on the required schedule.
* Participate in the Local Community Prevention Collaborative and community\-facing outreach and distribution events.

**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in public health, social work, or a related field
* Local, rural\-based residency or strong ties to Lauderdale, Colbert, and Franklin Counties, with community trust and lived familiarity with the area.
* Community health worker certification or equivalent lived or professional experience preferred.
* Strong local community relationships and the trust of area residents.
* Ability to complete Aletheia House's overdose\-recognition and naloxone\-administration training during onboarding (provided).
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel within the assigned counties for distribution and training visits.
* Comfortable with basic data entry and reporting tools.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

Aletheia House is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Candidates are selected based on merit and qualifications only.


**Schedule**



Monday\-Friday 9:00am\-5:00pm; occasional weekends and evenings for community events

jobs.title: Training and Commercial Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Training and Commercial Operations Coordinator**
==================================================


**About InSource Solutions**
----------------------------



InSource Solutions is a leading industrial software solutions provider and a trusted partner of AVEVA, a global leader in engineering and industrial software. Leveraging AVEVA's portfolio and the portfolios of our other partners, we specialize in delivering cutting\-edge services and solutions that empower businesses across various industries to optimize their operations, improve efficiency, and achieve their digital transformation goals.


**Position Summary**
--------------------



The Training and Commercial Operations Coordinator is responsible for the end\-to\-end coordination and administration of InSource's training programs while also supporting sales and operations teams with customer onboarding and commercial account setup.



This role serves as the primary point of contact for training registrations, inquiries, scheduling, payment coordination, and logistics, helping ensure a seamless experience for students while supporting trainers in delivering an organized and financially effective training operation.



The Training and Commercial Operations Coordinator also supports customer onboarding activities, including documentation collection, credit checks, insurance compliance, and account setup. By coordinating closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Client Success, this role helps ensure customer accounts are properly established and compliant before order processing begins.



Success in this role requires strong organization, attention to detail, customer service, cross\-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and stakeholders across both training and commercial operations.



**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* **Training Calendar and Scheduling:** Collaborate with the VP of Client Success and dedicated trainers to develop and maintain the annual training calendar. Partner with Marketing to keep the training schedule on the company website current, including providing the finalized annual schedule and communicating timely updates when classes are cancelled or reach capacity.
* **Class Enrollment Management:** Work with the VP of Client Success and trainers to identify underenrolled classes and determine whether cancellation is appropriate. As a general guideline, classes with fewer than four registrants two weeks before the start date may be considered for cancellation. Notify registered students of cancellations and proactively provide alternative options.
* **Training Registration Processing:** Process inbound training registrations received through the company website and direct email. Ensure each registration includes valid payment or an authorized coupon and confirm enrollment only after applicable requirements are satisfied.
* **Payment and Coupon Administration:** Process credit card payments directly, prepare quotes for purchase\-order or invoice\-based registrations, and process resulting purchase orders. Validate training coupons against authorized coupon types, including unlimited training subscriptions and System Integrator seats.
* **Prerequisite Validation:** Review and validate student prerequisites for classes that require them before confirming enrollment.
* **Training Sales Support:** Create training quotes in support of active sales opportunities and respond promptly to training inquiries received through the website and direct email.
* **Third\-Party Training Administration:** Coordinate pass\-through training registrations with third\-party providers such as AVEVA and Ocean Data Systems. Register students with the provider, create associated quotes, process purchase orders, invoices, or credit card payments, and facilitate payment to third\-party providers in a timely manner.
* **Training Materials and Logistics:** Monitor and maintain adequate inventory of training manuals and coordinate reorders with suppliers when needed. Ship training manuals to students before class start dates and update NetSuite with class\-specific URLs for student materials.
* **Customer Onboarding and Account Setup:** Coordinate customer onboarding and account setup, ensuring required documentation is complete and accurate to establish InSource Solutions Group companies as approved vendors.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Intelerad, we believe the path to answers in healthcare should be clear\-whether you are waiting for a diagnosis or trying to expedite one. Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark.


Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking \#1 for PACS Europe UK/Ireland in the 2026 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non\-US) report.

 **Job Description**  

Intelerad is seeking a Technical Implementation Specialist II to lead the delivery of complex technical and workflow implementation services for our Radiology Healthcare IT solutions. Operating with increased autonomy, you will design integration workflows, configure and validate enterprise systems, and guide clients through complex go\-lives. You will collaborate cross\-functionally with Project Management, Applications, and Workflow teams, and will contribute to continuous improvement by sharing implementation insights across the organization.


InteleShare is Intelerad’s medical image exchange platform, used by healthcare organizations to securely share imaging studies and related clinical information across facilities, providers, and care networks. This role will be part of the Technical Services group for the InteleShare team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead HL7/DICOM integration design, configuration, and deployment for complex client environments, ensuring alignment with clinical goals and Intelerad best practices.
* Diagnose and resolve advanced technical and workflow issues across applications, integrations, and infrastructure, both remotely and on\-site.
* Partner with Project Management to drive system integration and functionality milestones, providing regular status updates to clients and third\-party vendors.
* Design and deliver structured training programs for end users and administrators, adapting delivery to meet diverse learning needs and clinical settings.
* Document and maintain implementation artifacts — including configurations, workflows, and architecture changes — and contribute findings to post\-implementation reviews that drive process improvement.
* Assist with TS requests which may include custom reports, queries, identifying bugs, complex DICOM/HL7 migrations or workflows.

 **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Medical Imaging Sciences, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in healthcare IT implementation, system integration, or a related technical role.
* Demonstrated proficiency with HL7/DICOM standards and experience configuring healthcare system integrations.
* Proficiency with Linux command\-line interface and experience with SQL databases (e.g., Sybase, PostgreSQL, MS SQL).
* Valid government\-issued identification; eligibility for security\-related clearance where required.
* Ability to travel as required to support on\-site client engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications \& Special Requirements**

* In\-depth understanding of radiology workflows, including modality, PACS, RIS, and clinical imaging processes.
* Experience working with AWS cloud infrastructure and services.
* Understanding of API architecture and working with data formats such as JSON.
* Experience mentoring junior implementation staff or delivering structured clinical training programs.
* Exposure to enterprise go\-live planning and change management in healthcare environments.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud technologies.
* PostgreSQL database and query development.
* Familiarity with Python notebook development, Visual Studio Code, GitHub, and AWS SageMaker.
* Knowledge of InteleShare and/or Image Exchange platforms.

**Travel Requirements**

* Up to 10% travel may be required, occasionally on short notice.


This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

 **Additional Information**  

The base pay for this position ranges from $78,750\-$105,000/yr USD within any geographic market in the US. Pay may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


Remote


**Employment Type**

**Compensation**
----------------

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.


  
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that.


But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.


We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.


At Headway, we're building a new mental healthcare system from the ground up—one that's accessible, effective, and built to scale. Providers on Headway are responsible for their own coding and documentation, and many are new to billing insurance in private practice. We review that documentation against clinical documentation standards — and when a provider has questions about what came back, someone needs to give them a clear, accurate answer they can act on. That's this role.


As a **Senior Clinical \& Coding Operations Associate**, you're the coding and billing expert providers reach when they have questions about their documentation review results. You'll interpret those results, determine whether a finding is actually correct, and explain what it means in language a clinician can act on. You'll also be the person who catches it when a review result is wrong — and gets it fixed.


**A Certified Professional Coder (CPC) certification is required**. All care on Headway is outpatient behavioral health, delivered in person or virtually.


**This is not an auditing role, and it is not a production coding role.** A separate team performs the documentation audits; you won't be auditing charts or coding claims. You'll apply the same depth of coding knowledge to a different problem — getting providers to the right answer, and making sure the guidance they receive is correct.


**You Will:**


* Interpret behavioral health documentation and coding review results (ICD\-10\-CM and CPT) and translate them into clear, actionable provider education and feedback
* Determine whether a flagged finding is accurate — confirming genuine documentation and coding errors, and identifying findings that were flagged incorrectly so they can be corrected and escalated
* Serve as a subject matter expert by answering provider and internal\-team questions on behavioral health coding and documentation (ICD\-10\-CM and CPT) and billing findings
* Deliver clear, accurate, and empathetic responses to providers through our support channels (e.g., Zendesk)
* Contribute to provider education efforts, including drafting content, identifying documentation gaps, and advising on documentation standards
* Partner with our Customer Experience (CX) team to build knowledge base content and resources that help resolve more questions without direct SME support
* Provide insights on coding trends, identify risk areas, and recommend improvements to tooling, process, and training
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners on initiatives that improve the provider audit\-support experience
* Stay current with evolving coding guidelines, payer rules, and industry standards through continuing education and independent learning

**You’d be a great fit if….**


* Have a CPC certification (required) and 2\-3 years of experience in outpatient or professional\-services coding, ideally within a behavioral health setting
* Possess a strong grasp of ICD\-10\-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding guidelines and the documentation requirements
* Communicate clearly and empathetically, especially when educating providers or discussing sensitive feedback
* Have the ability to balance supportive coaching and enforcing provider policies regarding payer standards and compliance regulations
* Hold a CPMA certification (nice to have)
* Can independently reach the correct coding and documentation conclusion on a behavioral health note and defend it — including disagreeing with a review result when the documentation supports you
* Are energized by making providers and frontline teams self\-sufficient, rather than by reviewing charts
* Previously educated providers on medical decision making (MDM) for outpatient Evaluation and Management (E/M) services
* Bring a high level of attention to detail and comfort working independently in a fast\-paced, digital environment
* Are tech\-savvy: you can navigate Google Workspace, Zoom, and EMR platforms—or you're excited to learn
* Are energized by working cross\-functionally and driving quality at scale in a tech\-forward setting

**Compensation and Benefits:**


The expected base pay range for this position is $76,160 \- $112,000 based on a variety

**Join Our Team at Mindoula Health!**


**Position:** Care Manager, Suicide Prevention Program  

**Location:** Washington State  

**Type:** Full\-Time, Remote

Are you passionate about making a difference in mental health? Mindoula Health is expanding our Nevada team and seeking experienced Care Managers for our Suicide Prevention Program. Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3\. Zones are determined by your zip code; if you’re within 100 miles of a listed metro area (straight\-line radius), you’re included in that Zone. Please

### **Your Zone**


Check


Read more about our Benefits.  

  

  

### **Company Description**


Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise\-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.


### **Team Description**


The Dropbox Customer Experience and Success (CXS) Team shapes how more than 700 million users and 575k teams worldwide interact with our products. We turn insights into actions, bringing empathy and expertise to every touchpoint. Our team embraces resourcefulness and curiosity, pushing boundaries—and ourselves—to improve the customer experience and ensure our customers achieve their desired outcomes with our products, leading to increased customer lifetime value, retention, and growth. Every team member contributes their unique perspective as we collaborate across the organization to amplify the customer voice. If you're passionate about bringing joy, humanity, and simplicity to how people interact with Dropbox, join our Customer Experience and Success team.


### **Virtual First**


Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in\-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on\-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.


This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5\-10% of the year or 2\-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.


### **AI Fluency**


AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.
We look for four key behaviors in candidates:
* **Ownership**: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
* **Experimentation:** You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
* **Leverage:** You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
* **Learning:** You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.  

  

Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted.
  

Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

jobs.description:
**Overview of Job Function**

The Manager of Customer Success leads a team of Customer Success Managers responsible for driving adoption, value realization, retention, and expansion across a defined portfolio of Verint customers. This role owns the operating rhythm for the team, including renewal readiness, CSQL pipeline generation, customer health management, and playbook execution. The Manager is accountable for team\-level revenue outcomes (revenue retention, renewal rates, and expansion pipeline) and for developing CSMs into high\-performing customer advocates. This role partners cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services to ensure customers realize measurable value from Verint's platform.


**Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership \& Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers across varying experience levels.
* Own the full people management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, development plans, and performance management.
* Establish and run a consistent team operating rhythm, including account health reviews, forecast calls, account planning sessions, and strategy discussions.
* Set clear expectations for CSM activity, output quality, and customer outcomes; hold the team accountable to those standards.
* Build team capabilities through structured coaching on executive engagement, business review delivery, value realization storytelling, and expansion identification.
* Manage team capacity and workload distribution to ensure balanced account coverage.

**Revenue Ownership \& Customer Outcomes**

* Own team\-level targets for revenue retention, and CSQL\-generated expansion pipeline.
* Hold the team accountable for documenting customer outcomes and value realization, ensuring success stories and measurable results are captured and shared.
* Drive CSM execution against renewal timelines, ensuring early risk identification and proactive intervention.
* Oversee CSQL pipeline generation and qualification, ensuring the team identifies and advances expansion opportunities through the defined approval and staging process.
* Monitor customer health scores, adoption metrics, and risk indicators at the portfolio level; take action when trends signal churn or contraction risk.
* Ensure consistent execution of scheduled customer check\-ins, success plans, and periodic business reviews across the team's portfolio.

**Customer Engagement \& Escalation Management**

* Serve as the escalation point for at\-risk accounts, engaging directly with customer executives when needed to resolve issues and protect revenue.
* Join strategic customer meetings, executive business reviews, and renewal conversations to reinforce Verint's commitment and value.
* Coach CSMs on building and maintaining multi\-threaded relationships with customer stakeholders, including economic buyers and operational sponsors.
* Ensure timely identification, documentation, and resolution of customer concerns across the team.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Represent the voice of the customer in cross\-functional forums with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services.
* Partner with Sales leadership on account strategy alignment, handoff processes, and joint renewal/expansion planning.
* Provide structured product feedback to Product teams based on aggregated customer input and adoption data.
* Coordinate with Professional Services and Support to ensure delivery expectations align with customer goals.

**Process Ownership \& Operational Excellence**

* Own playbook execution and iteration for the team, ensuring CSMs follow established engagement models, success planning frameworks, and escalation protocols.
* Utilize CS platform tools and dashboards (e.g., Totango) to track customer health, adoption trends, and team performance.
* Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement in workflows, templates, and reporting to increase team efficiency and consistency.
* Deliver accurate renewal and expansion forecasts to leadership on a regular cadence.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 4\+ years of people management experience leading customer\-facing teams, with 6\+ years of overall experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related function.
* Demonstrated experience managing a team accountable for a book of business, including renewal and expansion targets.
* Working knowledge of CS platforms and tooling (e.g., Totango, Gainsight) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).
* Proficiency in using data, dashboards, and health scoring frameworks to manage customer portfolios and drive team actions.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and relationship\-building skills with the ability to engage customer executives.
* Experience operating in a cross\-functional, matrixed environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize across multiple accounts, team members, and competing demands.
* Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.
* Successful completion of a background screening process including, but not limited to, employment verifications, criminal search, OFAC, SS Verification, as well as credit and drug screening, where applicable and in accordance with federal and local regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in workforce management, customer experience, or enterprise SaaS environments.
* Track record of improving net revenue retention or gross renewal rates within a managed portfolio.
* Familiarity with customer segmentation models and tiered engagement strategies.
* Background in coaching and developing Customer Success professionals.
* Experience driving or contributing to a structured expansion pipeline program (e.g. CSQL or similar qualification\-based model).

jobs.description:
###### **A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US**


We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

#### **About Foundant**


At Foundant, we build mission\-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.


We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of \~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

#### **Where You’ll Work:**

* As a remote\-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
* With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
##### ***What******You’ll******Do:***

* You'll build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients across our portfolio, serving as a strategic advisor and advocate — because renewals are built on relationships, not just contracts
* You'll own the renewal process end to end and proactively identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities aligned with client goals and product capabilities
* You'll track and assess client engagement, satisfaction, and usage metrics to ensure high retention and get ahead of churn risk
* You'll partner closely with Customer Success to align on client needs, share feedback, and coordinate efforts that drive client success — because we do more good when we work together
* You'll develop account plans for key clients, outlining growth strategies, risk mitigation, and engagement tactics
* You'll maintain a deep understanding of Foundant, GivingData, and SmartSimple offerings so you can guide clients toward the solutions and outcomes that matter most to their mission
* Other duties as assigned

##### ***What******You’ll******Need:***

* 3\+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or a related role in SaaS or technology environments
* A proven track record of managing renewals and driving upsell/cross\-sell outcomes
* Experience working cross\-functionally in a fast\-paced, client\-centric environment
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and customer success platforms
* Must be legally eligible to work in Canada or the United States

**Preferred:**

* Experience in the nonprofit, philanthropic, or government sectors
* Understanding of SaaS metrics and client health scoring

##### ***What******You’ll******Bring to our Team Dynamics:***

* **Adaptive Achievement:** Owns a full renewal pipeline independently — juggling multiple accounts and deadlines, and adapting account plans as client needs and priorities shift
* **Productive Collaboration:** Builds trusted, cross\-functional relationships with Customer Success and other internal teams to keep client outcomes aligned, because we do more good together
* **Service Orientation:** Anticipates client needs before renewal conversations happen, understanding that a client's success is what makes the relationship — and the business — sustainable
* **Business Insight:** Understands how Foundant, GivingData, and SmartSimple solutions drive measurable outcomes for organizations in the philanthropic and social good sector, and uses that knowledge to identify genuine upsell and cross\-sell opportunities

##### ***Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:***

* At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not\-for\-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real\-world change.
* We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
* With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well\-being and professional success.
* We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
* As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
* You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
* Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

  

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants
