jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

About TSOLife

TSOLife is an AI\-powered resident insight and experience platform providing automated data collection, business intelligence, and actionable insights for the senior living industry. We leverage cutting\-edge technology to allow businesses to make data\-informed decisions and truly personalize the resident experience.

Customer Success Team

The Customer Success team owns the customer journey from onboarding through adoption, retention, and growth. We combine high\-touch relationship management with data, technology, and proactive account strategy to ensure customers realize measurable value from TSOLife. Our CSMs are growth partners who identify risk early, drive adoption across their accounts, and continuously look for opportunities to deepen customer value.

The Role

The Customer Success Manager owns the success and growth of an assigned portfolio of TSOLife customers. You will build trusted relationships from community users through corporate executives while using account data, platform adoption, and customer goals to determine where to focus your attention.

This is a proactive role. You will be expected to identify risk before the customer raises it, drive adoption when usage is falling short, lead difficult conversations when necessary, and recognize opportunities to expand the relationship.

**Position Type**

Fulltime, Salary

**Location**

Remote

**What You’ll Do**

**Own the Full Customer Lifecycle**

* Serve as the primary strategic point of contact, building trusted relationships with community users and corporate stakeholders.
* Own the full implementation and onboarding lifecycle for assigned accounts.

**Drive Account Health, Retention \& Growth**

* Monitor engagement and platform usage and adoption metrics, proactively diagnosing barriers and executing corrective action plans before they become retention risks.
* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities as accounts mature, translating usage patterns into a broader growth strategy.
* Deliver QBRs and executive reporting that demonstrate value, insights, outcomes, and forward strategy to senior stakeholders.

**Champion Full Feature Product Adoption**

* Stay fluent in all TSOLife products and updates, enabling accurate communication and guidance for customers across our full solution set — not just the module they started with.
* Create and maintain training and enablement resources to accelerate adoption and support new releases.
* Provide timely, high\-quality support that resolves issues and keeps daily operations running smoothly for every account.

**Partner Across the Business**

* Advocate for customer needs internally, gathering feedback and partnering with Product, Engineering, and leadership on improvements.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure a cohesive customer experience that supports company\-wide objectives.
* Ensure the timely delivery of customer\-facing assets, including calendars, newsletters, and monthly content, as applicable.

**Build Repeatable Customer Success Practices**

* Maintain accurate documentation and reporting on account status, risks, value metrics, and engagement activities.
* Champion industry best practices and emerging trends to continuously raise the bar on customer outcomes.
* Take on additional responsibilities as they arise — this is a builder's seat in a growing department.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Proven Customer Success Ownership**

* Experience owning the full customer relationship \- onboarding, adoption, retention, and growth with a track record of proactively catching account risk before it becomes a churn conversation, not just responding to tickets as they come in.

**Product Comprehension**

* The ability to learn a multi\-module SaaS platform deeply enough to recognize when a customer's actual goals call for a different or additional part of the product than what they originally asked for.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Comfort operating as the bridge between Product, Support, Sales, and the customer, translating customer feedback into something the internal team can act on, and translating roadmap and constraints into something a community or corporate stakeholder can understand.

**Business \& Data Fluency**

* Ability to walk a corporate stakeholder through usage metrics, adoption trends, and ROI in a QBR, and tie those numbers to a forward strategy — not just deliver a relationship\-first status update.
* Comfortable balancing white\-glove service with hard conversations about risk and performance.

**High\-Touch Service at Scale**

* Experience providing individualized, high\-touch service to enterprise or senior\-living\-caliber accounts, with the judgment to know when a tailored approach is worth the extra effort and when it isn't.

**Creative Problem Solving**

* A resourceful, first\-principles approach to genuinely ambiguous problems — finding workarounds within real constraints rather than stalling at “that's not possible,” without cutting corners on documentation, security, or scope.

**Execution at Volume**

* Strong personal systems for managing a full portfolio of accounts simultaneously, with the organizational discipline to make sure nothing goes quiet even as volume grows.
* Shown Project management and process development experience

**Industry \& Technical Fluency**

* Experience in senior living, healthcare, or another relationship\-intensive service industry preferred.
* High comfort with technology, including messaging, video conferencing, workflow, and database tools.

**Values Alignment:** 

* A genuine fit with TSOLife's values Integrity, Learning, Resilience, Compassion, Self\-Awareness, and Team Work.

Why You’ll Love it Here

jobs.title: Learning & Development Specialist – Go To Market
jobs.description:
Harbor is looking for a full\-time, temporary, Learning \& Development Specialist (Go To Market) for a 5–6\-month engagement. The Learning \& Development Specialist (Go To Market) is a contract role responsible for designing and developing high\-quality learning solutions that build critical sales enablement capabilities across Harbor's Client Engagement / Delivery organizations. Working closely with Delivery leaders, subject matter experts, and Learning \& Development, this role will translate business priorities, capability needs, and subject matter expertise into practical, engaging, and scalable learning experiences.



This is a hands\-on individual contributor role responsible for designing, developing, and implementing learning solutions in support of GTM priorities. The Specialist will independently drive assigned learning workstreams from needs assessment and design through development and implementation, working directly with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand learning gaps and translate them into effective learning solutions.



The role requires strong instructional design and content development expertise, project management capabilities, excellent communication skills, and an understanding of how professionals learn and operate within a fast\-paced professional services or consulting environment. The role will work within established GTM priorities and program direction, partnering closely with Learning \& Development to ensure learning solutions align with Harbor's overall learning approach and standards, onboarding experience, brand, UGE, and broader learning ecosystem.



#### **Key Responsibilities:**


**Instructional Design \& Content Development:**


* Partner with GTM leaders and subject matter experts to identify learning needs and translate business priorities, knowledge gaps, and complex subject matter into clear learning objectives and effective learning solutions.
* Design and develop practical, engaging learning experiences across multiple modalities, including instructor\-led and virtual learning, digital learning, presentations, toolkits, job aids, practice activities, assessments, and reinforcement resources.
* Apply adult learning and instructional design principles to recommend appropriate learning approaches, modalities, sequencing, and reinforcement within established program priorities.
* Curate and adapt existing internal and external content where appropriate to accelerate development and create cohesive learning experiences.
* Develop facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, case studies, knowledge checks, and other resources to support effective delivery and application.
* Ensure learning materials are polished, consistent, accessible, and aligned with Harbor's learning and brand standards.


 **Learning Project Management:**


* Independently manage assigned learning projects from initial discovery through development, launch, and evaluation.
* Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and stakeholder responsibilities.
* Coordinate content development and review cycles across Delivery leaders/subject matter experts, Client Engagement, L\&D, and other stakeholders.
* Manage multiple concurrent learning initiatives while maintaining quality and meeting agreed\-upon timelines.
* Proactively identify risks, dependencies, scope considerations, and potential barriers and recommend solutions to keep projects moving forward.
* Facilitate effective project meetings, design sessions, content reviews, and stakeholder discussions.


**Stakeholder Management \& Business Partnership:**


* Build effective working relationships with GTM leaders, subject matter experts, Learning \& Development, and cross\-functional partners.
* Lead discovery conversations with stakeholders and SMEs to understand business context, target audiences, performance gaps, and learning needs.
* Apply instructional design expertise to recommend effective learning solutions within established GTM priorities and program direction.
* Synthesize stakeholder and SME input into clear learning requirements, content, and deliverables.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders at varying levels of the organization, including senior leaders, and proactively manage feedback, decisions, and next steps.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen and an understanding of the pace, client orientation, and performance expectations of a professional services environment.
* Partner with external learning/content providers as needed, coordinating inputs, reviews, and deliverables and ensuring resulting content meets defined business and learning requirements.


**Learning Technology \& Implementation:**


* Develop and maintain digital learning content using tools such as Articulate 360\.
* Support the implementation and launch of learning experiences through Workday Learning, including course setup, testing, learner journeys, materials, and launch readiness as appropriate.
* Conduct quality assurance and testing to ensure learning content and experiences function as intended.
* Leverage learning technology and AI\-enabled tools, where appropriate, to increase the efficiency and scalability of content development.


**Measurement \& Continuous Improvement:**


* Define appropriate measures of learning effectiveness based on learning objectives and desired business outcomes.
* Develop assessments, knowledge checks, surveys, and other mechanisms to evaluate learner understanding and experience.
* Review learner feedback, stakeholder input, and available learning data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend enhancements to learning content, delivery approaches, and supporting resources based on data and feedback.
* Capture lessons learned and reusable content or approaches that can support future learning initiatives.

 #### **Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in Learning \& Develop

JOB SUMMARY
  
  

HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re\-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. * **Counseling**\- Provides individual counseling and informational services to Medicare beneficiaries regarding Medicare insurance options, eligibility for financial assistance programs to help with Medicare costs, billing problems, and other related topics.
* **Advocacy** \- Assists individuals as appropriate to ensure that clients’ rights and privileges under Medicare are upheld, makes appropriate referrals to legal services and /or other agencies, and offers other referrals and/or interventions as needed and appropriate.
* **Record Keeping**\-Maintains accurate database records on all clients, contacts, and services
* **Community Outreach and Education** \- Attend outreach events or conduct presentations to community groups, senior centers, senior lunch sites, etc. Providing presentations regarding HICAP services, Medicare, Medicare Supplemental (Medigap) insurance, long\-term care insurance, consumer rights, Medicare Advantage (MA), and prescription drug plans (PDP) and promotes program publicity.
* **Collaboration and Communications**\- Demonstrates a collaborative and respectful approach to working with colleagues, contributing to a positive, team\-oriented work environment.
* **Attendance and Punctuality**\- Maintains regular and reliable attendance, adhering to assigned work schedules and punctuality standards.
* Substitutes for volunteer counselors at counseling sites when needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent training with a minimum of two years providing services in a social services or health care organization or related experience.
* Must complete HICAP counselor training and/or registration within 2 months of employment, depending on program needs. Must maintain current registration standards as outlined by the CDA.
* Three or more years providing services in a social services or health care organization or related experience.
* Knowledge of Medicare, Medi\-Cal, Medigap, managed care, long\-term care insurance, and health care delivery systems preferred.
* Must abide by the HICAP Confidentiality and Conflict of Interest Guidelines as outlined by the CDA and HICAP. These include having no past or present employment or financial interests and investments, or personal affiliations that may affect their ability to provide HICAP services in an objective and unbiased manner.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, and experience in group presentations. Bilingual in English and Chinese/Spanish/Russian/Vietnamese preferred.
* Must be self\-motivated, organized, and able to multitask under minimal supervision.
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment;
* Sensitive to the needs of the elderly and disabled adults from diverse ethnic and minority cultures.
* Proficient in MS Office and the Internet.
* Must be able to travel via public transportation or personal vehicle for the performance of job duties. If driving, must have and maintain a valid CA driver license, satisfactory driving record, and auto insurance coverage as specified in Self\-Help's policy.

*Self\-Help for the Elderly is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmation Action Employer and we welcome diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law. We participate in E\-Verify.*

*Qualified applicants with criminal history will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*

*We may provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, please call (415\) 677\-7600 for special assistance.*

**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.

* Mentor junior analysts and guide their professional growth.

new_jobs.description:
- **ABOUT WIND RIVER**
====================

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission\-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.


Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.


The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer\-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion \& belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world.


**YOUR ROLE**
=============

We are seeking a highly analytical and technology\-focused Sales Operations Administrator to drive operational excellence across our global sales organization.


In this role, you will be responsible for optimizing sales processes, administering critical sales technologies, delivering actionable analytics, and supporting automation initiatives that improve seller productivity, data quality, and operational efficiency.


**HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE**
---------------------------

You will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance, IT, and Business Systems teams to streamline workflows, improve reporting visibility, and help scale operations as Wind River continues to grow.


**In your daily work, you will:**
---------------------------------


	* Administer and optimize key sales technologies including Salesforce CRM, Salesforce CPQ, ZoomInfo, Clari, Outreach, Salesloft, and related sales engagement platforms.
	* Support onboarding and offboarding activities for sales personnel and related user groups.
	* Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and analytics that support leadership decision\-making.
	* Identify operational bottlenecks and drive continuous improvements across lead management, opportunity progression, territory management, forecasting, quoting, and partner\-related processes.
	* Build and enhance automation solutions within Salesforce, including workflows, approvals, validation rules, and process automation.
	* Partner with cross\-functional teams to improve data governance, system adoption, and operational effectiveness.
	* Participate in evaluating, testing, and implementing new sales technologies and process enhancements.**Key skills and competencies for succeeding in this role include:**
--------------------------------------------------------------------


	* 5\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related analytical role.
	* 3\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce administration and support experience.
	* Strong experience developing Salesforce reports, dashboards, and analytics.
	* Experience supporting Salesforce CPQ environments.
	* Experience with Salesforce Enterprise Territory Management (ETM) or similar territory management solutions preferred.
	* Experience with ZoomInfo, sales engagement platforms, and sales productivity tools.
	* Experience developing process automation within Salesforce.
	* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with strong Excel skills.
	* Strong understanding of CRM data quality, governance, and reporting best practices.
	* Ability to analyze business processes and translate requirements into scalable operational solutions.
	* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
	* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
	* Self\-motivated team player with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.**BENEFITS**
============


	* Hybrid work model for workplace flexibility.
	* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
	* Life insurance.
	* Short and long\-term disability coverage.
	* Flexible time\-off policies.
	* Employee assistance program.
	* Learning and professional development opportunities, including access to LinkedIn Learning.
	* 401(k) participation and company\-sponsored programs.**COMPENSATION**
----------------

This role is compensation range is between $140,00 to $160,000 USD plus annual incentive plan bonus. Compensation is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and abilities of the applicant, and equity with other team members. Employees in this role are also eligible for the following benefits in accordance with the terms of the Company's plans: health, dental, vision insurance, life insurance, flex time off, eligibility to enroll in 401k, and 12 paid holidays.

----------------------------

new_jobs.description:
**OUR COMMITMENT TO A HUMAN HIRING PROCESS**



We believe every candidate deserves thoughtful consideration. That's why we do not use AI or automated systems to review applications. Every application is reviewed by a real human member of our team. Because we take the time to give each submission the attention it deserves, our review process may take a little longer — and we genuinely appreciate your patience as we work through applications carefully and respectfully.


**SERVICE AREA PREFERENCE**



While we encourage all interested applicants to apply, we do give priority to those who live in, or near, our service counties: Santa Cruz, Monterey, Merced, San Benito, and Mariposa. Our mission of *accessible, quality health care guided by local innovation*leads everything we do, and having team members who are connected to the communities we serve strengthens our ability to deliver on that commitment.


#### **ABOUT THIS TEMP POSITION**



This is a temporary position. The length of the assignment is estimated to go from September 2026 through December 2026, but this is always dependent on business need, and these dates may change. While the assignment would be at the Alliance, you would be an employee of a temporary employment agency that we would connect you with if hired for this position.This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) temporary assignment.


**WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**



Reporting to the Enterprise Project Management Manager, this position:


* Provides intermediate\-level project management support for medium to high complexity cross\-functional, systems\-driven strategic and operational projects involving interdepartmental units and/or external stakeholder teams through all aspects of the project lifecycle
* Conducts intermediate\-level business, technical and financial analysis and reporting to support operations and business development
* Effectively utilizes, implements and communicates project management methodologies and policies, and mentors project teams, project stakeholders and Enterprise Project Managers, to ensure accuracy, consistency and thoroughness


**ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Project Management Office (PMO) is a key part of our Operational Excellence Department, committed to *providing and growing operational effectiveness expertise across the organization*. As the PMO team, we contribute to that commitment through enterprise Portfolio, Program and Project Management services, enabling the organization to operationally adapt and advance our mission. The PMO's role is to provide practical structure, partnership, and support that makes it easier for teams to deliver meaningful outcomes and focus on what matters most: serving our members well.



**IDEAL CANDIDATE**



We are looking for a flexible, adaptable professional who works effectively with stakeholders at all levels and keeps projects moving in a fast\-paced environment. This person communicates clearly, collaborates across teams, and manages the full project lifecycle with strong organization and attention to detail. They are resourceful and solution oriented, able to balance multiple priorities while producing high\-quality documentation. They take ownership of their work, build trust and credibility quickly, foster alignment across teams, and contribute to team success with a constructive, team\-first approach.



#### **WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**



To read the full position description and list of requirements, click here.


* **Knowledge of:**
* + Project management methodologies and tools
	+ Windows based PC systems and Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and project management software applications
	+ Methods and tools of meeting facilitation and ability to lead team building exercises and facilitate meetings and/or projects using problem solving and persuasion skills
* **Ability to:**
	+ Demonstrate strong analytical skills and identify issues, offer solutions and mitigate risk
	+ Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner
	+ Maintain organized and accurate records
	+ Accurately collect, interpret and evaluate data, make recommendations, and project consequences of recommendations
	+ Prepare statistical and narrative reports
* **Education and Experience:**
	+ Bachelor's degree in a Business, Health Care or a related field
	+ A minimum of three years of project management experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be qualifying

#### **OTHER INFORMATION**


* We are in a hybrid work environment, and we anticipate that the interview process will take place remotely via Microsoft Teams.
* While some staff may work full telecommuting schedules, attendance at quarterly company\-wide events or department meetings will be expected.
* In\-office or in\-community presence may be required for some positions and is dependent on business need. Details about this can be reviewed during the interview process.
* **This is a temporary position and does not provide the benefits that are listed below (this is standard language from our regular job posts and cannot be altered or removed). Temporary employees on assignment at the Alliance will be connected to a staffing agency with separate benefit options.**


**COMPENSATION INFORMATION**


* **Zone 1 Pay Range: $57\.70 \- $63\.50**  

Typical areas in Zone 1: Santa Cruz, San Benito, and Monterey Counties, Bay Area, Sacramento, Los Angeles and San Diego areas
* **Zone 2 Pay Range: $54\.50 \- $60\.10**  

Typical areas in Zone 2: Mariposa and Merced Counties, Fresno area, Bakersfield, Eastern California, San Luis Obispo area, and the Central Valley (except Sacramento)


The applicable salary ranges are based on work location and are aligned to a zone according to the cost of labor in your area. All ranges are subject to change in the future. We are happy to answer any questions that you have or share the applicable pay zone for your location if it's not one of the typical areas listed. You can reach out to

new_jobs.title: Program Manager- NPI
new_jobs.description:
As NPI Program Manager, you will serve as the primary leader for assigned customer programs and portfolios, driving the execution of customer commitments, operational performance, and business objectives. You will align resources across Molex GSM, translate customer requirements into executable plans, and lead cross\-functional teams through demand planning, delivery, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Account Management, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain \& Operations, Procurement, and Sales, you will ensure priorities, risks, and decisions are effectively managed to support customer success and profitable growth.
Success in this role requires strong business acumen, customer advocacy, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization to drive accountability, disciplined execution, and measurable results. The Program Manager is accountable for overall program performance and customer satisfaction, ensuring alignment between customer priorities and business objectives.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead cross\-functional execution of customer programs and projects, managing priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions to ensure successful delivery of customer and business objectives.
* Serve as the primary program leader and internal customer advocate, aligning customer priorities, contractual commitments, and business objectives with operational capabilities and resources.
* Establish and maintain program governance, including customer reviews, executive business reviews, escalation management, action tracking, performance reporting, and recovery planning.
* Translate customer demand, forecasts, program changes, and strategic priorities into coordinated plans that support delivery, quality, responsiveness, and profitable growth.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate risks while facilitating timely, data\-driven decision\-making to prevent impacts to customer experience or business performance.
* Develop and maintain program plans, dashboards, performance metrics, and communication processes that provide visibility, accountability, and execution discipline.
* Partner with commercial and operational leaders to support strategic account planning, identify growth opportunities, improve forecast accuracy, and protect profitability.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including on\-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, customer satisfaction, and program profitability.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 2\+ years of experience leading programs, projects, customer accounts, or cross\-functional business initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across matrixed organizations, manage risk, balance competing priorities, and drive execution without direct authority.
* Strong business, financial, analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills, including experience leading customer communications, escalations, and performance reviews.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, ERP/MRP systems, business intelligence tools, and performance reporting dashboards.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience leading strategic customer programs in aerospace, defense, space, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting strategic account growth, new program launches, demand planning, and manufacturing operations.
* Experience presenting to executive leadership, leading customer business reviews, and building strong customer relationships while balancing business and operational priorities.
* PMP, PgMP, Lean Six Sigma, or comparable project management and continuous improvement certifications.

new_jobs.title: Residential Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Nordin Builders is a small, family\-run residential general contractor looking for a Project Manager to join our team. We build and remodel homes throughout Los Altos, Los Altos Hills, Palo Alto, Mountain View, Woodside and surrounding areas.

This is a hybrid role, but the majority of the position is spent onsite. We’re looking for someone who understands residential construction, can confidently read plans, knows construction sequencing and is comfortable managing the day\-to\-day moving pieces of a project.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day progress of residential projects
* Coordinate subcontractors, inspections, deliveries and materials
* Read architectural and structural plans and oversee work in the field
* Maintain project schedules and stay ahead of upcoming trades and project needs
* Communicate with homeowners, architects, designers, subcontractors and our internal team
* Identify issues in the field and work with the team to resolve them
* Manage project documentation such as change orders and punch lists
* Keep project information organized and up to date in Buildertrend and Google Drive

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong knowledge of residential construction and how a project comes together from start to finish
* Very good at reading and understanding construction plans
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing and trade coordination
* Organized, dependable and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces
* Strong communication and follow\-through
* Comfortable with technology and proficient with Google Drive, Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Calendar
* Buildertrend experience is a plus, but not required

We’re flexible on exact background and experience. Residential project management experience is a plus, but strong field experience, construction knowledge and the ability to stay organized and manage a project are most important to us.

Because we’re a small team, this person will work closely with both our field and office staff and have a lot of involvement in their projects.

* **Full\-time \| Monday–Friday**
* **Primarily onsite with some remote flexibility**
* **Compensation based on experience**

Pay: From $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company truck
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R\&D organization. You will run internal voice\-of\-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.


This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross\-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.


This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

* Own end\-to\-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.

**Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!**
---------------------------------------------


Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.


As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.


We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

**Role**
--------


We’re looking for a Senior Creative Operations Program Manager to lead large, high\-visibility campaigns across the Whatnot brand. This person will sit at the center of Creative, Marketing, and Catex teams, bringing structure to complex initiatives, aligning stakeholders, and keeping work moving from kickoff through launch. LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987\. With 40 programs, LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site\-based programs and community outreach.


**POSITION PURPOSE**
The Case Manager reports to the Program Director and supports clients by assisting with care and linking them to housing and community resources. The position plays a key role in supporting people moving toward safe, stable housing and greater self\-sufficiency. They provide case management services, life skills support, and resource connections and work in partnership with clients to set goals, celebrate progress, and overcome challenges. Using a trauma\-informed and a strength\-based approach, this position builds trust and respect, making sure clients feel heard, valued, and supported throughout their journey.


Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high\-quality, coordinated care. Through their efforts, staff empower clients to grow their strengths, reach their goals, and build a better future.


**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES****Client Support and Case Management*** Develop and maintain individualized case plans focused on housing, employment, benefits, and overall well\-being, based on each client’s strengths and goals.
* Support clients with housing searches, employment readiness, benefits enrollment (e.g., General Assistance, CalFresh, CAPI), and skill\-building activities such as budgeting and daily living.
* Connect clients to healthcare providers and community resources, and assist with coordination, scheduling, and transportation as needed.
* Maintain accurate and timely client documentation and outcome tracking in HMIS and the agency’s client management system.
* Advocate for client needs and rights when working with partners, landlords, employers, or service agencies; provide mediation and conflict resolution support as needed.
* Provide calm, trauma\-informed crisis response and ensure all client services align with ethical standards and agency values.

**Resource Connection and Community Collaboration*** Build and maintain partnerships with community organizations, public agencies, and system partners (e.g., VA, APS, CPS, Probation) to support clients and improve access to resources.

* Be available to work occasional evenings and weekends as needed or as schedule describes.
* Perform other duties as assigned to meet program and organizational needs.

**Kaiser Team Responsibilities*** Act as the point of contact at medical facilities when needed to advocate and support client care.

**QUALIFICATIONS*** **Educational Requirements:** Associate Degree in related field preferred; or High School Diploma/GED with 2\-5 years of equivalent experience in related field. new_jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Creator Economy runs on two things creators can't get a straight answer on: what their content is actually earning across platforms, and when that money lands in their account. We're solving both.

Over 1\.2 million Creators across 50\+ countries rely on ChannelMeter for the data behind their business—performance and monetization reporting across platforms beyond YouTube—and for the payments infrastructure that turns that data into money in their bank account. We've processed $1\.8B\+ in payments for Creator Networks, agencies, IP distributors, and global brands, and the analytics layer underneath is just as core to what we do as the payment rails.

The market is heading toward $500B by 2027, and most of the infrastructure to support it—on the data side and the money side—doesn't exist yet. We're building it, and we need someone who can speak fluently to both halves of that problem for every customer who depends on us.

**Why this role exists**

Our customers don't show up with one kind of question. One week it's "why does my YouTube monetization number look off," the next it's "where's my payment," and often it's both at once, tangled together. This isn't a check\-in\-once\-a\-quarter role—you'll be embedded in how our customers understand their own data and their own money, spotting risk before it becomes churn and opportunity before anyone has to ask for it. And you'll do it with AI as a core part of how you work, not an add\-on: Claude, Codex, and Claude Cowork are expected tools here, not optional ones.

**What you'll own**

**Own the full customer relationship**

\- Guide customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion, building trust with everyone from day\-to\-day operators to economic buyers

\- Manage a tiered portfolio—hands\-on for our largest Creator Networks and agencies, and scalable playbooks (lifecycle campaigns, in\-product prompts, proactive outreach) for the rest, so growth doesn't just mean more headcount

**Be fluent in the data, not just the money**

\- Help customers interpret their own performance and monetization data—including YouTube monetization trends—as confidently as they'd want a finance person to explain a payment

\- Spot data anomalies (a channel's reported earnings not matching what a customer expects) before they turn into a support escalation or a trust problem

\- Track account health against a mix of signals—retention, expansion, NPS/sentiment, and data/usage patterns—not payment metrics alone

**Turn signals into action**

\- Partner with Risk and Finance on underwriting\-adjacent questions and payment escalations, and with Data and Product on reporting or monetization discrepancies—most real issues touch both

\- Feed what you're hearing from customers back into Product in a structured way, not just as one\-off tickets

**Build the playbook as you go**

\- Use your AI toolkit daily—prep for calls, draft QBRs, summarize account history, and flag risk patterns before they surface

\- Keep a tight, structured pipeline in your task management system—every commitment and renewal date owned, nothing left to memory

\- Help define what great customer success looks like at ChannelMeter as we build out the function

**Who you are**

\- 3–5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer\-facing SaaS/B2B role

\- Already fluent with AI tools like Claude, Codex, or Cowork in your daily workflow—this is the single biggest predictor of success here

\- Comfortable being the translator between a data/analytics question and a payments/financial one—most accounts touch both, often in the same conversation

\- A clear, concise writer who simplifies complex things instead of complicating simple ones

\- Obsessively organized, with the kind of follow\-through that catches what everyone else missed

\- Genuinely curious about the Creator Economy—how creators actually make money across platforms, not just how they get paid

**Nice to have**

\- Experience with creator or content analytics, multi\-channel network (MCN) tools, or platform monetization systems (YouTube or otherwise)

\- Experience in payments, fintech, or financial operations

\- Time spent in the Creator Economy—platform, agency, brand, or enterprise side

\- Startup experience where you had to build the process, not just follow one

**The fine print**

\- Based in the SF Bay Area or Los Angeles, available to come into the office regularly

\- Authorized to work in the US—we can't sponsor visas or support relocation for this role

\- Comfortable demonstrating your AI workflow as part of the interview process

**What success looks like**

In your first 60 days: you've met every account in your portfolio and can speak to both the data and the money behind your top accounts accurately, you've got a first pass at a health\-tracking system in place, and your task pipeline is fully stood up.

By 6 months: retention and expansion in your book are trending up, Product and Data are getting structured, regular signal from your accounts, and the playbooks you've built are ones a future hire could pick up and run with.

**Compensation**

\- Base: $55,000–$85,000 USD

\- Commission on top of base—$85K–$125K OTE

\- Health benefits, unlimited PTO, team offsites, and flexible work arrangements

**How we hire**

We move quickly and respect your time. Most candidates wrap up in 2–3 weeks:

1\. Intro call (30 min)

2\. Team interview (45 min)

3\. Short take\-home exercise (AI tools expected, not just encouraged)

4\. Presentation \& discussion

5\. Leadership conversations

6\. References \& offer

**Apply**

Send your resume or LinkedIn to jobs@channelmeter.com. Tell us your favorite Creator, and one specific way you've used data or AI to improve a customer outcome.

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Technical Account Management Services, the **Technical Account Manager** (**TAM**) serves as a liaison between Availity’s technical teams, health plan analyst, Strategic Account Managers (SAS) and the strategic health plan partners, ensuring that the products or services align with the customers' technical needs and business objectives. * This is a fast\-paced, flexible, and collaborative work environment where you are encouraged to bring your authentic self every day in the pursuit of serving our clients.
* This position gives exposure to multiple areas within Availity and is a great career path to future Account Management roles within the company.

  

  

**To be qualified for this role you:**

**What will set you apart:**

**Sunny's Gourmet Products · Part\-time · Remote with travel to Mishawaka, Indiana**

Sunny's Gourmet Products manufactures authentic Korean sauces and seasonings — all\-natural, chef\-developed, and built on recipes our founder refined over more than thirty years, first in her own restaurant kitchen and now as a packaged goods line. We distribute nationally through KeHE, with UNFI in progress, alongside self\-distribution and Amazon, and hold retail placement across the Midwest and beyond.

**The opportunity**

This is a new role and a broad one. Our founder has run production directly since the beginning, and this next stage calls for formalizing what she has built — specifications, quality standards, supplier and cost systems — so it scales with us.

You would own that work end to end and design most of it rather than inherit it. For an operator who would rather build than maintain, there is real room here, and the role is structured to grow as the company does.

**The first six months**

*Month 1 — Get oriented.* Meet the team, learn the products, and map the current state across records, suppliers, contracts, certifications, and working arrangements. Deliver a current\-state map and a prioritized roadmap.

*Months 2–3 — On\-site intensive.* Two consecutive days in Mishawaka working directly with the founder and observing live production, capturing formulation, process parameters, and quality standards. A structured question bank and capture protocol are ready for you.

*Months 3–4 — Documentation.* Master specifications for four SKUs, quality standards with defined acceptance criteria, and core operating procedures.

*Months 4–6 — Build the operating record.* Supplier and packaging master with terms and lead times, SKU\-level cost build and COGS, logistics and fulfillment, and the compliance documentation our distribution partners require.

**Ongoing**

* Own and maintain the specification and procedure library
* Supplier relationships, purchasing cadence, and terms
* Cost tracking and margin analysis by SKU and channel
* Retailer and distributor compliance documentation and new item setup
* Co\-manufacturer qualification as we expand capacity
* Production planning and inventory as volume grows

**Required**

* Documentation experience in a regulated manufacturing environment — food, pharmaceutical, or medical device. Food preferred.
* Fluency in controlled documentation: specifications, batch records, operating procedures, and change control
* Experience building operating systems, not only maintaining them
* Experience working directly with a founder\-operator
* Self\-directed, and comfortable owning a function end to end

**Preferred**

* Food manufacturing background, particularly shelf\-stable products
* HACCP, GMP, and FSMA fluency
* Experience taking a small brand into co\-manufacturing
* Familiarity with KeHE and UNFI mechanics, trade spend, and deductions
* SKU\-level cost accounting
* Based in the South Bend–Elkhart area — convenient for the on\-site work, though not required

**Terms**

Independent contractor on a monthly retainer. Approximately 30 hours per month at $1,600–1,800, depending on experience and scope. Twelve\-month horizon with a path to a full\-time operations role as revenue supports it. Remote — on\-site work in Mishawaka is expected to be roughly 10% of the engagement or less, concentrated in the intensive. Airfare and lodging arranged and paid by SGP, ground transportation reimbursed. Mutual NDA prior to disclosure.

**To apply**

Send relevant experience with particular attention to operations work you built rather than inherited; one sample deliverable you authored (redaction is fine); your read on where you would start; and your availability.

Pay: $1,600\.00 \- $1,800\.00 per month

**About Fringe**


Fringe is a fast\-growing HR technology company based in Virginia. Founded in late 2018, Fringe is the first ever platform for personalized lifestyle benefits. We built Fringe to give companies a better way to show love and care to their people. Because we believe it's the people who really matter. Companies exist because of the products and services they offer, but we believe the people within them should come first. At Fringe, this is the way we live.

We're a startup, and that means we must be a courageous group. We solve problems all day, but we also mess up sometimes. We extend grace to each other, and we try again. **About the role**


Fringe's employee experience platform combines a B2B model with a B2B2C marketplace. Employers pay us a subscription and fund lifestyle benefits, swag, recognition, and gifting for their people. Employees spend those dollars as points in our marketplace across hundreds of vendors. We pay the vendors. That means we run a SaaS business and a marketplace at the same time, with deferred revenue, points liabilities, and a cohort of channel partners layered on top. If you find that combination energizing rather than intimidating, keep reading.


You'll be the in\-house finance and accounting leader at Fringe and will take over a well\-built set of documented, repeatable close processes. You will own the monthly close and everything that comes out of it, run our financial operations end to end, and be the person everyone at Fringe comes to with a finance question. You'll report to the COO and work closely with Operations and Product.


This is a role for a professional who wants to jump into a startup environment and own a whole function. It is a lot of hats and it is a rare amount of scope, ownership, and visibility..


**What you'll own**


**Monthly close and reporting**


* Run the full monthly close: close calendar, journal entries, reconciliations, and sign\-off across subscription and marketplace revenue.
* Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 for a hybrid model: PEPM subscriptions, employer\-funded marketplace spend, gifting, and partner revenue share.
* Maintain deferred revenue and points liability roll\-forwards and keep the balance sheet clean and explainable.
* Produce internal and external monthly reporting: variance and flux analysis and the executive dashboard.
* Support the annual audit and tax processes with our outside CPA firms.


**Financial operations**


* Treasury and cash: cash forecast, bank relationships, managing operating balances, and executing outbound wires and ACH payments with proper approvals.
* Accounts payable, accounts receivable and collections in partnership with Customer Success: customer invoicing and billing accuracy, vendor payment runs, and chasing what's past due.
* Payroll, working with People Operations and our PEO.
* Review all accounting work and ensure a high standard.


**Cross\-functional partner**


* Be the main point of contact for all things finance internally: contract terms, vendor questions, funding schedules, commission plans, budgets.
* Spot the process that's slowing us down and fix it. Drive operational improvement rather than waiting for someone to ask.


**Who you are**


* High agency and a bias for action. You'd rather ship a good answer today than a perfect one next week, and you know which situations call for which.
* Comfortable being the only finance person in the room, and honest about when you need a second set of eyes.
* A clear communicator who can explain a flux to the CEO, a payment term to a salesperson, and a rev rec judgment to an auditor.
* Curious about how the business actually works, not just how it's booked.
* Someone who owns mistakes, extends grace, and shows up as the same person every day. That's who we are.


**Need to haves**


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience.
* Deep understanding of GAAP, especially ASC 606\.
* Hands\-on experience running monthly close procedures and meeting internal and external reporting requirements.
* Familiarity with an accounting tech stack and a spreadsheet wizard (Quickbooks, Tabs, Anrok, FloQast, Salesforce, Claude, Google Sheets)
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to drive operational improvement.
* Quality communicator, written and verbal.


**Nice to haves**


* Experience at Big 4, high\-growth startup, management consulting, or investment banking.
* CPA (active or license applicant).
* SaaS or marketplace experience, especially with deferred revenue, points or stored value, or multi\-party revenue.


**What we offer**


Fringe is remote\-first, with an office in Richmond, VA for those who want it. Beyond the scope of the role itself, here's what comes with it:


* Competitive salary.
* Employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for individuals and families.
* 3% company match on 401(k) retirement

new_jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

About TSOLife

TSOLife is an AI\-powered resident insight and experience platform providing automated data collection, business intelligence, and actionable insights for the senior living industry. We leverage cutting\-edge technology to allow businesses to make data\-informed decisions and truly personalize the resident experience.

Customer Success Team

The Customer Success team owns the customer journey from onboarding through adoption, retention, and growth. We combine high\-touch relationship management with data, technology, and proactive account strategy to ensure customers realize measurable value from TSOLife. Our CSMs are growth partners who identify risk early, drive adoption across their accounts, and continuously look for opportunities to deepen customer value.

The Role

The Customer Success Manager owns the success and growth of an assigned portfolio of TSOLife customers. You will build trusted relationships from community users through corporate executives while using account data, platform adoption, and customer goals to determine where to focus your attention.

This is a proactive role. You will be expected to identify risk before the customer raises it, drive adoption when usage is falling short, lead difficult conversations when necessary, and recognize opportunities to expand the relationship.

**Position Type**

Fulltime, Salary

**Location**

Remote

**What You’ll Do**

**Own the Full Customer Lifecycle**

* Serve as the primary strategic point of contact, building trusted relationships with community users and corporate stakeholders.
* Own the full implementation and onboarding lifecycle for assigned accounts.

**Drive Account Health, Retention \& Growth**

* Monitor engagement and platform usage and adoption metrics, proactively diagnosing barriers and executing corrective action plans before they become retention risks.
* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities as accounts mature, translating usage patterns into a broader growth strategy.
* Deliver QBRs and executive reporting that demonstrate value, insights, outcomes, and forward strategy to senior stakeholders.

**Champion Full Feature Product Adoption**

* Stay fluent in all TSOLife products and updates, enabling accurate communication and guidance for customers across our full solution set — not just the module they started with.
* Create and maintain training and enablement resources to accelerate adoption and support new releases.
* Provide timely, high\-quality support that resolves issues and keeps daily operations running smoothly for every account.

**Partner Across the Business**

* Advocate for customer needs internally, gathering feedback and partnering with Product, Engineering, and leadership on improvements.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure a cohesive customer experience that supports company\-wide objectives.
* Ensure the timely delivery of customer\-facing assets, including calendars, newsletters, and monthly content, as applicable.

**Build Repeatable Customer Success Practices**

* Maintain accurate documentation and reporting on account status, risks, value metrics, and engagement activities.
* Champion industry best practices and emerging trends to continuously raise the bar on customer outcomes.
* Take on additional responsibilities as they arise — this is a builder's seat in a growing department.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Proven Customer Success Ownership**

* Experience owning the full customer relationship \- onboarding, adoption, retention, and growth with a track record of proactively catching account risk before it becomes a churn conversation, not just responding to tickets as they come in.

**Product Comprehension**

* The ability to learn a multi\-module SaaS platform deeply enough to recognize when a customer's actual goals call for a different or additional part of the product than what they originally asked for.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Comfort operating as the bridge between Product, Support, Sales, and the customer, translating customer feedback into something the internal team can act on, and translating roadmap and constraints into something a community or corporate stakeholder can understand.

**Business \& Data Fluency**

* Ability to walk a corporate stakeholder through usage metrics, adoption trends, and ROI in a QBR, and tie those numbers to a forward strategy — not just deliver a relationship\-first status update.
* Comfortable balancing white\-glove service with hard conversations about risk and performance.

**High\-Touch Service at Scale**

* Experience providing individualized, high\-touch service to enterprise or senior\-living\-caliber accounts, with the judgment to know when a tailored approach is worth the extra effort and when it isn't.

**Creative Problem Solving**

* A resourceful, first\-principles approach to genuinely ambiguous problems — finding workarounds within real constraints rather than stalling at “that's not possible,” without cutting corners on documentation, security, or scope.

**Execution at Volume**

* Strong personal systems for managing a full portfolio of accounts simultaneously, with the organizational discipline to make sure nothing goes quiet even as volume grows.
* Shown Project management and process development experience

**Industry \& Technical Fluency**

* Experience in senior living, healthcare, or another relationship\-intensive service industry preferred.
* High comfort with technology, including messaging, video conferencing, workflow, and database tools.

**Values Alignment:** 

* A genuine fit with TSOLife's values Integrity, Learning, Resilience, Compassion, Self\-Awareness, and Team Work.

Why You’ll Love it Here

* **Make a Difference:** Your work measurably improves quality of life for 230,000\+ senior living residents.
* **Passionate Team:** Workwith a great, mission\-driven team with shared, unwavering purpose and drive.
